## `tests/fixtures/classical.comments` (2 lines)

````
Hand derivations: sum(n) accumulates n+(n-1)+...+1, hence n(n+1)/2 for n<=8. nested calls f, whose clock.read in g is cancelled by an inner uncall; uncalling f must skip those frames, leaving clock=0. effects copies entropy [11,22,33] to console, clock.read writes initial 0, then block.write/read sector 7; five tape entries, clock=1, return 0. Whole reversal removes the formerly absent sector. impure performs store after g, so uncall faults 4. entropy_short has live destination but empty tape and faults 10 atomically. Unknown device faults 8. Null load faults 7; 3/0 faults 5.
Host: request is a5 00 00 in a three-byte allocation. Reply 11 22 33 44 55 writes 11 22 33 and returns full length 5; reversal restores the original bytes and then allocation. Null host pointer faults 7 before making a request.
````

## `tests/fixtures/control_flow.comments` (22 lines)

````
Hand-derived expectations, recorded before execution:
while3: flag_i is AND of p[0] through p[i]. X flips t once per true flag.
Thus t is XORed with the parity of the initial consecutive ones in p, and p
is unchanged. At p=3 (011) it flips twice; at p=5 (101) it flips once.
Adjoint reverses those same enabled iterations and clears all three flags.
conditional: starting with t=0 and p=+ gives amplitudes [0,1/sqrt(2),1/2,1/2]
in allocation order (t low bit). Applying the adjoint restores t=0,p=+.
minus_i: S^2=Z; the six gates S S X S S X act as X Z X Z = -I exactly.
controlled_phase calls minus_i: controlled by p, it is Z on p;
H p; controlled_phase; H p therefore produces p=1 with probability one.
phase retains theta=6.283185307179586=884279719003555/140737488355328,
a finite binary64 angle, not symbolic 2*pi. Its Rz is
diag(exp(-i*theta/2), exp(i*theta/2)). Starting at t=p=0, the separate
H p; ctl p phase; H p probe has amplitudes (1+exp(-i*theta/2))/2 on 00
and (1-exp(-i*theta/2))/2 on 01 (wire order t,p).
P(p=0)=cos(theta/4)^2 is strictly positive, approximately 3.749399456654644e-33;
both exact-support keys must survive even when a displayed component rounds.
exchange: qexchm swaps t with m[a] and leaves the other cell unchanged.
image: data symbol bytes (hex dead) has cell0=0xde and cell1=0xad. With t initially0x35 the
result is0xeb or0x98 respectively. Scratch and local image are restored.
borrowed: CX x,b; CX b,t; CX x,b; CX b,t gives t XOR x, restores b,
and has no dependence on b, including when b is entangled externally.
````

## `tests/fixtures/heap.comments` (1 lines)

````
Hand-derived vectors: heap_base=32, heap_limit=32, initial pinned g=(16,1); table capacity=4. heap allocates two bytes at 32, stores 0x1234 little endian (34 12), loads 4660. heap_limit=1 faults 2. Two zero-sized allocations still consume one byte each, so returned pointers differ by 1. Freed, pinned, double-freed, null store accesses fault 7. Three new allocations fill the table; the fourth faults 2. faultif(true,9) gives (0,9).

## `tests/fixtures/mutual.comments` (1 lines)

````

## `tests/fixtures/nested.comments` (1 lines)

````
Hand derivation: inc8(8)=9 in three rows. nested calls it, compares fr to zero, and raises FAULT_CALLEE=9 on an unsuccessful inner budget. cancel calls then uncalls with identical ins/mem/token, so target and fr return to zero even for a callee fault. ignore returns a zero payload when the callee faults without automatic propagation. inc8(255)=0 by 8-bit wrap.
````

## `tests/fixtures/registers.comments` (1 lines)

````
Hand-derived vectors: allocation concatenates two clean one-wire qregs and frees the resulting clean two-wire qreg. views flips bit 0 through a view twice; each region call consumes that view and restores its parent to live, so free succeeds. unclean flips a one-wire qreg once, so free traps with code 4 before consuming it. measurement produces Bell amplitudes at 00 and 11, probabilities 1/2; draws 0.1 and 0.9 select 0 and 3 respectively. measuring (CC, since an R function may call only R functions, §3.1 / SPEC-QUESTIONS 19) wraps that call; bad_uncall must trap 4 because the uncalled CC segment contains a measure frame (§7.4). Reversal restores handle states and wire identities for reversible traces; measurement traces are ineligible.
````

## `tests/fixtures/tiny_memory.comments` (1 lines)

````
Hand derivation over full D (14 bits): input x is one bit, db is one caller-owned byte, target one bit, fault four bits. Rows: addr, zext x, load db, udiv(db,x), const one, and, icmp, retval. x=0 faults DIV0=5 at row 4. x=1 returns db&1 at row 8. Earlier prefixes give step-budget fault 1. B=9 has one idle HALT frame. Every target/fault entry value is checked by explicit commit and every internal location/frame/byte/pre-entry must restore.
````

## `tests/fixtures/wide.comments` (12 lines)

````
Hand expectations, recorded before execution:
x=2^200+3=1606938044258990275541962092341162602522202993782792835301379;
y=2^100+5=1267650600228229401496703205381.
div257 quotient=2^100-5=1267650600228229401496703205371, remainder28,
since (2^100-5)(2^100+5)=2^200-25. It finishes in2 rows; B1 faults1.
add257 computes (x+y) mod2^257 in2 rows.
call257 captures x into id257, returns x, then retval:3 rows. id257's frame
has3 metadata+1 parameter+1 result=5 cells. stack4 faults3 on the first row;
stack5 and depth1 suffice. Every complete prefix must reverse.
fault257 emits code2^200+3 in one row, no payload, high bit200 retained.
fault_small257 has the same wide fault but one input bit: both inputs yield
that fault in one row. Its small input domain permits exhaustive CLI checking.
````

mod support;
use bennett_isa_ref::{sha256_hex, Object};

#[test]
fn fips_180_4_sha256_vectors() {
    for (input, expected) in [
        ("", "e3b0c44298fc1c149afbf4c8996fb92427ae41e4649b934ca495991b7852b855"),
        ("abc", "ba7816bf8f01cfea414140de5dae2223b00361a396177a9cb410ff61f20015ad"),
        ("abcdbcdecdefdefgefghfghighijhijkijkljklmklmnlmnomnopnopq", "248d6a61d20638b8e5c026930c3e6039a33ce45964ff2167f6ecedd419db06c1"),
        ("abcdefghbcdefghicdefghijdefghijkefghijklfghijklmghijklmnhijklmnoijklmnopjklmnopqklmnopqrlmnopqrsmnopqrstnopqrstu", "cf5b16a778af8380036ce59e7b0492370b249b11e8f07a51afac45037afee9d1"),
    ] { assert_eq!(sha256_hex(input.as_bytes()), expected); }
    assert_eq!(
        sha256_hex(&vec![b'a'; 1_000_000]),
        "cdc76e5c9914fb9281a1c7e284d73e67f1809a48a497200e046d39ccc7112cd0"
    );
}

#[test]
fn all_four_published_hashes_and_printed_envelopes() {
    let spec = include_str!("../../spec/Bennett-ISA-Spec.md");
    let mut hashes = std::collections::BTreeMap::new();
    let mut envelopes = Vec::new();
    for fixture in [
        include_str!("fixtures/inc8.bisa"),
        include_str!("fixtures/sum_db.bisa"),
    ] {
        let object = Object::parse(fixture).unwrap();
        let identity = object.identity().unwrap();
        object.check_hashes().unwrap();
        for (name, hash) in identity.interface_hashes {
            assert_eq!(
                identity.closure_hashes[&name].as_deref(),
                Some(hash.as_str())
            );
            hashes.insert(name, hash);
        }
        envelopes.extend(identity.envelopes.into_values());
    }
    for (name, expected) in [
        (
            "inc8",
            "8ce5e64f15830d8e596ba9b4861def6565dd567b5804300f427d8b9566d5be93",
        ),
        (
            "zero",
            "7002ed5ea010907a0ae99065663f22fb7d18ca1d6cb171fed57e2594bd9367e6",
        ),
        (
            "sum",
            "74f110bbafde68a4785025e7e571ef871ddd83a09465ab9c1604f653a0cfcd92",
        ),
        (
            "sum_db",
            "68225d213c44812fe844cd295d8821127c3cf31682be4eb19303cb53f9b147f7",
        ),
    ] {
        assert_eq!(hashes[name], expected);
    }
    let mut count = 0;
    for block in spec.split("```\n").skip(1) {
        if block.starts_with("isa=0.8\n") {
            let envelope = block.split("```").next().unwrap();
            assert!(
                envelopes.iter().any(|e| e == envelope),
                "printed envelope differs byte-for-byte"
            );
            count += 1;
        }
    }
    assert_eq!(count, 2);
}

#[test]
fn object_hash_excludes_only_the_three_nonsemantic_sections() {
    let raw = include_str!("fixtures/inc8.bisa");
    let base = Object::parse(raw).unwrap().identity().unwrap();
    let annotated = format!("{raw}\nsection coverage\n{{\"entries\":[]}}\n");
    let after = Object::parse(&annotated).unwrap().identity().unwrap();
    assert_eq!(base.object_hash, sha256_hex(raw.as_bytes()));
    assert_eq!(base.object_hash, after.object_hash);
    assert!(
        Object::parse(&raw.replace("lift.const.i8 1", "lift.const.i8 2"))
            .unwrap()
            .check_hashes()
            .is_err()
    );
}

#[test]
fn reference_order_and_self_scc_are_observable() {
    let raw = include_str!("fixtures/sum_db.bisa");
    let base = Object::parse(raw).unwrap().identity().unwrap();
    let env = &base.envelopes["sum"];
    assert!(env.contains("lift.call @$0"));
    assert_eq!(
        base.interface_hashes["sum"],
        sha256_hex(format!("{}:0", sha256_hex(env.as_bytes())).as_bytes())
    );
    let shifted = Object::parse(&raw.replace("\"base\":16,\"image\"", "\"base\":17,\"image\""))
        .unwrap()
        .identity()
        .unwrap();
    assert_ne!(
        base.interface_hashes["sum"],
        shifted.interface_hashes["sum"]
    );
    assert_ne!(
        base.interface_hashes["sum_db"],
        shifted.interface_hashes["sum_db"]
    );
    assert_eq!(
        base.interface_hashes["zero"],
        shifted.interface_hashes["zero"]
    );
}

fn unmodelled_effect_is_hashable_and_keeps_its_fault_semantics() {

    assert!(identity.envelopes["g"].contains("device clock {\"version\":\"0.8\"}\n"));

#[test]
fn mutual_scc_hashing_and_canonical_lproc_member_order() {
    use bennett_isa_ref::{Budget, OracleInput};
    let o = Object::parse(include_str!("fixtures/mutual.bisa")).unwrap();
    let id = o.identity().unwrap();
    assert!(
        id.interface_hashes["f"] > id.interface_hashes["g"],
        "fixture must expose sorting by member hashes"
    );
    let digest = sha256_hex(format!("{}{}", id.envelopes["f"], id.envelopes["g"]).as_bytes());
    assert_eq!(
        id.interface_hashes["f"],
        sha256_hex(format!("{digest}:0").as_bytes())
    );
    assert_eq!(
        id.interface_hashes["g"],
        sha256_hex(format!("{digest}:1").as_bytes())
    );
    assert!(id.envelopes["f"].contains("lift.call @$1"));
    assert!(id.envelopes["g"].contains("lift.call @$0"));
    let r = o
        .run_oracle(
            "main",
            &OracleInput::bits(&[]),
            Budget {
                steps: 20,
                heap: 0,
                stack: 32,
                depth: 8,
            },
        )
        .unwrap();
    assert_eq!((r.payload, r.code), (4, 0));
}

#[test]
fn council_r4_mutual_scc_has_independent_literal_envelopes() {
    // §9.2: f < g bytewise; headers are definitions, calls are references;
    // lprocs without lift.addr globals have NO layout leaves or part-(6) lines.
    let f = concat!(
        "isa=0.8\nptr_width=16\n",
        "{\"abi\":\"0.8\",\"kind\":\"lproc\",\"params\":[],\"result\":16,\"tier\":\"q\"}\n",
        "lproc @f () (r:reg[16]) () () ()\n^entry():\nr = lift.call @$1 ()\nlift.ret r\n"
    );
    let g = concat!(
        "isa=0.8\nptr_width=16\n",
        "{\"abi\":\"0.8\",\"kind\":\"lproc\",\"params\":[],\"result\":16,\"tier\":\"q\"}\n",
        "lproc @g () (r:reg[16]) () () ()\nregs { p:reg[1] }\n^entry():\n",
        "p = lift.const.i1 1\nqbranch p ^done ^recurse\n^done():\nr = lift.label ^entry\nlift.ret r\n",
        "^recurse():\nr = lift.call @$0 ()\nlift.ret r\n"
    );
    let digest = sha256_hex(format!("{f}{g}").as_bytes());
    let id = Object::parse(include_str!("fixtures/mutual.bisa"))
        .unwrap()
        .identity()
        .unwrap();
    assert_eq!(id.envelopes["f"], f);
    assert_eq!(id.envelopes["g"], g);
    assert_eq!(id.scc_members["f"], ["f", "g"]);
    assert_eq!(id.scc_hashes["f"], digest);
    assert_eq!(
        sha256_hex(format!("{digest}:0").as_bytes()),
        "e4028cf7347c2779e19c8193ef1039837944acebd4784e9c3a42fbe236e737ec"
    );
    assert_eq!(
        sha256_hex(format!("{digest}:1").as_bytes()),
        "7dc9c25aff5230a46ae697edf187d34ba72a03f7a3c1a520c6fc6bf5462c6374"
    );
    assert_eq!(
        id.interface_hashes["f"],
        sha256_hex(format!("{digest}:0").as_bytes())
    );
    assert_eq!(
        id.interface_hashes["g"],
        sha256_hex(format!("{digest}:1").as_bytes())
    );
}

#[test]
fn council_r4_cc_envelope_includes_service_but_not_unused_model() {
    // §4.8: effect is R-only, hostcall CC-only. A CC envelope includes its
    // service but not an unused declared model; both cannot be used directly.
    let raw = support::object(
        &[("mix", r#"{"abi":"0.8","kind":"cc","params":["ptr","i32"],"results":[],"tier":"cc"}"#,
        "fn cc @mix (p:ptr, n:i32) () () () ()\n^entry():\nr = hostcall a.service p n\nret")], "{}",
        "\nsection devices\n{\"models\":{\"clock\":{\"version\":\"0.8\"}},\"services\":{\"a.service\":{\"version\":\"1\"}}}\n\nsection layout\n{\"A_tab\":0,\"H\":0,\"S_cells\":0,\"globals\":{},\"heap_base\":1,\"heap_limit_max\":0,\"interface_regions\":{},\"null_size\":1,\"ptr_width\":32}\n"
    );
    let expected = concat!(
        "isa=0.8\nptr_width=32\n",
        "{\"abi\":\"0.8\",\"kind\":\"cc\",\"params\":[\"ptr\",\"i32\"],\"results\":[],\"tier\":\"cc\"}\n",
        "fn cc @mix (p:ptr, n:i32) () () () ()\n^entry():\nr = hostcall a.service p n\nret\n",
        "layout A_tab 0\nlayout H 0\nlayout S_cells 0\nlayout heap_base 1\nlayout heap_limit_max 0\nlayout null_size 1\nlayout ptr_width 32\n",
        "device a.service {\"version\":\"1\"}\n"
    );
    let id = Object::parse(&raw).unwrap().identity().unwrap();
    assert_eq!(id.envelopes["mix"], expected);
    assert_eq!(id.interface_hashes["mix"], sha256_hex(expected.as_bytes()));
}

fn r11_oracle_layout_ownership_uses_exact_names() {

        "isa=0.8\nptr_width=32\n",

        "oracle @a (x:wire in) (t:wire) (f:wire[4]) () ()\n^entry():\nlift.retval x\n",

#[test]
fn r11_dotted_oracle_layout_ownership() {
    let expected = concat!(
        "isa=0.8\nptr_width=32\n",
        "{\"abi\":\"0.8\",\"args\":[],\"fault\":4,\"in\":[8],\"kind\":\"oracle\",\"mem\":[{\"A\":0,\"W\":8,\"role\":\"in\"}],\"tgt\":8,\"tier\":\"q\"}\n",
        "oracle @a (x:wire[8] in) (t:wire[8]) (f:wire[4]) (db:region[0,8] in) ()\n^entry():\nlift.retval x\n",
        "layout A_tab 1\nlayout H 8\nlayout S_cells 0\nlayout heap_base 128\nlayout heap_limit_max 0\n",
        "layout interface_regions.a.db {\"base\":16}\nlayout null_size 1\nlayout ptr_width 32\n"
    );
    assert_eq!(
        sha256_hex(expected.as_bytes()),
        "4671ca551ee57390d7f69d362e83180a1f3b29a3b8d2f45e2cd80962c6692aec"
    );
    for tag in ["codex-layout-32", "codex-layout-48"] {
        let o = Object::parse(&support::r11_text(tag)).unwrap();
        assert_eq!(o.identity().unwrap().envelopes["a"], expected);
        let o = support::r11_pin(tag);
        let mut input = bennett_isa_ref::OracleInput::bits(&[7]);
        input.regions.insert("db".into(), vec![0]);
        let result = o
            .run_oracle("a", &input, bennett_isa_ref::Budget::steps(1))
            .unwrap();
        assert_eq!((result.payload, result.code, result.steps), (7, 0, 1));
    }
    let changed = support::r11_text("codex-layout-32").replace("\"base\":16", "\"base\":17");
    assert_ne!(
        Object::parse(&changed)
            .unwrap()
            .identity()
            .unwrap()
            .interface_hashes["a"],
        sha256_hex(expected.as_bytes())
    );
}

#[test]
fn r11_dotted_owner_and_region_family() {
    for owner in ["a", "a.b", "a.b.c"] {
        let mut envelopes = vec![];
        for base in [32, 48] {
            let tag = format!("deep-{owner}-{base}");
            let o = support::r11_pin(&tag);
            envelopes.push(o.identity().unwrap().envelopes[owner].clone());
            let changed = support::r11_text(&tag).replace("\"base\":16", "\"base\":17");
            assert_ne!(
                Object::parse(&changed)
                    .unwrap()
                    .identity()
                    .unwrap()
                    .envelopes[owner],
                envelopes[0]
            );
        }
        assert_eq!(envelopes[0], envelopes[1]);
    }
}

#[test]
fn r12_cc_r_colliding_dotted_leaves() {

    let expected = concat!(

        "fn cc @main () () () () ()\n^entry():\nret\n",

#[test]
fn r12_dotted_leaf_collision_family() {
    for owner in ["a", "a.b", "a.b.c"] {
        for tier in ["cc", "r"] {
            let mut ids = vec![];
            for (b1, b2) in [(16, 16), (16, 32), (32, 16), (17, 32), (16, 33)] {
                let o = support::r12_pin(&format!("family-{owner}-{tier}-{b1}-{b2}"));
                let id = o.identity().unwrap();
                let lines: Vec<_> = id.envelopes["main"]
                    .lines()
                    .filter(|l| l.starts_with("layout interface_regions."))
                    .collect();
                assert_eq!(
                    lines,
                    [
                        format!("layout interface_regions.{owner}.c.db {{\"base\":{b1}}}"),
                        format!("layout interface_regions.{owner}.c.db {{\"base\":{b2}}}")
                    ]
                );
                ids.push(id);
            }
            for changed in [3, 4] {
                assert_ne!(
                    ids[1].interface_hashes["main"],
                    ids[changed].interface_hashes["main"]
                );
            }
            assert_eq!(ids[1].envelopes[owner], ids[4].envelopes[owner]);
            assert_eq!(
                ids[1].envelopes[&format!("{owner}.c")],
                ids[3].envelopes[&format!("{owner}.c")]
            );
        }
    }
}

#[test]
fn r12_dotted_global_lproc_keeps_exact_closure_selection() {
    let raw = include_str!("fixtures/sum_db.bisa").replace("zero", "global.with.dots");
    let o = Object::parse(&raw).unwrap();
    let id = o.identity().unwrap();
    let env = &id.envelopes["sum"];
    assert!(env.contains(
        "layout globals.global.with.dots {\"base\":16,\"image\":\"global.with.dots\",\"size\":1}\n"
    ));
    assert!(env.contains("data global.with.dots 00\n"));
    assert_eq!(env.lines().filter(|s| s.starts_with("layout ")).count(), 1);
    let changed = Object::parse(&raw.replace("\"base\":4096", "\"base\":4095"))
        .unwrap()
        .identity()
        .unwrap();
    assert_eq!(env, &changed.envelopes["sum"]);
    assert!(!id.envelopes["global.with.dots"].contains("layout "));
    let actions = Object::parse(include_str!("fixtures/actions.bisa"))
        .unwrap()
        .identity()
        .unwrap();
    assert!(actions
        .envelopes
        .values()
        .all(|env| !env.contains("layout ")));
}

#[test]
fn r12_interface_address_is_not_a_function_dependency() {
    let expected = concat!(
        "isa=0.8\nptr_width=32\n",
        "{\"abi\":\"0.8\",\"args\":[],\"fault\":4,\"in\":[],\"kind\":\"oracle\",\"mem\":[{\"A\":0,\"W\":8,\"role\":\"in\"}],\"tgt\":32,\"tier\":\"q\"}\n",
        "oracle @o () (t:wire[32]) (f:wire[4]) (o:region[0,8] in) ()\n",
        "regs { p:reg[32] }\n^entry():\np = lift.addr @o\nlift.retval p\n",
        "layout A_tab 0\nlayout H 6\nlayout S_cells 0\nlayout heap_base 48\nlayout heap_limit_max 0\n",
        "layout interface_regions.o.o {\"base\":16}\nlayout null_size 1\nlayout ptr_width 32\n"
    );
    for region in ["o", "db"] {
        let c = support::r12_address_case(region);
        let expected = expected
            .replace("(o:region", &format!("({region}:region"))
            .replace("lift.addr @o", &format!("lift.addr @{region}"))
            .replace(
                "interface_regions.o.o ",
                &format!("interface_regions.o.{region} "),
            );
        assert_eq!(
            sha256_hex(expected.as_bytes()),
            c.get("hash").unwrap().string().unwrap()
        );
        let o = Object::parse(&support::r12_address_text(region)).unwrap();
        let id = o.identity().unwrap();
        assert_eq!(id.envelopes["o"], expected);
        assert_eq!(
            id.interface_hashes["o"],
            c.get("hash").unwrap().string().unwrap()
        );
        assert_eq!(
            id.closure_hashes["o"].as_deref(),
            Some(c.get("hash").unwrap().string().unwrap())
        );
        assert_eq!(
            id.object_hash,
            c.get("object_hash").unwrap().string().unwrap()
        );
        // No false recursive ":0" hashing or part-(6) dependency line.
        assert_eq!(id.interface_hashes["o"], id.scc_hashes["o"]);
        o.check_hashes().unwrap();
    }
}

#[test]
fn r12_interface_symbol_kind_family() {
    let mut count = 0;
    for kind in [
        "cc",
        "r",
        "oracle",
        "lproc",
        "action",
        "perm_action",
        "data",
    ] {
        for imported in ["False", "True"] {
            let c = support::r12_address_case(&format!("family-{kind}-{imported}"));
            let o = Object::parse(c.get("text").unwrap().string().unwrap()).unwrap();
            let id = o.identity().unwrap();
            assert_eq!(
                id.envelopes["o"],
                c.get("envelope").unwrap().string().unwrap()
            );
            assert_eq!(
                id.interface_hashes["o"],

            );
            assert_eq!(
                id.closure_hashes["o"].as_deref(),
                Some(c.get("hash").unwrap().string().unwrap())
            );
            o.check_hashes().unwrap();
            count += 1;
        }
    }
    assert_eq!(count, 14);
}

#[test]
fn r12_call_operand_stays_a_dependency_beside_local_address() {
    let mut hashes = vec![];
    for value in [0, 1] {
        let c = support::r12_address_case(&format!("call-{value}"));
        let o = Object::parse(c.get("text").unwrap().string().unwrap()).unwrap();
        let id = o.identity().unwrap();
        let env = &id.envelopes["o"];
        assert_eq!(env, c.get("envelope").unwrap().string().unwrap());
        assert!(env.contains("p = lift.addr @alias\n"));
        assert!(env.contains(&format!(
            "r = lift.call @{} ()\n",
            id.interface_hashes["alias"]
        )));
        assert_eq!(env.lines().last().unwrap(), id.interface_hashes["alias"]);
        assert_eq!(
            id.interface_hashes["o"],
            c.get("hash").unwrap().string().unwrap()
        );
        assert_eq!(
            id.closure_hashes["o"].as_deref(),
            Some(c.get("hash").unwrap().string().unwrap())
        );
        o.check_hashes().unwrap();
        hashes.push(id.interface_hashes["o"].clone());
    }
    assert_ne!(hashes[0], hashes[1]);
}

#[test]
fn r12_global_and_qregion_operands_remain_symbol_references() {
    for (tag, name) in [("global", "o"), ("image", "a")] {
        let c = support::r12_address_case(tag);
        let o = Object::parse(c.get("text").unwrap().string().unwrap()).unwrap();
        let id = o.identity().unwrap();
        assert_eq!(
            id.envelopes[name],
            c.get("envelope").unwrap().string().unwrap()
        );
        assert_eq!(
            id.interface_hashes[name],
            c.get("hash").unwrap().string().unwrap()
        );
        assert_eq!(
            id.closure_hashes[name].as_deref(),
            Some(c.get("hash").unwrap().string().unwrap())
        );
        assert_eq!(
            id.envelopes[name].lines().last().unwrap(),
            id.interface_hashes["alias"]
        );
        o.check_hashes().unwrap();
        if tag == "global" {
            let mut input = bennett_isa_ref::OracleInput::bits(&[]);
            input.regions.insert("db".into(), vec![0]);
            let r = o
                .run_oracle("o", &input, bennett_isa_ref::Budget::steps(2))
                .unwrap();
            assert_eq!((r.payload, r.code, r.steps), (24, 0, 2));
        }
    }
}

#[test]
fn r13_spec_limitation_cross_object_dotted_leaf_collision() {
    // Recorded ISA 0.8 defect, NOT a desired identity property: INV-4 proof
    // step 1.5.3 / SPEC-QUESTIONS 31. Tie ordering preserves leaves within one
    // object, but dotted serialization loses components across different objects.
    // Keep §9.2 as written; a 0.9 contract change must replace this limitation.
    let cases = support::json(include_str!("support/r13_spec_limitation_cases.json"));
    for pair in cases.array().unwrap().as_chunks::<2>().0 {
        let mut ids = Vec::new();
        let mut layouts = Vec::new();
        for c in pair {
            let o = Object::parse(c.get("object").unwrap().string().unwrap()).unwrap();
            o.check_hashes().unwrap();
            let id = o.identity().unwrap();
            let pin = c.get("interface_hash").unwrap().string().unwrap();
            assert_eq!(
                id.envelopes["main"],
                c.get("envelope").unwrap().string().unwrap()
            );
            assert_eq!(id.interface_hashes["main"], pin);
            assert_eq!(id.closure_hashes["main"].as_deref(), Some(pin));
            assert_eq!(
                id.object_hash,
                c.get("object_hash").unwrap().string().unwrap()
            );
            assert_eq!(
                id.envelopes["main"]
                    .lines()
                    .filter(|s| s.starts_with("layout interface_regions."))
                    .collect::<Vec<_>>(),
                [r#"layout interface_regions.a.c.db {"base":32}"#]
            );
            layouts.push(o.section("layout").unwrap().clone());
            ids.push(id);
        }
        assert_ne!(layouts[0], layouts[1], "distinct structured closure sets");
        assert_ne!(
            ids[0].object_hash, ids[1].object_hash,
            "objects stay distinct"
        );
        assert_eq!(
            ids[0].envelopes["main"], ids[1].envelopes["main"],
            "recorded spec limitation"
        );
        assert_eq!(
            ids[0].interface_hashes["main"],
            ids[1].interface_hashes["main"]
        );
        assert_eq!(ids[0].closure_hashes["main"], ids[1].closure_hashes["main"]);
    }
}

mod support;
use bennett_isa_ref::{sha256_hex, Budget, Object, OracleInput};
use support::{object, rehash};
const SIG: &str =
    r#"{"abi":"0.8","args":[],"fault":4,"in":[8],"kind":"oracle","mem":[],"tgt":8,"tier":"q"}"#;
const PROC: &str = r#"{"abi":"0.8","kind":"lproc","params":[8],"result":8,"tier":"q"}"#;
const CC: &str = r#"{"abi":"0.8","kind":"r","params":["i8"],"results":["i8"],"tier":"r"}"#;
const LAYOUT:&str="\nsection layout\n{\"A_tab\":0,\"H\":8,\"S_cells\":4,\"globals\":{},\"heap_base\":16,\"heap_limit_max\":0,\"interface_regions\":{},\"null_size\":1,\"ptr_width\":32}\n";
fn library() -> Object {
    rehash(&object(&[("inc",PROC,"lproc @inc (x:reg[8]) (r:reg[8]) () () ()\nregs { one:reg[8] }\n^entry():\none = lift.const.i8 1\nr = lift.add x one\nlift.ret r")],"{}",LAYOUT))
}
fn client(pin: Option<&str>) -> String {
    let pin = pin
        .map(|h| format!(",\"pinned_closure_hash\":\"{h}\""))
        .unwrap_or_default();
    let imports = format!("{{\"inc\":{{\"signature\":{PROC}{pin}}}}}");
    object(&[("main",SIG,"oracle @main (x:wire[8] in) (t:wire[8]) (f:wire[4]) () ()\nregs { r:reg[8] }\n^entry():\nr = lift.call @inc (x)\nlift.retval r")],&imports,LAYOUT)
}
#[test]
fn unresolved_lproc_has_fingerprint_and_no_executable_closure() {
    let o = rehash(&client(None));
    let identity = o.identity().unwrap();
    let mut bytes = b"inc\0".to_vec();
    bytes.extend(PROC.as_bytes());
    let fingerprint = sha256_hex(&bytes);
    assert!(identity.envelopes["main"].contains(&format!("lift.call @{fingerprint} (x)")));
    assert_eq!(identity.closure_hashes["main"], None);
    assert!(o
        .run_oracle(
            "main",
            &OracleInput::bits(&[2]),
            Budget {
                steps: 20,
                heap: 0,
                stack: 16,
                depth: 8
            }
        )
        .is_err());
}
#[test]
fn link_resolves_calls_and_pins_and_deduplicates() {
    let lib = library();
    let pin = lib.identity().unwrap().closure_hashes["inc"]
        .clone()
        .unwrap();
    let c = rehash(&client(Some(&pin)));
    let linked = Object::link(&[c, lib.clone(), lib]).unwrap();
    linked.check_hashes().unwrap();
    assert!(linked.section("imports").is_none());
    assert_eq!(linked.functions.len(), 2);
    let result = linked
        .run_oracle(
            "main",
            &OracleInput::bits(&[255]),
            Budget {
                steps: 6,
                heap: 0,
                stack: 16,
                depth: 8,
            },
        )
        .unwrap();
    assert_eq!((result.payload, result.code, result.steps), (0, 0, 5));
}
#[test]
fn link_rejects_unresolved_signature_pin_definition_and_layout_conflicts() {
    let lib = library();
    for c in [
        client(Some(&"0".repeat(64))),
        client(None).replace("\"params\":[8]", "\"params\":[16]"),
    ] {
        let error = match Object::parse(&c) {
            Ok(c) => Object::link(&[rehash(&c.text), lib.clone()]).unwrap_err(),
            Err(e) => e,
        };
        assert!(
            error.to_string().contains("§9.3") || error.to_string().contains("§3.3"),
            "{error}"
        );
    }
    assert!(Object::link(&[rehash(&client(None))]).is_err());
    let changed = rehash(&lib.text.replace("lift.const.i8 1", "lift.const.i8 2"));
    assert!(Object::link(&[lib.clone(), changed]).is_err());
    let changed = rehash(&lib.text.replace("\"null_size\":1", "\"null_size\":2"));
    assert!(Object::link(&[lib, changed]).is_err());
}
#[test]
fn classical_and_region_import_signatures_are_validated() {
    let imports = format!("{{\"f\":{{\"signature\":{CC}}}}}");
    let raw = object(
        &[(
            "caller",
            CC,
            "fn r @caller (x:i8) (r:i8) () () ()\n^entry():\nr = call @f x\nret r",
        )],
        &imports,
        "",
    );
    assert!(Object::parse(&raw).is_ok());
    let action_sig = r#"{"abi":"0.8","args":[],"bounds":[],"in":[],"kind":"perm_action","mem":[],"mut":[8],"tier":"q"}"#;
    let imports = format!("{{\"f\":{{\"signature\":{action_sig}}}}}");
    let raw=object(&[("caller",action_sig,"perm_action @caller (x:wire[8] mut) () () () ()\n^entry():\naction_call @f (x) () () ()")],&imports,"");
    assert!(Object::parse(&raw).is_ok());
    let malformed = raw.replace("\"mut\":[8]", "\"mut\":[0]");
    assert!(Object::parse(&malformed).is_err());
}

#[test]
fn imported_quantum_region_image_resolves_by_data_signature() {
    let signature = r#"{"abi":"0.8","args":[],"bounds":[],"in":[],"kind":"perm_action","mem":[],"mut":[1],"tier":"q"}"#;
    let imports = r#"{"image":{"signature":{"abi":"0.8","kind":"data","size":1,"tier":"-"}}}"#;
    let caller = rehash(&object(
        &[(
            "a",
            signature,
            "perm_action @a (t:wire mut) () () () ()\n^entry():\nqregion r 0 8 @image",
        )],
        imports,
        "",
    ));
    let text=format!("bennett-object isa=0.8 object=0.8 launch=0.8 sched=0.8 cert=0.8 coverage=0.8 target=0.8 ptr_width=32\n\nsection symbols\n{{\"0\":{{\"interface_hash\":\"{}\",\"kind\":\"data\",\"name\":\"image\",\"signature\":{{\"abi\":\"0.8\",\"kind\":\"data\",\"size\":1,\"tier\":\"-\"}}}}}}\n\nsection data\nimage ff\n","0".repeat(64));
    let linked = Object::link(&[caller, rehash(&text)]).unwrap();
    linked.check_hashes().unwrap();
    let mut q = bennett_isa_ref::QuantumState::new();
    let t = q.allocate(1).unwrap();
    let mut binding = bennett_isa_ref::QuantumBindings::default();
    binding.bundles.insert("t".into(), t.clone());
    linked
        .execute_action("a", &mut q, &binding, false, &[])
        .unwrap();
    assert_eq!(q.read_basis(&t).unwrap(), 0);
}

mod support;
use bennett_isa_ref::{json::Json, Object};
use support::json;

const INC: &str = include_str!("fixtures/inc8.bisa");
const HASH: &str = "8ce5e64f15830d8e596ba9b4861def6565dd567b5804300f427d8b9566d5be93";
fn schedule() -> Json {
    json(&format!(
        r#"{{"bindings":{{"budget":[3,0,0,0],"closure_hash":"{HASH}","epsilon":0,"expansion":{{"hash":"{}","name":"ref","version":"0.8"}},"inherited_controls":0,"params_hash":"{}","region":"inc8","scheduler":{{"name":"test","version":"1"}},"target_hash":"{}","variant":"forward"}},"entries":[]}}"#,
        "1".repeat(64),
        "2".repeat(64),
        "3".repeat(64)
    ))
}
fn with(section: &str, value: &Json) -> String {
    format!("{INC}\nsection {section}\n{}\n", value.canonical())
}
fn set(value: &mut Json, key: &str, next: Json) {
    let Json::Object(fields) = value else {
        panic!("object")
    };
    fields.insert(key.into(), next);
}
fn reject(value: &Json, section: &str, rule: &str) {
    let e = match Object::parse(&with(section, value)) {
        Err(e) => e,
        Ok(_) => panic!("malformed {section} accepted"),
    };
    assert!(e.to_string().contains(rule), "{e}");
}
fn entry(point: &str, iteration: &str) -> Json {
    json(&format!(
        r#"{{"generated":"*","kind":"gate","path":[{{"iteration":{iteration},"point":"{point}","symbol":"{HASH}"}}],"phase":"fwd","step":1,"gate":{{"epsilon_share":0,"realisation":"native"}}}}"#
    ))
}
#[test]
fn schedule_requires_typed_bindings_selectors_and_unique_maxima() {
    Object::parse(&with("schedule", &schedule())).unwrap();
    for (key, value) in [
        ("closure_hash", json("\"bad\"")),
        ("inherited_controls", json("-1")),
        ("budget", json("[3,-1,0,0]")),
        ("epsilon", json("-0.1")),
    ] {
        let mut s = schedule();
        let Json::Object(fields) = &mut s else {
            unreachable!()
        };
        set(fields.get_mut("bindings").unwrap(), key, value);
        reject(&s, "schedule", "§11");
    }
    let mut s = schedule();
    let Json::Object(fields) = &mut s else {
        unreachable!()
    };
    let Json::Object(bindings) = fields.get_mut("bindings").unwrap() else {
        unreachable!()
    };
    bindings.remove("expansion");
    Object::parse(&with("schedule", &s))
        .unwrap()
        .check_hashes()
        .unwrap();
    for (key, value) in [
        ("phase", json("\"backwards\"")),
        ("step", json("0")),
        ("generated", json("-1")),
        (
            "gate",
            json(r#"{"epsilon_share":-1,"realisation":"native"}"#),
        ),
    ] {
        let mut e = entry("entry:0", "[]");
        set(&mut e, key, value);
        let mut s = schedule();
        set(&mut s, "entries", Json::Array(vec![e]));
        reject(&s, "schedule", "§11");
    }
    let e = entry("entry:0", "[]");
    let mut s = schedule();
    set(&mut s, "entries", Json::Array(vec![e.clone(), e]));
    reject(&s, "schedule", "§11");

fn region_mut(c: &mut Json) -> &mut Json {

#[test]
fn r15_translation_frame_cardinality_is_checked_at_admission() {
    use support::r15::*;
    // The exact reviewer negative remains rejected after moving the rule
    // into the grammar. A two-point control preserves every identity pin.
    for len in 0..=3 {
        let point = format!(r#"["{IH}","entry",0]"#);
        let frame = format!("[{}]", vec![point; len].join(","));
        let text = FRAME.replace(r#""frame":[]"#, &format!(r#""frame":{frame}"#));
        assert!(FRAME.contains(r#""frame":[]"#));
        if len == 2 {
            let o = Object::parse(&text).unwrap();
            o.check_hashes().unwrap();
            assert_eq!(o.identity().unwrap().object_hash, OH);
        } else {
            let e = Object::parse(&text).unwrap_err();
            assert!(e.to_string().contains("§12.1"), "{e}");
        }
    }
}

#[test]
fn r15_oracle_schedule_epsilon_uses_exact_decimal_value() {
    use support::r15::*;
    assert_eq!(schedule(json(r#""0.0""#)), EPSILON);
    assert_eq!(
        bennett_isa_ref::sha256_hex(EPSILON.as_bytes()),
        "1431a1dbbe4991d170e3848995026610ebbffce08e7279ee05a68880f06c82df"
    );
    for epsilon in zeros() {
        let o = Object::parse(&schedule(epsilon.clone()))
            .unwrap_or_else(|e| panic!("zero {}: {e}", epsilon.canonical()));
        o.check_hashes().unwrap();
        let id = o.identity().unwrap();
        assert_eq!(id.object_hash, OH);
        assert_eq!(id.interface_hashes["inc8"], IH);
        assert_eq!(id.closure_hashes["inc8"].as_deref(), Some(IH));
    }
    for epsilon in nonzeros() {
        let e = Object::parse(&schedule(epsilon)).unwrap_err();
        assert!(e.to_string().contains("§5.2"), "{e}");
    }
    // The string exponent form is outside §9.1's decimal-string grammar.
    let e = Object::parse(&schedule(json(r#""1e-300""#))).unwrap_err();
    assert!(e.to_string().contains("§9.1"), "{e}");
}

#[test]
fn r16_schedule_consumer_resolves_default_and_preserves_explicit_binding() {
    use support::r16::*;
    // §17 item 7: absence is ref at the object's ISA version, not a made-up pin.
    let o = Object::parse(DEFAULT).unwrap();
    let binding = o.schedule_expansion().unwrap().unwrap();
    assert_eq!(
        (binding.name, binding.version, binding.hash),
        ("ref", "0.8", None)
    );
    // Resolution must leave the canonical schedule and its identity untouched.
    assert_eq!(
        bennett_isa_ref::sha256_hex(o.section("schedule").unwrap().canonical().as_bytes()),
        SH
    );
    for (name, version) in [("ref", "0.8"), ("vendor", "2026.10")] {
        let descriptor = json(&format!(
            r#"{{"name":"{name}","version":"{version}","hash":"{}"}}"#,
            "a".repeat(64)
        ));
        let text = expansion(descriptor);
        let o = Object::parse(&text).unwrap();
        let binding = o.schedule_expansion().unwrap().unwrap();
        assert_eq!((binding.name, binding.version), (name, version));
        assert_eq!(
            binding.hash,
            Some("aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa")
        );
        o.check_hashes().unwrap();
    }
    assert!(Object::parse(INC)
        .unwrap()
        .schedule_expansion()
        .unwrap()
        .is_none());
}

#[test]
fn r17_shadowed_tie_all_orders_and_genuine_maximum_ties() {
    use support::r17::*;
    let mut s = schedule(TIE);
    let entries = s.get("entries").unwrap().array().unwrap().to_vec();
    let operation = json(&format!(
        r#"{{"path":[{{"symbol":"{HASH}","point":"entry:0","iteration":[]}}],"step":1,"phase":"fwd","generated":0}}"#
    ));
    for order in [
        [0, 1, 2],
        [0, 2, 1],
        [1, 0, 2],
        [1, 2, 0],
        [2, 0, 1],
        [2, 1, 0],
    ] {
        set(
            &mut s,
            "entries",
            Json::Array(order.map(|i| entries[i].clone()).to_vec()),
        );
        let o = Object::parse(&document(TIE, &s)).unwrap();
        o.check_hashes().unwrap();
        assert_eq!(
            o.resolve_schedule(&operation, "cleanup").unwrap(),
            Some(&entries[2])
        );
    }
    for indices in [vec![0, 1], vec![0, 1, 2, 2]] {
        set(
            &mut s,
            "entries",
            Json::Array(indices.iter().map(|i| entries[*i].clone()).collect()),
        );
        let e = Object::parse(&document(TIE, &s)).unwrap_err();
        assert!(e.to_string().contains("multiple maximal"), "{e}");
    }
    set(
        &mut s,
        "entries",
        Json::Array(vec![entries[0].clone(), entries[2].clone()]),
    );
    Object::parse(&document(TIE, &s))
        .unwrap()
        .check_hashes()
        .unwrap();
}

#[test]
fn r17_specificity_lattice_family_matches_brute_force() {
    // An independent oracle enumerates concrete operations, and computes the
    // literal §11 lexicographic maximum. No production overlap/domain helpers.
    fn score(e: &Json) -> (usize, usize, bool, bool, bool) {
        let path = e.get("path").unwrap().array().unwrap();
        let specific = |v: &Json| v != &json(r#""*""#);
        (
            path.len(),
            path.iter()
                .filter(|p| specific(p.get("iteration").unwrap()))
                .count(),
            specific(e.get("step").unwrap()),
            specific(e.get("phase").unwrap()),
            specific(e.get("generated").unwrap()),
        )
    }
    fn matches(e: &Json, op: &Json) -> bool {
        let ep = e.get("path").unwrap().array().unwrap();
        let opath = op.get("path").unwrap().array().unwrap();
        ep.len() <= opath.len()
            && ep.iter().zip(opath).all(|(a, b)| {
                ["symbol", "point"]
                    .iter()
                    .all(|k| a.get(k).unwrap() == b.get(k).unwrap())
                    && (a.get("iteration").unwrap() == &json(r#""*""#)
                        || a.get("iteration").unwrap() == b.get("iteration").unwrap())
            })
            && ["step", "phase", "generated"].iter().all(|k| {
                e.get(k).unwrap() == &json(r#""*""#) || e.get(k).unwrap() == op.get(k).unwrap()
            })
    }
    let mut seed = 0x1718_cafe_u64;
    let mut draw = |n: u64| {
        seed ^= seed << 13;
        seed ^= seed >> 7;
        seed ^= seed << 17;
        seed % n
    };
    let mut cases = 0;
    let mut admitted = 0;
    for count in 2..=4 {
        for _ in 0..400 {
            let mut entries = Vec::new();
            for _ in 0..count {
                let mut e = entry(
                    &format!("entry:{}", draw(3)),
                    if draw(2) == 0 { "[]" } else { r#""*""# },
                );
                if draw(4) == 0 {
                    set(&mut e, "path", json("[]"));
                }
                for key in ["step", "phase", "generated"] {
                    let value = match draw(3) {
                        0 => json(r#""*""#),
                        n if key == "phase" => json(if n == 1 { r#""fwd""# } else { r#""rev""# }),
                        n => Json::Number((if key == "step" { n } else { n - 1 }).to_string()),
                    };
                    set(&mut e, key, value);
                }
                entries.push(e);
            }
            // 2 specific generated ordinals + one residual; likewise all three
            // budget steps, both phases, and all three root program points.
            let mut concrete = Vec::new();
            for point in 0..3 {
                for step in 1..=3 {
                    for phase in ["fwd", "rev"] {
                        for generated in 0..=2 {
                            concrete.push(json(&format!(r#"{{"path":[{{"symbol":"{HASH}","point":"entry:{point}","iteration":[]}}],"step":{step},"phase":"{phase}","generated":{generated}}}"#)));
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
            let winners: Vec<_> = concrete
                .iter()
                .map(|op| {
                    let matching: Vec<_> = entries
                        .iter()
                        .enumerate()
                        .filter(|(_, e)| matches(e, op))
                        .collect();
                    let best = matching.iter().map(|(_, e)| score(e)).max();
                    matching
                        .into_iter()
                        .filter(|(_, e)| Some(score(e)) == best)
                        .map(|(i, _)| i)
                        .collect::<Vec<_>>()
                })
                .collect();
            let ambiguous = winners.iter().any(|w| w.len() > 1);
            let mut s = schedule();
            set(&mut s, "entries", Json::Array(entries.clone()));
            let parsed = Object::parse(&with("schedule", &s));
            assert_eq!(
                parsed.is_err(),
                ambiguous,
                "case {cases}: {}",
                s.canonical()
            );
            if let Ok(o) = parsed {
                admitted += 1;
                for (op, w) in concrete.iter().zip(&winners) {
                    assert_eq!(
                        o.resolve_schedule(op, "gate").unwrap(),
                        w.first().map(|i| &entries[*i])
                    );
                }
            }
            // Document order independence includes rejected cases.
            entries.reverse();
            set(&mut s, "entries", Json::Array(entries));
            assert_eq!(Object::parse(&with("schedule", &s)).is_err(), ambiguous);
            cases += 1;
        }
    }
    assert_eq!(cases, 1200);
    eprintln!("R17 specificity family: {cases} schedules + reversed orders, {admitted} admitted, {} rejected; 54 concrete operations each; oracle agreement 100%", cases - admitted);
}

#[test]
fn r17_union_coverage_partial_coverage_and_budget_domains() {
    let mut a = entry("entry:0", r#""*""#);
    set(&mut a, "phase", json(r#""*""#));
    let b = a.clone();
    let mut fwd = a.clone();
    set(&mut fwd, "phase", json(r#""fwd""#));
    let mut rev = a.clone();
    set(&mut rev, "phase", json(r#""rev""#));
    let mut s = schedule();
    for (entries, valid) in [
        (vec![a.clone(), b.clone(), fwd.clone(), rev], true),
        (vec![a.clone(), b.clone(), fwd], false),
    ] {
        set(&mut s, "entries", Json::Array(entries));
        assert_eq!(Object::parse(&with("schedule", &s)).is_ok(), valid);
    }
    // step 4 lies outside the oracle's 1..B domain: no matchable maximum tie.
    set(&mut a, "step", json("4"));
    set(&mut s, "entries", Json::Array(vec![a.clone(), a]));
    Object::parse(&with("schedule", &s)).unwrap();
}

#[test]
fn r17_equal_share_consumer_keeps_exact_and_explicit_assignments() {
    use bennett_isa_ref::ScheduleEpsilonShare;
    let op = json(&format!(
        r#"{{"path":[{{"symbol":"{HASH}","point":"entry:0","iteration":[]}}],"step":1,"phase":"fwd","generated":0}}"#
    ));
    let o = Object::parse(support::r17::EPS).unwrap();
    let epsilon = o
        .section("schedule")
        .unwrap()
        .get("bindings")
        .unwrap()
        .get("epsilon")
        .unwrap();
    for n in [1, 3, 1000] {
        assert_eq!(
            o.schedule_epsilon_share(&op, false, n).unwrap(),
            Some(ScheduleEpsilonShare::EqualShare {
                epsilon,
                operations: n
            })
        );
    }
    assert!(o.schedule_epsilon_share(&op, false, 0).is_err());
    assert_eq!(
        o.schedule_epsilon_share(&op, true, 0).unwrap(),
        Some(ScheduleEpsilonShare::Exact)
    );
    let o = Object::parse(&support::r17::gate(json(
        r#"{"realisation":"native","epsilon_share":"0.125"}"#,
    )))
    .unwrap();
    let supplied = json(r#""0.125""#);
    assert_eq!(
        o.schedule_epsilon_share(&op, false, 3).unwrap(),
        Some(ScheduleEpsilonShare::Assigned(&supplied))
    );
    assert_eq!(
        o.schedule_epsilon_share(&op, true, 3).unwrap(),
        Some(ScheduleEpsilonShare::Exact)
    );
    let o = Object::parse(INC).unwrap();
    assert_eq!(o.schedule_epsilon_share(&op, false, 3).unwrap(), None);
}

#[test]
fn r17_loop_iteration_union_and_empty_domains() {
    for (bound, valid) in [(0, true), (2, true), (3, false), (1u64 << 40, false)] {
        let sig = r#"{"abi":"0.8","args":[],"bounds":[],"in":[],"kind":"perm_action","mem":[],"mut":[1],"tier":"q"}"#.replace("\"bounds\":[]", &format!("\"bounds\":[{bound}]"));
        let body = format!(
            "perm_action @a (t:wire mut) () () () ()\nregs {{  }} bounds {{{bound}}}\n^entry():\nqloop {bound} {{\nx t\nx t\n}}"
        );
        let o = support::rehash(&support::object(&[("a", &sig, &body)], "{}", ""));
        let hash = &o.identity().unwrap().interface_hashes["a"];
        let mut a = entry("entry:1", r#""*""#);
        let Json::Object(fields) = &mut a else {
            unreachable!()
        };
        let Json::Array(path) = fields.get_mut("path").unwrap() else {
            unreachable!()
        };
        set(&mut path[0], "symbol", Json::String(hash.clone()));
        let mut c = a.clone();
        let mut d = a.clone();
        for (e, iteration) in [(&mut c, 0), (&mut d, 1)] {
            let Json::Object(fields) = e else {
                unreachable!()
            };
            let Json::Array(path) = fields.get_mut("path").unwrap() else {
                unreachable!()
            };
            set(&mut path[0], "iteration", json(&format!("[{iteration}]")));
        }
        let entries = if bound == 0 {
            vec![a.clone(), a]
        } else {
            vec![a.clone(), a, c, d]
        };
        let mut s = schedule();
        let Json::Object(fields) = &mut s else {
            unreachable!()
        };
        let bindings = fields.get_mut("bindings").unwrap();
        set(bindings, "region", json(r#""a""#));
        set(bindings, "closure_hash", Json::String(hash.clone()));
        set(&mut s, "entries", Json::Array(entries));
        let text = format!("{}\nsection schedule\n{}\n", o.text, s.canonical());
        assert_eq!(Object::parse(&text).is_ok(), valid, "loop {bound}");
    }
}

#[test]
fn r18_literal_nested_budget_ties_defer_until_run() {
    use bennett_isa_ref::{Argument, Budget, OracleInput};
    for (root, source) in [(2, support::r18::TWO), (3, support::r18::THREE)] {
        let o = Object::parse(source).expect("token budgets are unknown at admission");
        o.check_hashes().unwrap();
        assert_eq!(o.identity().unwrap().object_hash, support::r18::OH);
        let mut input = OracleInput::bits(&[8]);
        input.args.push(Argument::Token(Budget::steps(3)));
        let e = o
            .run_oracle("ignore", &input, Budget::steps(root))
            .unwrap_err();
        assert!(
            e.to_string()
                .contains("§11: multiple maximal matching schedule entries"),
            "{e}"
        );
        assert!(
            bennett_isa_ref::OracleMachine::new(&o, "ignore", &input, Budget::steps(root))
                .err()
                .unwrap()
                .to_string()
                .contains("§11: multiple maximal")
        );
        input.args[0] = Argument::Token(Budget::steps(2));
        let r = o.run_oracle("ignore", &input, Budget::steps(root)).unwrap();
        assert_eq!((r.payload, r.code, r.steps), (0, 0, 2));
    }
    // Root-owned ties remain exact at admission, independent of the unknown
    // nested token: step 3 is outside B=2 and inside B=3.
    for (root, source) in [(2, support::r18::TWO), (3, support::r18::THREE)] {
        let mut s = support::r17::schedule(source);
        let mut a = s.get("entries").unwrap().array().unwrap()[0].clone();
        let path = a.get("path").unwrap().array().unwrap()[..1].to_vec();
        set(&mut a, "path", Json::Array(path));
        set(&mut s, "entries", Json::Array(vec![a.clone(), a]));
        assert_eq!(
            Object::parse(&support::r17::document(source, &s)).is_err(),
            root == 3
        );
    }
}

#[test]
fn r18_single_and_shadowed_nested_entries_preserve_identity_and_resolve_all_orders() {
    use support::{
        r17::{document, schedule},
        r18::*,
    };
    let mut s = schedule(TWO);
    let literal = s.get("entries").unwrap().array().unwrap()[0].clone();
    let mut op = literal.clone();
    set(&mut op, "generated", json("0")); // review probe's concrete operation
    set(&mut s, "entries", Json::Array(vec![literal.clone()]));
    let o = Object::parse(&document(TWO, &s)).unwrap();
    o.check_hashes().unwrap();
    assert_eq!(o.identity().unwrap().object_hash, OH);
    assert_eq!(
        o.identity().unwrap().closure_hashes["ignore"].as_deref(),
        Some(IH)
    );
    assert_eq!(o.resolve_schedule(&op, "gate").unwrap(), Some(&literal));
    // Literal duplicates are fully specific except generated="*"; one more
    // generated ordinal cannot cover that entire domain. Broaden iterations
    // for A/B; the literal C then genuinely covers their tie on ALL ordinals.
    let mut broad = literal.clone();
    let mut path = broad.get("path").unwrap().array().unwrap().to_vec();
    for p in &mut path {
        set(p, "iteration", json(r#""*""#));
    }
    set(&mut broad, "path", Json::Array(path));
    let entries = [broad.clone(), broad, literal.clone()];
    for order in ORDERS {
        set(
            &mut s,
            "entries",
            Json::Array(order.map(|i| entries[i].clone()).to_vec()),
        );
        let o = Object::parse(&document(TWO, &s)).unwrap();
        o.check_hashes().unwrap();
        assert_eq!(o.identity().unwrap().object_hash, OH);
        for g in [0, 1, u128::MAX] {
            set(&mut op, "generated", Json::Number(g.to_string()));
            assert_eq!(o.resolve_schedule(&op, "gate").unwrap(), Some(&literal));
        }
    }
}

#[test]
fn r18_lproc_action_root_and_prefix_domain_controls() {
    use support::r18::*;
    for (edges, action) in [
        (vec!['L'], false),
        (vec!['O', 'L'], false),
        (vec!['O'], true),
    ] {
        let o = chain(&edges, action);
        let hashes = o.identity().unwrap().interface_hashes;
        let path: Vec<_> = (0..=edges.len())
            .map(|i| {
                point(
                    &hashes[&format!("n{i}")],
                    if i == edges.len() { 2 } else { 0 },
                )
            })
            .collect();
        let mut s = support::r18::schedule(&o, 2, &[3]);
        let e = gate(&path, json("3"));
        set(&mut s, "entries", Json::Array(vec![e.clone(), e]));
        let parsed = Object::parse(&document(&o, &s)).unwrap();
        let budget = bennett_isa_ref::Budget {
            steps: 2,
            heap: 0,
            stack: 256,
            depth: 16,
        };
        let args: Vec<_> = edges
            .iter()
            .filter(|&&edge| edge == 'O')
            .map(|_| {
                bennett_isa_ref::Argument::Token(bennett_isa_ref::Budget { steps: 3, ..budget })
            })
            .collect();
        if action {
            let mut q = bennett_isa_ref::QuantumState::new();
            let mut bindings = bennett_isa_ref::QuantumBindings::default();
            for (name, width) in [("t", 8), ("f", 4), ("x", 8)] {
                bindings
                    .bundles
                    .insert(name.into(), q.allocate(width).unwrap());
            }
            bindings.args.insert("tk0".into(), args[0].clone());
            let before = q.clone();
            let e = parsed
                .execute_action("n0", &mut q, &bindings, false, &[])
                .unwrap_err();
            assert!(e.to_string().contains("§11: multiple maximal"));
            assert_eq!(
                q, before,
                "schedule tie must reject before any action realisation"
            );
        }
        let bound = parsed.check_schedule_matches_for_run("n0", budget, &args);
        if edges == ['L'] {
            bound.unwrap();
        } else {
            assert!(bound
                .unwrap_err()
                .to_string()
                .contains("§11: multiple maximal"));
        }
    }
    // A prefix is not confined to the root's domain when it matches nested
    // operations. Covers for root steps 1,2 leave nested step 3 uncovered.
    let o = chain(&['O'], false);
    let mut s = support::r18::schedule(&o, 2, &[3]);
    let a = gate(&[], json(r#""*""#));
    let entries = vec![a.clone(), a, gate(&[], json("1")), gate(&[], json("2"))];
    set(&mut s, "entries", Json::Array(entries));
    let parsed = Object::parse(&document(&o, &s)).unwrap();
    let budget = bennett_isa_ref::Budget {
        steps: 2,
        heap: 0,
        stack: 256,
        depth: 16,
    };
    let args = [bennett_isa_ref::Argument::Token(bennett_isa_ref::Budget {
        steps: 3,
        ..budget
    })];
    assert!(parsed
        .check_schedule_matches_for_run("n0", budget, &args)
        .unwrap_err()
        .to_string()
        .contains("§11: multiple maximal"));
    // Root B=0 has no nested invocation; no token preimage is inferred.
    let mut bindings = s.get("bindings").unwrap().clone();
    set(&mut bindings, "budget", json("[0,0,256,16]"));
    set(&mut s, "bindings", bindings);
    Object::parse(&document(&o, &s)).unwrap();
}

#[test]
fn r18_nested_specificity_family_matches_brute_force() {
    use support::r18::*;
    // Derive operations from explicit O/L shapes and concrete budgets BEFORE
    // admission. Every oracle dispatch expands each static row at t=1..B,
    // including gated-off rows; L shares that dispatch, O starts its own.
    // Tokens are not recoverable from params_hash: admission sees only root
    // domains; bound matching and the concrete resolver use EACH actual token
    // assignment, never the union over possible token values (INV-5 1.4.3).
    fn enumerate(edges: &[char], action: bool, hashes: &[String], budgets: &[u64]) -> Vec<Json> {
        let mut out = Vec::new();
        let mut prefix = Vec::new();
        let mut owner = if action { None } else { Some(0) };
        let mut next_token = 1;
        for (depth, symbol) in hashes.iter().enumerate() {
            let bound = owner.map_or(4, |i| budgets[i]);
            if bound == 0 {
                break;
            }
            let points = if depth == 0 && action {
                1
            } else if depth == edges.len() {
                3
            } else {
                2
            };
            for ordinal in 0..points {
                let mut path = prefix.clone();
                path.push(point(symbol, ordinal));
                for t in 1..=bound {
                    for phase in ["fwd", "rev"] {
                        for generated in 0..=2 {
                            let mut op = gate(&path, Json::Number(t.to_string()));
                            set(&mut op, "phase", Json::String(phase.into()));
                            set(&mut op, "generated", Json::Number(generated.to_string()));
                            out.push(op);
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
            if let Some(&edge) = edges.get(depth) {
                prefix.push(point(symbol, 0));
                if edge == 'O' {
                    owner = Some(next_token);
                    next_token += 1;
                }
            }
        }
        out
    }
    let mut seed = 0x1819_cafe_u64;
    let mut draw = |n: u64| {
        seed ^= seed << 13;
        seed ^= seed >> 7;
        seed ^= seed << 17;
        seed % n
    };
    let (mut cases, mut admitted, mut assignments, mut operations) = (0, 0, 0, 0);
    let mut bound_ties = 0;
    for depth in 1..=3 {
        for oracles in 0..=depth {
            let edges: Vec<_> = (0..depth)
                .map(|i| if i < oracles { 'O' } else { 'L' })
                .collect();
            for action in [false, true] {
                if action && oracles == 0 {
                    continue;
                }
                let o = chain(&edges, action);
                let id = o.identity().unwrap();
                let hashes: Vec<_> = (0..=depth)
                    .map(|i| id.interface_hashes[&format!("n{i}")].clone())
                    .collect();
                for root in [0, 1, 2, 4] {
                    assignments += 5usize.pow(oracles as u32);
                    let mut root_budgets = vec![root];
                    root_budgets.extend(vec![0; oracles]);
                    let root_operations = enumerate(&edges, action, &hashes, &root_budgets);
                    // Even with B=0 there are no root oracle operations. Build
                    // selectors independently so empty domains are exercised.
                    let leaf: Vec<_> = (0..=depth)
                        .map(|i| point(&hashes[i], if i == depth { 2 } else { 0 }))
                        .collect();
                    for case in 0..125 {
                        let mut entries = Vec::new();
                        for _ in 0..(2 + draw(3)) {
                            let mut path = leaf[..draw((depth + 2) as u64) as usize].to_vec();
                            for p in &mut path {
                                if draw(2) == 0 {
                                    set(p, "iteration", json(r#""*""#));
                                }
                            }
                            let mut e = gate(
                                &path,
                                if draw(3) == 0 {
                                    json(r#""*""#)
                                } else {
                                    Json::Number((1 + draw(3)).to_string())
                                },
                            );
                            set(
                                &mut e,
                                "phase",
                                json([r#""*""#, r#""fwd""#, r#""rev""#][draw(3) as usize]),
                            );
                            set(
                                &mut e,
                                "generated",
                                if draw(3) == 0 {
                                    json(r#""*""#)
                                } else {
                                    Json::Number(draw(2).to_string())
                                },
                            );
                            entries.push(e);
                        }
                        // Deterministic exact ties, shadowed ties, and UNION
                        // coverage supplement (without replacing) the RNG.
                        if case % 8 == 0 {
                            let a = gate(&leaf, json("3"));
                            entries = vec![a.clone(), a];
                        } else if case % 8 == 1 {
                            let a = gate(&[], json(r#""*""#));
                            entries =
                                vec![a.clone(), a, gate(&[], json("1")), gate(&[], json("2"))];
                        } else if case % 8 == 2 {
                            let mut a = gate(&leaf, json(r#""*""#));
                            set(
                                &mut a,
                                "path",
                                Json::Array(
                                    leaf.iter()
                                        .map(|p| {
                                            let mut p = p.clone();
                                            set(&mut p, "iteration", json(r#""*""#));
                                            p
                                        })
                                        .collect(),
                                ),
                            );
                            entries = vec![a.clone(), a, gate(&leaf, json(r#""*""#))];
                        }
                        let mut encoded = case % 5usize.pow(oracles as u32);
                        let tokens: Vec<_> = (0..oracles)
                            .map(|_| {
                                let value = (encoded % 5) as u64;
                                encoded /= 5;
                                value
                            })
                            .collect();
                        let mut budgets = vec![root];
                        budgets.extend(&tokens);
                        let concrete = enumerate(&edges, action, &hashes, &budgets);
                        operations += concrete.len();
                        let expected: Vec<_> =
                            concrete.iter().map(|op| winners(&entries, op)).collect();
                        let ambiguous = expected.iter().any(|w| w.len() > 1);
                        let root_ambiguous = root_operations
                            .iter()
                            .any(|op| winners(&entries, op).len() > 1);
                        let limits = bennett_isa_ref::Budget {
                            steps: root,
                            heap: 0,
                            stack: 256,
                            depth: 16,
                        };
                        let args: Vec<_> = tokens
                            .iter()
                            .map(|&steps| {
                                bennett_isa_ref::Argument::Token(bennett_isa_ref::Budget {
                                    steps,
                                    ..limits
                                })
                            })
                            .collect();
                        let mut s = support::r18::schedule(&o, root, &tokens);
                        for reverse in [false, true] {
                            let mut ordered = entries.clone();
                            if reverse {
                                ordered.reverse();
                            }
                            set(&mut s, "entries", Json::Array(ordered));
                            let parsed = Object::parse(&document(&o, &s));
                            assert_eq!(parsed.is_err(), root_ambiguous, "edges={edges:?}, action={action}, root={root}, case={case}, reverse={reverse}: {}", s.canonical());
                            if let Ok(parsed) = parsed {
                                if !reverse {
                                    admitted += 1;
                                    if ambiguous {
                                        bound_ties += 1;
                                    }
                                }
                                let bound =
                                    parsed.check_schedule_matches_for_run("n0", limits, &args);
                                assert_eq!(bound.is_err(),ambiguous,"bound edges={edges:?}, action={action}, budgets={budgets:?}, case={case}: {}",s.canonical());
                                if let Err(e) = bound {
                                    assert!(e.to_string().contains("§11: multiple maximal"), "{e}");
                                }
                                for (op, w) in concrete.iter().zip(&expected) {
                                    let resolution = parsed.resolve_schedule(op, "gate");
                                    if w.len() > 1 {
                                        assert!(resolution
                                            .unwrap_err()
                                            .to_string()
                                            .contains("§11: multiple maximal"));
                                    } else {
                                        assert_eq!(
                                            resolution.unwrap(),
                                            w.first().map(|i| &entries[*i])
                                        );
                                    }
                                }
                            } else {
                                assert!(parsed
                                    .unwrap_err()
                                    .to_string()
                                    .contains("§11: multiple maximal"));
                            }
                        }
                        cases += 1;
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }
    assert_eq!(cases, 7500);
    eprintln!("R18 nested family: {cases} schedules + {cases} reversed orders, {admitted} admitted / {} root-rejected, {bound_ties} deferred ties materialise at binding; {assignments} distinct concrete budget assignments, {operations} concrete operations; root admission, actual-budget bound matching and all concrete resolver results: oracle agreement 100%",cases-admitted);
}

#[test]
fn r18_recursive_lproc_keeps_root_budget_without_depth_cap() {
    use support::r18::{document, gate, point, set};
    let o = Object::parse(include_str!("fixtures/sum_db.bisa")).unwrap();
    let id = o.identity().unwrap();
    let mut s = schedule();
    let mut b = s.get("bindings").unwrap().clone();
    set(&mut b, "region", Json::String("sum_db".into()));
    set(
        &mut b,
        "closure_hash",
        Json::String(id.closure_hashes["sum_db"].clone().unwrap()),
    );
    set(&mut b, "budget", json("[2,4080,16,64]"));
    set(&mut s, "bindings", b);
    let a = gate(&[point(&id.interface_hashes["sum_db"], 2)], json("3"));
    set(&mut s, "entries", Json::Array(vec![a.clone(), a]));
    // Exploring extensions must terminate at a call-graph fixpoint; recursive
    // lift.call does not create a token-governed machine or a fresh step range.
    Object::parse(&document(&o, &s)).unwrap();

#[test]
fn r18_bound_tokens_forward_by_parameter_and_zero_ancestor_is_empty() {
    use bennett_isa_ref::{Argument, Budget, OracleInput};
    use support::r18::*;
    let o = chain(&['O', 'O'], false);
    let reversed = o.text.replace(
        "lift.oracle_call @n1 tk0 (x) r fr () (tk0, tk1)",
        "lift.oracle_call @n1 tk0 (x) r fr () (tk1, tk0)",
    );
    assert_ne!(reversed, o.text);
    let swapped = support::rehash(&reversed);
    for (o, tokens, tie) in [
        (&swapped, [4, 2], true),
        (&swapped, [2, 4], false),
        (&o, [0, 4], false),
    ] {
        let id = o.identity().unwrap();
        let path: Vec<_> = (0..=2)
            .map(|i| {
                point(
                    &id.interface_hashes[&format!("n{i}")],
                    if i == 2 { 2 } else { 0 },
                )
            })
            .collect();
        let e = gate(&path, json("3"));
        let mut s = support::r18::schedule(o, 2, &tokens);
        set(&mut s, "entries", Json::Array(vec![e.clone(), e]));
        let parsed = Object::parse(&document(o, &s)).unwrap();
        let limits = Budget {
            steps: 2,
            heap: 0,
            stack: 256,
            depth: 16,
        };
        let mut input = OracleInput::bits(&[8]);
        input.args = tokens
            .map(|steps| Argument::Token(Budget { steps, ..limits }))
            .to_vec();
        let result = parsed.run_oracle("n0", &input, limits);
        assert_eq!(result.is_err(), tie);
        if let Err(e) = result {
            assert!(e.to_string().contains("§11: multiple maximal"));
        }
    }
}

mod support;
use bennett_isa_ref::{Argument, Budget, Object, OracleInput};

#[test]
fn seed_inc8_full_input_domain_and_budget_boundaries() {
    let o = Object::parse(include_str!("fixtures/inc8.bisa")).unwrap();
    for x in 0..256 {
        for b in 0..=4 {
            let r = o
                .run_oracle("inc8", &OracleInput::bits(&[x]), Budget::steps(b))
                .unwrap();
            assert_eq!(
                (r.payload, r.code),
                if b >= 3 { ((x + 1) & 255, 0) } else { (0, 1) },
                "x={x},B={b}"
            );
            assert_eq!(r.steps, b.min(3));
        }
    }
}

#[test]
fn seed_recursive_memory_interface_and_stack_boundaries() {
    let o = Object::parse(include_str!("fixtures/sum_db.bisa")).unwrap();
    // Hand derivation: db[i]=i+1, so n bytes sum to n(n+1)/2.
    for n in 0..24 {
        let mut input = OracleInput::bits(&[n]);
        input.regions.insert("db".into(), (1..=16).collect());
        let budget = Budget {
            steps: 1000,
            heap: 4080,
            stack: 512,
            depth: 64,
        };
        let r = o.run_oracle("sum_db", &input, budget).unwrap();
        assert_eq!(
            (r.payload, r.code),
            if n <= 16 {
                (n * (n + 1) / 2, 0)
            } else {
                (0, 7)
            },
            "n={n}"
        );
        if n <= 16 {
            assert_eq!(r.steps, 14 * n as u64 + 10);
            for stack in [16 * (n + 1), 16 * (n + 1) - 1] {
                let r = o
                    .run_oracle("sum_db", &input, Budget { stack, ..budget })
                    .unwrap();
                assert_eq!(r.code, if stack % 16 == 0 { 0 } else { 3 });
            }
            let r = o
                .run_oracle("sum_db", &input, Budget { depth: n, ..budget })
                .unwrap();
            assert_eq!(r.code, 3);
            let r = o
                .run_oracle(
                    "sum_db",
                    &input,
                    Budget {
                        depth: n + 1,
                        ..budget
                    },
                )
                .unwrap();
            assert_eq!(r.code, 0);
            let r = o
                .run_oracle(
                    "sum_db",
                    &input,
                    Budget {
                        steps: r.steps - 1,
                        ..budget
                    },
                )
                .unwrap();
            assert_eq!(r.code, 1);
        } else {
            assert_eq!(r.steps, 13);
        }
    }
}

        ("ashr", vec![128, 8], (0, 0)),
        ("udiv", vec![255, 2], (127, 0)),
        ("urem", vec![255, 2], (1, 0)),
        ("sdiv", vec![249, 2], (253, 0)),

        ("udiv", vec![3, 0], (0, 5)),

        ("ule", vec![2, 2], (1, 0)),

#[test]
#[ignore = "full 8-bit arithmetic sweep"]
fn exhaustive_unsigned_and_signed_division_u8() {
    let o = Object::parse(include_str!("fixtures/arithmetic.bisa")).unwrap();
    for a in 0..=255u128 {
        for b in 0..=255u128 {
            for name in ["udiv", "urem", "sdiv", "srem"] {
                let r = o
                    .run_oracle(name, &OracleInput::bits(&[a, b]), Budget::steps(2))
                    .unwrap();
                let overflow = name.starts_with('s') && a == 128 && b == 255;
                if b == 0 || overflow {
                    assert_eq!((r.payload, r.code), (0, if b == 0 { 5 } else { 6 }));
                } else {
                    let sa = a as u8 as i8 as i16;
                    let sb = b as u8 as i8 as i16;
                    let expected = match name {
                        "udiv" => a / b,
                        "urem" => a % b,
                        "sdiv" => (sa / sb) as u8 as u128,
                        _ => (sa % sb) as u8 as u128,
                    };
                    assert_eq!((r.payload, r.code), (expected, 0), "{name}({a},{b})");
                }
            }
        }
    }
}
#[test]
fn const_literals_outside_the_destination_range_are_rejected_not_reduced() {
    // SPEC-QUESTIONS 12 (revised): -2^(N-1) <= c < 2^N; reducing 2^128+5 to 5
    // would be the silent truncation §3.3 forbids. Hand check for N = 8:
    // -128 and 255 are the extremes; -129 and 256 are outside.
    for literal in [
        "340282366920938463463374607431768211461",
        "-340282366920938463463374607431768211461",
        "256",
        "-129",
    ] {
        let text = include_str!("fixtures/inc8.bisa")
            .replace("lift.const.i8 1", &format!("lift.const.i8 {literal}"));
        let e = Object::parse(&text).unwrap_err().to_string();
        assert!(e.contains("§3.3"), "{literal}: {e}");
    }
    for (literal, addend) in [("255", 255u128), ("-128", 128), ("-1", 255)] {
        let text = include_str!("fixtures/inc8.bisa")
            .replace("lift.const.i8 1", &format!("lift.const.i8 {literal}"));
        let o = support::rehash(&text);
        for x in [0u128, 1, 127, 128, 255] {
            let r = o
                .run_oracle("inc8", &OracleInput::bits(&[x]), Budget::steps(3))
                .unwrap();
            assert_eq!(
                (r.payload, r.code),
                ((x + addend) & 255, 0),
                "{literal} {x}"
            );
        }
    }
}
