## `tests/parser.rs` (434 lines)

````rust
use bennett_isa_ref::{json::Json, Object};

const INC: &str = include_str!("fixtures/inc8.bisa");
const SUM: &str = include_str!("fixtures/sum_db.bisa");

fn rejects(text: &str, rule: &str) {
    let error = match Object::parse(text) {
        Err(e) => e,
        Ok(_) => panic!("ill-formed object accepted"),
    };
    assert!(error.to_string().contains(rule), "{error} must cite {rule}");
}

#[test]
fn published_objects_parse() {
    let inc = Object::parse(INC).unwrap();
    assert_eq!(inc.ptr_width, 32);
    assert_eq!(inc.functions["inc8"].blocks[0].instructions.len(), 3);
    let sum = Object::parse(SUM).unwrap();
    assert_eq!(sum.functions["sum"].locations().len(), 13);
    assert_eq!(sum.functions["sum"].frame_cells(), 16);
}

#[test]
fn lexical_and_section_errors_cite_rules() {
    for text in [
        INC.replace('\n', "\r\n"),
        INC.replace("lift.add x", "lift.add  x"),
        INC.replace("lift.add x one", "lift.add x one "),
        INC.replace("\n\nsection", "\nsection"),
        INC.replace("^entry():", "\n^entry():"),
    ] {
        rejects(&text, "§16.1");
    }
    rejects(&INC.replace("isa=0.8", "isa=0.9"), "§1");
    rejects(&INC.replace("section symbols", "section unknown"), "§9.1");
    rejects(&format!("{INC}\nsection symbols\n{{}}\n"), "§9.1");
    rejects(&INC.replace("{\"0\":", "{ \"0\":"), "§16.1");
}

#[test]
fn names_widths_opcodes_and_terminators_are_checked() {
    rejects(
        &INC.replace("lift.add x one", "lift.add missing one"),
        "§3.7",
    );
    rejects(&INC.replace("r = lift.add", "x = lift.add"), "§3.7");
    rejects(&INC.replace("r:reg[8]", "r:reg[7]"), "§3.3");
    rejects(
        &INC.replace("one = lift.const.i8 1", "one = lift.magic x"),
        "§4.8",
    );
    rejects(&INC.replace("lift.retval r", "r = lift.mov one"), "§3.6");
    rejects(&INC.replace("lift.retval r", "lift.ret r"), "§4.2");
    rejects(&INC.replace("lift.retval r", "qjump ^missing"), "§3.6");
    rejects(&INC.replace("lift.retval r", "fault 16"), "§3.3");
    rejects(
        &SUM.replace("idx = lift.zext.i32 n2", "idx = lift.trunc.i32 n2"),
        "§3.3",
    );
    rejects(
        &SUM.replace(
            "lift.call @sum (n, acc, base)",
            "lift.call @sum (base, acc, n)",
        ),
        "§3.3",
    );
    rejects(
        &SUM.replace("zp = lift.addr @zero", "zp = lift.addr @db"),
        "§4.2",
    );
    rejects(&SUM.replace("\"base\":4096", "\"base\":16"), "§7.2");
    rejects(&SUM.replace("\"size\":1", "\"size\":2"), "§7.2");
}

#[test]
fn json_is_strict_and_canonical() {
    let raw = r#"{"a":[null,true,false,"\n",-1,1e+30],"z":"é"}"#;
    assert_eq!(Json::parse(raw).unwrap().canonical(), raw);
    for bad in [
        "{\"a\":1,\"a\":2}",
        "[01]",
        "[1.]",
        "[NaN]",
        "[1e999]",
        "\"\u{0001}\"",
        "\"\\ud800\"",
    ] {
        assert!(Json::parse(bad).is_err(), "accepted {bad}");
    }
    assert_eq!(
        Json::parse("[-0,1e-7,1e-6,1e20,1e21]").unwrap().canonical(),
        "[0,1e-7,0.000001,100000000000000000000,1e+21]"
    );
    // RFC 8785 sorts object keys by UTF-16 units: a supplementary character
    // sorts before U+E000, despite its larger Unicode scalar value.
    assert_eq!(
        Json::parse("{\"\u{e000}\":0,\"😀\":1}")
            .unwrap()
            .canonical(),
        "{\"😀\":1,\"\u{e000}\":0}"
    );
}

#[test]
fn empty_hex_data_and_canonical_type_widths() {
    let data=format!("bennett-object isa=0.8 object=0.8 launch=0.8 sched=0.8 cert=0.8 coverage=0.8 target=0.8 ptr_width=32\n\nsection symbols\n{{\"0\":{{\"interface_hash\":\"{}\",\"kind\":\"data\",\"name\":\"empty\",\"signature\":{{\"abi\":\"0.8\",\"kind\":\"data\",\"size\":0,\"tier\":\"-\"}}}}}}\n\nsection data\nempty \n","0".repeat(64));
    assert!(Object::parse(&data).unwrap().data["empty"].is_empty());
    // INT := -?(0|[1-9][0-9]*) (§16.1) governs every width token.
    rejects(&INC.replace("reg[8]", "reg[08]"), "§16.1");
}

#[test]
fn label_width_uses_reachable_closure_not_unrelated_functions() {
    let raw = include_str!("fixtures/arithmetic.bisa");
    let narrow = raw.replace(
        "z:reg[8], p:reg[1], idx:reg[32], r:reg[8]",
        "z:reg[8], p:reg[1], idx:reg[4], r:reg[8]",
    );
    // jump has ten rows, so 2^4 > 10, regardless of other independent oracles.
    let object = Object::parse(&narrow).unwrap();
    let result = object
        .run_oracle(
            "jump",
            &bennett_isa_ref::OracleInput::bits(&[0, 0]),
            bennett_isa_ref::Budget::steps(10),
        )
        .unwrap();
    assert_eq!((result.payload, result.code), (42, 0));
}

#[test]
fn every_operand_uses_canonical_int_float_string_and_index_spellings() {
    let text = include_str!("fixtures/control_flow.bisa");
    for bad in [
        "6.2831853071795860",
        "06.283185307179586",
        "+6.283185307179586",
    ] {
        rejects(&text.replace("6.283185307179586", bad), "§16.1");
    }
    rejects(&INC.replace("lift.const.i8 1", "lift.const.i8 01"), "§16.1");
    assert!(bennett_isa_ref::Type::parse("qreg[02]")
        .unwrap_err()
        .to_string()
        .contains("§16.1"));
    rejects(&text.replace("x t\n}", "cx p[00] t\n}"), "§16.1");
}

#[test]
fn quoted_service_literals_decode_for_binding_execution_and_identity() {
    let raw = include_str!("fixtures/classical.bisa");
    let quoted = raw.replace("hostcall org.bennett.test", "hostcall \"org.bennett.test\"");
    let o = Object::parse(&quoted).unwrap();
    use bennett_isa_ref::{ClassicalMachine, ClassicalValue};
    let mut machine = ClassicalMachine::new(&o, "host", &[], &[]).unwrap();
    assert_eq!(
        machine.run(100).unwrap().request.unwrap().service,
        "org.bennett.test"
    );
    machine.reply(&[7]).unwrap();
    assert_eq!(
        machine.run(100).unwrap().values,
        vec![ClassicalValue::Int(16, 1)]
    );
    o.identity().unwrap();
    // Only the three ISA escapes are available in instruction strings.
    rejects(
        &raw.replace(
            "hostcall org.bennett.test",
            "hostcall \"org\\t.bennett.test\"",
        ),
        "§16.1",
    );
}

#[test]
fn metadata_integers_preserve_exactness_and_canonical_decimal_strings() {
    assert_eq!(
        Json::parse("9007199254740991").unwrap().uint().unwrap(),
        9_007_199_254_740_991
    );
    assert_eq!(
        Json::parse("\"340282366920938463463374607431768211455\"")
            .unwrap()
            .uint()
            .unwrap(),
        u128::MAX
    );
    for bad in ["9007199254740992", "\"01\"", "\"+1\"", "\"-0\"", "\"1.0\""] {
        assert!(Json::parse(bad).unwrap().uint().is_err(), "accepted {bad}");
    }
}

mod support;
#[test]
fn r3_normalized_cc_controls_are_typed_and_disjoint_at_load() {
    let ac = r#"{"abi":"0.8","args":[],"bounds":[],"in":[],"kind":"action","mem":[],"mut":[1],"tier":"q"}"#;
    for (tag, ty, control) in [
        ("integer", "i8", "c"),
        ("token", "token", "c"),
        ("unknown", "qreg[1]", "missing"),
        ("multiwire", "qreg[2]", "c"),
        ("alias", "qreg[1]", "q"),
    ] {
        let cc = format!(
            r#"{{"abi":"0.8","kind":"cc","params":["{ty}","qreg[1]"],"results":[],"tier":"cc"}}"#
        );
        let text = support::object(&[("a",ac,"action @a (t:wire mut) () () () ()\n^entry():\nx t"),("p",&cc,&format!("fn cc @p (c:{ty}, q:qreg[1]) () () () ()\n^entry():\nctl {control} action_call @a (q) () () ()\nret"))],"{}", "");
        support::reject_cli(&text, "§3.3", &format!("cc-ctl-{tag}"));

#[test]
fn r10_function_header_prefix_matches_kind() {
    let failures: Vec<_> = support::r10_bad_headers()
        .iter()
        .enumerate()
        .filter_map(|(n, text)| {
            let result = Object::parse(text).err().map(|e| e.to_string());
            println!("header {n}: {result:?}");
            (!result.is_some_and(|e| e.contains("§16.2"))).then_some(n)
        })
        .collect();
    assert!(
        failures.is_empty(),
        "headers without §16.2 rejection: {failures:?}"
    );
}

    support::r10_pin("omitted-bounds");
}
#[test]
fn r10_exact_fhead_and_nonempty_optional_productions() {
    let failures: Vec<_> = ["fn-oracle", "inc-empty-bounds", "empty-lhs"]
        .into_iter()
        .filter(|tag| {
            let result = Object::parse(&support::r10_text(tag))
                .err()
                .map(|e| e.to_string());
            println!("{tag}: {result:?}");
            !result.is_some_and(|e| e.contains("§16.2"))
        })
        .collect();
    assert!(failures.is_empty(), "{failures:?}");
    rejects(
        &support::r10_text("cc").replace("\nret\n", "\n() = ret\n"),
        "§16.2",
    );
    // Nonempty tuple LHS and empty operand lists remain legal.
    Object::parse(&INC.replace("r = lift.add", "(r) = lift.add")).unwrap();
    for tag in ["cc", "r", "omitted-bounds"] {
        support::r10_pin(tag);
    }
    let sig = r#"{"abi":"0.8","args":[],"bounds":[1],"in":[],"kind":"action","mem":[],"mut":[1],"tier":"q"}"#;
    Object::parse(&support::object(&[("a",sig,"action @a (t:wire mut) () () () ()\nregs {  } bounds {1}\n^entry():\nqloop 1 {\nx t\n}")],"{}","")).unwrap();

    for kind in ["action", "perm_action"] {

            rejects(
                &text
                    .replace("action", kind)
                    .replace("cx d t", &format!("cx {operand} t")),

#[test]
fn r11_action_regs_cannot_invent_angles() {
    rejects(&support::r11_text("angle"), "§3.3");
    support::r11_pin("argument");
    // Named angles must be an f64 argument, never a wire, region or token.
    let text = support::r11_text("argument");
    for ty in ["i64", "ptr", "token"] {
        rejects(
            &text
                .replace("angle:f64", &format!("angle:{ty}"))
                .replace(r#""args":["f64"]"#, &format!(r#""args":["{ty}"]"#)),
            "§3.3",
        );
    }
    rejects(&text.replace("rx angle t", "rx missing t"), "§3.3");
    support::r10_pin("one-trip");
    support::r11_pin("producer");
}

#[test]
fn r11_register_types_follow_function_kind() {
    let mut accepted = 0;
    let mut rejected = 0;
    for kind in ["cc", "r", "oracle", "lproc", "action", "perm_action"] {
        let (sig, head, row, tail) = match kind {
            "cc" | "r" => (format!(r#"{{"abi":"0.8","kind":"{kind}","params":[],"results":[],"tier":"{kind}"}}"#),
                format!("fn {kind} @a () () () () ()"), "ret", ""),
            "oracle" => (r#"{"abi":"0.8","args":[],"fault":4,"in":[1],"kind":"oracle","mem":[],"tgt":1,"tier":"q"}"#.into(),
                "oracle @a (x:wire in) (t:wire) (f:wire[4]) () ()".into(), "lift.retval x", ""),
            "lproc" => (r#"{"abi":"0.8","kind":"lproc","params":[1],"result":1,"tier":"q"}"#.into(),
                "lproc @a (x:reg[1]) (r:reg[1]) () () ()".into(), "lift.ret x",
                r#"
section layout
{"A_tab":0,"H":1,"S_cells":0,"globals":{},"heap_base":1,"heap_limit_max":0,"interface_regions":{},"null_size":1,"ptr_width":32}
"#),
            _ => (format!(r#"{{"abi":"0.8","args":[],"bounds":[],"in":[],"kind":"{kind}","mem":[],"mut":[1],"tier":"q"}}"#),
                format!("{kind} @a (t:wire mut) () () () ()"), "x t", ""),
        };
        for ty in [
            "reg[1]",
            "wire",
            "wire[2]",
            "f64",
            "i8",
            "ptr",
            "token",
            "qreg[1]",
            "region[0,8]",
        ] {
            let body = format!(
                "{head}
regs {{ d:{ty} }}
^entry():
{row}
"
            );
            let text = support::object(&[("a", &sig, &body)], "{}", tail);
            if matches!(kind, "oracle" | "lproc") && ty == "reg[1]" {
                Object::parse(&text).unwrap();
                accepted += 1;
            } else {
                rejects(&text, "§3.3");
                rejected += 1;
            }
        }
        let text = support::object(
            &[(
                "a",
                &sig,
                &format!(
                    "{head}
regs {{  }}
^entry():
{row}
"
                ),
            )],
            "{}",
            tail,
        );
        Object::parse(&text).unwrap();
        accepted += 1;
    }
    assert_eq!((accepted, rejected), (8, 52));
    eprintln!("R11 regs family: {accepted} accepted / {rejected} rejected");
}

#[test]
fn r13_block_image_schema_is_checked_without_a_layout_consumer() {
    let bad = support::r13_text("block-number");
    for v in [
        "42",
        "null",
        "true",
        "{}",
        "[]",
        r#""""#,
        r#""missing""#,
        r#""not-a-name""#,
    ] {
        let text = bad.replace(r#""block_image":42"#, &format!(r#""block_image":{v}"#));
        let e = Object::parse(&text).unwrap_err();
        assert!(e.to_string().contains("§9.1"), "{e}");
    }
    for case in ["block-absent", "block-disk"] {
        support::r13_check(case, "a");
    }
    // Complete sectors are a load-time invariant too, even for action-only objects.
    let disk = support::r13_text("block-disk");
    let short = disk
        .replace(&format!("disk {}", "00".repeat(512)), "disk 00")
        .replace(r#""size":512"#, r#""size":1"#);
    let e = Object::parse(&short).unwrap_err();
    assert!(e.to_string().contains("§7.3"), "{e}");
}

#[test]
fn r13_classical_missing_block_image_never_panics() {
    let signature = r#"{"abi":"0.8","kind":"r","params":[],"results":[],"tier":"r"}"#;
    let layout = support::r13_text("block-missing")
        .split("section layout\n")
        .nth(1)
        .unwrap()
        .to_string();
    let text = support::object(
        &[(
            "main",
            signature,
            "fn r @main () () () () ()\n^entry():\nret",
        )],
        "{}",
        &format!("\nsection layout\n{layout}"),
    );
    assert!(Object::parse(&text)
        .unwrap_err()
        .to_string()
        .contains("§9.1"));
    // Object is publicly mutable; constructors must guard against post-load damage.
    let mut o = Object::parse(&support::object(
        &[(
            "main",
            signature,
            "fn r @main () () () () ()\n^entry():\nret",
        )],
        "{}",
        "",
    ))
    .unwrap();
    o.metadata
        .insert("layout".into(), support::json(layout.trim()));
    let result =
        std::panic::catch_unwind(|| bennett_isa_ref::ClassicalMachine::new(&o, "main", &[], &[]));
    let e = result
        .expect("constructor must not unwind")
        .err()
        .expect("missing image error");
    assert!(e.to_string().contains("§9.1"), "{e}");
}
````

````rust
use bennett_isa_ref::{Complex, Object, QuantumBindings, QuantumState};

fn close(a: Complex, b: Complex) {
    assert!(
        (a.re - b.re).abs() < 1e-12 && (a.im - b.im).abs() < 1e-12,
        "{a:?} != {b:?}"
    );
}
#[test]
fn bell_state_born_branches_and_adjoint() {
    let mut q = QuantumState::new();
    let wires = q.allocate(2).unwrap();
    q.gate("h", &[wires[0]], None, &[]).unwrap();
    q.gate("cx", &wires, None, &[]).unwrap();
    let a = q.amplitudes().unwrap();
    let h = std::f64::consts::FRAC_1_SQRT_2;
    close(a[0], Complex::new(h, 0.0));
    close(a[3], Complex::new(h, 0.0));
    close(a[1], Complex::ZERO);
    close(a[2], Complex::ZERO);
    let branches = q.measurement_branches(&wires).unwrap();
    assert_eq!(branches.len(), 2);
    for b in branches {
        assert!((b.probability - 0.5).abs() < 1e-12);
        assert_eq!(b.bits[0], b.bits[1]);
        assert_eq!(b.state.wire_count(), 0);
    }
    q.gate("cx", &wires, None, &[]).unwrap();
    q.gate("h", &[wires[0]], None, &[]).unwrap();
    q.release(&wires).unwrap();
    assert_eq!(q.wire_count(), 0);
}
#[test]
fn every_gate_and_controlled_global_phase() {
    for (op, n, angle, inverse) in [
        ("x", 1, None, "x"),
        ("h", 1, None, "h"),
        ("s", 1, None, "sdg"),
        ("t", 1, None, "tdg"),
        ("rx", 1, Some(0.7), "rx"),
        ("ry", 1, Some(-0.2), "ry"),
        ("rz", 1, Some(1.1), "rz"),
        ("cx", 2, None, "cx"),
        ("ccx", 3, None, "ccx"),
        ("swap", 2, None, "swap"),
        ("cz", 2, None, "cz"),
    ] {
        let mut q = QuantumState::new();
        let w = q.allocate(n + 1).unwrap();
        for wire in &w {
            q.gate("h", &[*wire], None, &[]).unwrap();
        }
        let before = q.amplitudes().unwrap();
        q.gate(op, &w[..n], angle, &[w[n]]).unwrap();
        q.gate(inverse, &w[..n], angle.map(|x| -x), &[w[n]])
            .unwrap();
        for (a, b) in q.amplitudes().unwrap().into_iter().zip(before) {
            close(a, b);
        }
    }
    // TAU is a rounded binary64 angle. The enabled phase is near -1, but
    // interference retains a strictly nonzero residual branch (§3.1/§4.4).
    let mut q = QuantumState::new();
    let w = q.allocate(2).unwrap();
    q.gate("h", &[w[0]], None, &[]).unwrap();
    q.gate("rz", &[w[1]], Some(std::f64::consts::TAU), &[w[0]])
        .unwrap();
    q.gate("h", &[w[0]], None, &[]).unwrap();
    assert_eq!(q.exact_support().len(), 2);
    assert!(q.read_basis(&[w[0]]).is_err());
    close(q.amplitudes().unwrap()[1], Complex::new(1.0, 0.0));
}
#[test]
fn permutation_fast_path_and_clean_release() {
    let mut q = QuantumState::new();
    let w = q.allocate(100).unwrap();
    q.gate("x", &[w[99]], None, &[]).unwrap();
    q.gate("mcx", &[w[99], w[3]], None, &[]).unwrap();
    assert!(q.is_basis());
    assert_eq!(q.read_basis(&[w[3]]).unwrap(), 1);
    assert!(q.release(&w).is_err());
    q.gate("mcx", &[w[99], w[3]], None, &[]).unwrap();
    q.gate("x", &[w[99]], None, &[]).unwrap();
    q.release(&w).unwrap();
}

fn actions_copy_cleanup_quantum_memory_loops_and_adjoint() {
    let o = Object::parse(include_str!("fixtures/actions.bisa")).unwrap();
    for name in ["flip", "memory", "loop", "bell"] {
        let mut q = QuantumState::new();
        let t = q.allocate(2).unwrap();
        let p = q.allocate(2).unwrap();
        q.gate("x", &[p[0]], None, &[]).unwrap();
        let mut b = QuantumBindings::default();
        b.bundles.insert("t".into(), t.clone());
        b.bundles.insert("p".into(), p.clone());
        let before = q.amplitudes().unwrap();
        o.execute_action(name, &mut q, &b, false, &[]).unwrap();
        o.execute_action(name, &mut q, &b, true, &[]).unwrap();

#[test]
fn lifted_permutation_calls_use_the_action_and_its_adjoint() {
    use bennett_isa_ref::{Budget, OracleInput, OracleMachine};
    let o = Object::parse(include_str!("fixtures/actions.bisa")).unwrap();
    for x in 0..4 {
        let input = OracleInput::bits(&[x]);
        let budget = Budget::steps(5);
        let result = o.run_oracle("lifted", &input, budget).unwrap();
        assert_eq!((result.payload, result.code), (x ^ 1, 0));
        let mut m = OracleMachine::new(&o, "lifted", &input, budget).unwrap();
        let before = m.snapshot();
        for _ in 0..5 {
            m.forward_step().unwrap();
        }
        assert_eq!(m.outcome().unwrap(), result);
        for _ in 0..5 {
            m.inverse_step().unwrap();
        }
        assert_eq!(m.snapshot(), before);
    }
}

#[test]
fn wide_structured_bundles_are_not_limited_to_integer_widths() {
    let signature = r#"{"abi":"0.8","args":[],"bounds":[],"in":[256],"kind":"perm_action","mem":[],"mut":[256],"tier":"q"}"#;
    let text=format!("bennett-object isa=0.8 object=0.8 launch=0.8 sched=0.8 cert=0.8 coverage=0.8 target=0.8 ptr_width=32\n\nsection symbols\n{{\"0\":{{\"interface_hash\":\"{}\",\"kind\":\"perm_action\",\"name\":\"wide\",\"signature\":{signature}}}}}\n\nsection functions\nperm_action @wide (t:wire[256] mut) (p:wire[256] in) () () ()\n^entry():\nd = qcopy p\nqxor d t\nquncopy p d\n","0".repeat(64));
    let object = Object::parse(&text).unwrap();
    let mut q = QuantumState::new();
    let t = q.allocate(256).unwrap();
    let p = q.allocate(256).unwrap();
    q.gate("x", &[p[255]], None, &[]).unwrap();
    let mut b = QuantumBindings::default();
    b.bundles.insert("t".into(), t.clone());
    b.bundles.insert("p".into(), p);
    object
        .execute_action("wide", &mut q, &b, false, &[])
        .unwrap();
    assert_eq!(q.read_basis(&[t[0], t[128], t[255]]).unwrap(), 4);
    assert_eq!(q.wire_count(), 512);

        .execute_action("wide", &mut q, &b, true, &[])
        .unwrap();
    assert_eq!(q.read_basis(&[t[255]]).unwrap(), 0);
}

#[test]
fn sol_r4_b01_tiny_projection_preserves_entangled_residual_and_second_born_weights() {
    // The rare branch of Rx(theta)|1> is correlated with a residual Bell pair.
    // Its conditional state has two equal finite amplitudes, and measuring
    // one Bell wire subsequently has probabilities 1/2,1/2, despite the
    // unnormalised exact shadow having a norm below binary64 range.
    for angle in [1e-162, 1e-200, f64::from_bits(1)] {
        let mut q = QuantumState::new();
        let w = q.allocate(3).unwrap();
        q.gate("x", &[w[0]], None, &[]).unwrap();
        q.gate("rx", &[w[0]], Some(angle), &[]).unwrap();
        q.gate("h", &[w[1]], None, &[]).unwrap();
        q.gate("cx", &[w[1], w[2]], None, &[]).unwrap();
        // Entangle the measured system with the residual pair (odd parity on
        // the common branch, even parity on the rare branch).
        q.gate("cx", &[w[0], w[1]], None, &[]).unwrap();
        let first = q.measurement_branches(&[w[0]]).unwrap();
        assert_eq!(first.len(), 2);
        assert_eq!(first[0].bits, [false]);
        let residual = &first[0].state;
        sparse_matches_normalized_dense(residual);
        let amps = residual.amplitudes().unwrap();
        assert!(amps.iter().all(|a| a.re.is_finite() && a.im.is_finite()));
        assert!((amps.iter().map(|a| a.re * a.re + a.im * a.im).sum::<f64>() - 1.0).abs() < 1e-12);
        let second = residual.measurement_branches(&[w[1]]).unwrap();
        assert_eq!(second.len(), 2);
        for branch in second {
            sparse_matches_normalized_dense(&branch.state);
            assert!((branch.probability - 0.5).abs() < 1e-12);
            assert_eq!(
                branch.state.read_basis(&[w[2]]).unwrap(),
                u128::from(branch.bits[0])
            );
            let a = branch.state.amplitudes().unwrap();
            assert!((a.iter().map(|z| z.re * z.re + z.im * z.im).sum::<f64>() - 1.0).abs() < 1e-12);
        }
    }
}

#[test]
fn sol_r4_b01_projection_recovers_amplitudes_below_binary64_range() {
    // Two rare independent rotations give amplitude about 2.5e-401 on 00.
    // It still projects to a normalized residual |+>, and applying H cleans it.
    let mut q = QuantumState::new();
    let w = q.allocate(3).unwrap();
    for wire in &w[..2] {
        q.gate("x", &[*wire], None, &[]).unwrap();
        q.gate("rx", &[*wire], Some(1e-200), &[]).unwrap();
    }
    q.gate("h", &[w[2]], None, &[]).unwrap();
    let branches = q.measurement_branches(&w[..2]).unwrap();
    assert_eq!(branches.len(), 4);
    let mut rare = branches[0].state.clone();
    sparse_matches_normalized_dense(&rare);
    for a in rare.amplitudes().unwrap() {
        assert!((a.re.abs() - std::f64::consts::FRAC_1_SQRT_2).abs() < 1e-12);
        assert!(a.im.abs() < 1e-12);
    }
    rare.gate("h", &[w[2]], None, &[]).unwrap();
    assert_eq!(rare.read_basis(&[w[2]]).unwrap(), 0);
    sparse_matches_normalized_dense(&rare);
    rare.release(&[w[2]]).unwrap();
}

mod support;

#[test]
fn sol_r5_b03_consumed_workspace_names_keep_their_own_widths() {
    let exact = "d = qalloc any 1\ncx t d\ncx t d\nqfree d\nd = qalloc any 2\nqfree d";
    let o = support::rehash(&support::borrow_lifetime_object(exact, &[]));
    assert_eq!(
        o.identity().unwrap().interface_hashes["a"],
        "ba05b26390994f78dc6405906f8ecf555075f83b6f2c47da1ffbee78e7afd140"
    );
    assert_eq!(
        o.identity().unwrap().object_hash,
        "1004ce41faf18591bbfa75d3cff461a2c61c0df9f3a89bcac513b3553c223340"
    );
    support::borrow_identity(&o);

    for renamed in [false, true] {
        for nested in [false, true] {
            // Reuse after qcopy, qload, qborrow and qalloc; all consumed
            // lifetimes have their own width, including inverse releases.
            let body = "a = qalloc any 1\nz = qalloc any 2\nd = qcopy t\nquncopy t d\nd = qcopy z\nquncopy z d\nd = qload r a\nqunload r a d\nd = qalloc any 1\ncx t d\ncx t d\nqfree d\nd = qborrow any 2\nx d[1]\nx d[1]\nqreturn d\nd = qborrow any 1\ncx d t\ncx d t\nqreturn d\nqfree z\nqfree a";
            let body = if renamed {
                body.replacen("d = qcopy z\nquncopy z d", "e = qcopy z\nquncopy z e", 1)
                    .replacen(
                        "d = qborrow any 2\nx d[1]\nx d[1]\nqreturn d",
                        "f = qborrow any 2\nx f[1]\nx f[1]\nqreturn f",
                        1,
                    )
            } else {
                body.into()
            };
            let (body, bounds) = if nested {
                (
                    format!("qregion r 1 2\nqloop 2 {{\nqloop 3 {{\n{body}\n}}\n}}"),
                    vec![2, 3],
                )
            } else {
                (format!("qregion r 1 2\n{body}"), vec![])
            };
            let o = support::rehash(&support::borrow_lifetime_object(&body, &bounds));
            for input in 0..10 {
                let mut q = QuantumState::new();
                let w = q.allocate(4).unwrap();
                for (i, wire) in w[..3].iter().enumerate() {
                    if input >= 8 {
                        q.gate("h", &[*wire], None, &[]).unwrap();
                    } else if input >> i & 1 == 1 {
                        q.gate("x", &[*wire], None, &[]).unwrap();
                    }
                }
                if input == 9 {
                    q.gate("cx", &[w[1], w[3]], None, &[]).unwrap();
                }
                let entry = q.clone();
                let mut b = QuantumBindings::default();
                b.bundles.insert("t".into(), vec![w[0]]);
                b.borrowed.push(w[1..3].to_vec());
                for adjoint in [false, true] {
                    o.execute_action("a", &mut q, &b, adjoint, &[]).unwrap();
                    assert_eq!(
                        q, entry,
                        "renamed={renamed}, nested={nested}, input={input}, adj={adjoint}"
                    );
                }
            }
        }
    }
    assert!(Object::parse(&support::borrow_lifetime_object(
        "d = qalloc any 1\nd = qalloc any 2\nqfree d",
        &[]
    ))
    .is_err());
}

fn sparse_matches_normalized_dense(q: &QuantumState) {
    let dense = q.amplitudes().unwrap();
    let sparse = q.exact_support();
    let mut norm = 0.0;
    for (bits, (re, im)) in sparse {
        assert!(re.is_finite() && im.is_finite());
        let index = bits
            .iter()
            .enumerate()
            .fold(0, |x, (i, b)| x | (usize::from(*b) << i));
        close(Complex::new(re, im), dense[index]);
        norm += re * re + im * im;
    }
    assert!((norm - 1.0).abs() < 1e-12, "sparse conditional norm={norm}");
}

#[test]
fn sol_r5_b04_sparse_observer_reports_the_conditional_state() {
    let mut q = QuantumState::new();
    let w = q.allocate(2).unwrap();
    q.gate("h", &[w[0]], None, &[]).unwrap();
    for mut branch in q.measurement_branches(&[w[0]]).unwrap() {
        assert!((branch.probability - 0.5).abs() < 1e-12);
        assert_eq!(
            branch.state.exact_support(),
            vec![(vec![false], (1.0, 0.0))]
        );
        sparse_matches_normalized_dense(&branch.state);
        branch.state.gate("h", &[w[1]], None, &[]).unwrap();
        sparse_matches_normalized_dense(&branch.state);
        for (_, (re, im)) in branch.state.exact_support() {
            close(
                Complex::new(re, im),
                Complex::new(std::f64::consts::FRAC_1_SQRT_2, 0.0),
            );
        }
    }
    // set_state_vector's contract leaves normalization to the caller.
    q.set_state_vector(&[(vec![false, false], Complex::new(2.0, 2.0))])
        .unwrap();
    assert_eq!(q.exact_support(), vec![(vec![false, false], (2.0, 2.0))]);
    q.gate("h", &[w[1]], None, &[]).unwrap();
    let norm: f64 = q
        .exact_support()
        .iter()
        .map(|(_, (r, i))| r * r + i * i)
        .sum();
    assert!((norm - 8.0).abs() < 1e-12);
    // A basis projection also returns its normalized conditional global phase.
    q.gate("h", &[w[1]], None, &[]).unwrap();
    let branch = q.measurement_branches(&[w[0]]).unwrap().remove(0);
    sparse_matches_normalized_dense(&branch.state);
    let mut reset = branch.state;
    reset
        .set_state_vector(&[(vec![false], Complex::new(3.0, 0.0))])
        .unwrap();
    assert_eq!(reset.exact_support(), vec![(vec![false], (3.0, 0.0))]);
}

#[test]
fn codex_r5_bell_projection_diagnostics_are_conditional_amplitudes() {
    let mut q = QuantumState::new();
    let w = q.allocate(2).unwrap();
    q.gate("h", &[w[0]], None, &[]).unwrap();
    q.gate("cx", &[w[0], w[1]], None, &[]).unwrap();
    for (_, (re, im)) in q.exact_support() {
        close(
            Complex::new(re, im),
            Complex::new(std::f64::consts::FRAC_1_SQRT_2, 0.0),
        );
    }
    for branch in q.measurement_branches(&[w[0]]).unwrap() {
        assert!((branch.probability - 0.5).abs() < 1e-12);
        assert_eq!(
            branch.state.exact_support(),
            vec![(vec![branch.bits[0]], (1.0, 0.0))]
        );
        sparse_matches_normalized_dense(&branch.state);
    }
}

#[test]
fn r6_structured_lifetime_variants_match_independent_identity() {
    let mut cases = vec![
        ("d = qalloc any 1\nqloop 0 {\nqloop 2 {\nqfree d\nd = qalloc any 2\n}\n}\nqfree d".into(), vec![0,2]),
        ("d = qalloc any 1\nqloop 2 {\nqloop 0 {\nqfree d\n}\n}\nqfree d".into(), vec![2,0]),
        ("d = qcopy t\nqloop 0 {\nquncopy t d\nd = qcopy t\n}\nquncopy t d".into(), vec![0]),
        ("d = qborrow any 1\nqloop 0 {\nqreturn d\nd = qborrow any 2\n}\nqreturn d".into(), vec![0]),
        ("qregion r 1 2\na = qalloc any 1\nd = qload r a\nqloop 0 {\nqunload r a d\nd = qload r a\n}\nqunload r a d\nqfree a".into(), vec![0]),
        ("d0 = qalloc any 1\nqfree d0\nd1 = qalloc any 2\nx d1[1]\nx d1[1]\nqfree d1\nd2 = qalloc any 2\nx d2[1]\nx d2[1]\nqfree d2".into(), vec![]),
    ];
    for n in [1, 2, 3, 128] {
        for borrow in [false, true] {
            let (alloc, free) = if borrow {
                ("qborrow", "qreturn")
            } else {
                ("qalloc", "qfree")
            };
            cases.push((format!("d = {alloc} any 1\nqloop {n} {{\n{free} d\nd = {alloc} any 2\nx d[1]\nx d[1]\n}}\n{free} d"), vec![n]));
        }
    }
    for (body, bounds) in cases {
        let text = support::borrow_lifetime_object(&body, &bounds);
        let o = Object::parse(&text).unwrap_or_else(|e| panic!("{e}\n{body}"));
        support::r6_map(&o, false);
    }
}

    for _ in 0..5000 {
        q.gate("h", &w, None, &[]).unwrap();
        q.gate("t", &w, None, &[]).unwrap();
    }

    let a = q.amplitudes().unwrap();
    close(a[0], Complex::new(-0.9438757756719142, 0.22414147502106144));
    close(

    for _ in 0..5000 {
        q.gate("tdg", &w, None, &[]).unwrap();
        q.gate("h", &w, None, &[]).unwrap();
    }
    assert_eq!(q, entry);
}
````

````rust
use bennett_isa_ref::{Object, QuantumBindings, QuantumRegion, QuantumState};

fn fixture() -> Object {
    let path = format!(
        "{}/tests/fixtures/control_flow.bisa",
        env!("CARGO_MANIFEST_DIR")
    );
    Object::parse(&std::fs::read_to_string(path).expect("canonical control-flow fixture")).unwrap()
}
fn prepare(q: &mut QuantumState, w: &[u64], value: u128) {
    for (bit, wire) in w.iter().enumerate() {
        if value & (1 << bit) != 0 {
            q.gate("x", &[*wire], None, &[]).unwrap();
        }
    }
}
#[test]
fn coherent_while_is_prefix_and_padding_with_an_exact_adjoint() {
    let o = fixture();
    for p in 0..8 {
        for t in 0..2 {
            let mut q = QuantumState::new();
            let target = q.allocate(1).unwrap();
            let selectors = q.allocate(3).unwrap();
            prepare(&mut q, &target, t);
            prepare(&mut q, &selectors, p);
            let mut b = QuantumBindings::default();
            b.bundles.insert("t".into(), target.clone());
            b.bundles.insert("p".into(), selectors.clone());
            let before = q.clone();
            o.execute_action("while3", &mut q, &b, false, &[]).unwrap();
            let prefix_ones = (0..3).take_while(|bit| p & (1 << bit) != 0).count();
            assert_eq!(
                q.read_basis(&target).unwrap(),
                t ^ (prefix_ones as u128 & 1)
            );
            assert_eq!(q.read_basis(&selectors).unwrap(), p);
            assert_eq!(q.wire_count(), 4);
            o.execute_action("while3", &mut q, &b, true, &[]).unwrap();
            assert_eq!(q, before);
        }
    }
    // Superpose all selectors and both target values, retaining coherent branches.
    let mut q = QuantumState::new();
    let wires = q.allocate(4).unwrap();
    for wire in &wires {
        q.gate("h", &[*wire], None, &[]).unwrap();
    }
    let mut b = QuantumBindings::default();
    b.bundles.insert("t".into(), wires[..1].to_vec());
    b.bundles.insert("p".into(), wires[1..].to_vec());
    let before = q.clone();
    o.execute_action("while3", &mut q, &b, false, &[]).unwrap();
    o.execute_action("while3", &mut q, &b, true, &[]).unwrap();
    assert_eq!(q, before);
}

#[test]
fn qif_and_nested_control_preserve_interference() {
    let o = fixture();
    let mut q = QuantumState::new();
    let t = q.allocate(1).unwrap();
    let p = q.allocate(1).unwrap();
    let mut b = QuantumBindings::default();
    b.bundles.insert("t".into(), t.clone());
    b.bundles.insert("p".into(), p.clone());
    q.gate("h", &p, None, &[]).unwrap();
    o.execute_action("conditional", &mut q, &b, false, &[])
        .unwrap();
    let a = q.amplitudes().unwrap();
    let half = 0.5;
    let h = std::f64::consts::FRAC_1_SQRT_2;
    for (actual, expected) in a.iter().zip([0.0, h, half, half]) {
        assert!((actual.re - expected).abs() < 1e-12);
        assert!(actual.im.abs() < 1e-12);
    }
    o.execute_action("conditional", &mut q, &b, true, &[])
        .unwrap();
    q.gate("h", &p, None, &[]).unwrap();
    q.release(&p).unwrap();
    q.release(&t).unwrap();
    let mut q = QuantumState::new();
    let t = q.allocate(1).unwrap();
    let p = q.allocate(1).unwrap();
    let mut b = QuantumBindings::default();
    b.bundles.insert("t".into(), t);
    b.bundles.insert("p".into(), p.clone());
    q.gate("h", &p, None, &[]).unwrap();
    o.execute_action("controlled_phase", &mut q, &b, false, &[])
        .unwrap();
    q.gate("h", &p, None, &[]).unwrap();
    assert_eq!(q.read_basis(&p).unwrap(), 1);
    assert_eq!(q.exact_support(), vec![(vec![false, true], (1.0, 0.0))]);
}

#[test]
fn interface_exchange_and_little_endian_local_image() {
    let o = fixture();
    for address in 0..2 {
        for target in 0..4 {
            for c0 in 0..4 {
                for c1 in 0..4 {
                    let mut q = QuantumState::new();
                    let t = q.allocate(2).unwrap();
                    let a = q.allocate(1).unwrap();
                    let m0 = q.allocate(2).unwrap();
                    let m1 = q.allocate(2).unwrap();
                    for (w, v) in [(&t, target), (&a, address), (&m0, c0), (&m1, c1)] {
                        prepare(&mut q, w, v);
                    }
                    let mut b = QuantumBindings::default();
                    b.bundles.insert("t".into(), t.clone());
                    b.bundles.insert("a".into(), a);
                    b.regions.insert(
                        "m".into(),
                        QuantumRegion {
                            address_width: 1,
                            cell_width: 2,
                            cells: vec![m0.clone(), m1.clone()],
                        },
                    );
                    let before = q.clone();
                    o.execute_action("exchange", &mut q, &b, false, &[])
                        .unwrap();
                    assert_eq!(
                        q.read_basis(&t).unwrap(),
                        if address == 0 { c0 } else { c1 }
                    );
                    assert_eq!(
                        q.read_basis(&m0).unwrap(),
                        if address == 0 { target } else { c0 }
                    );
                    assert_eq!(
                        q.read_basis(&m1).unwrap(),
                        if address == 1 { target } else { c1 }
                    );
                    o.execute_action("exchange", &mut q, &b, true, &[]).unwrap();
                    assert_eq!(q, before);
                }
            }
        }
    }
    for address in 0..2 {
        let mut q = QuantumState::new();
        let t = q.allocate(8).unwrap();
        let p = q.allocate(1).unwrap();
        prepare(&mut q, &t, 0x35);
        prepare(&mut q, &p, address);
        let mut b = QuantumBindings::default();
        b.bundles.insert("t".into(), t.clone());
        b.bundles.insert("p".into(), p);
        o.execute_action("image", &mut q, &b, false, &[]).unwrap();
        assert_eq!(
            q.read_basis(&t).unwrap(),
            0x35 ^ if address == 0 { 0xde } else { 0xad }
        );
        assert_eq!(q.wire_count(), 9);
        o.execute_action("image", &mut q, &b, true, &[]).unwrap();
        assert_eq!(q.read_basis(&t).unwrap(), 0x35);
    }
}
````

````rust
//! Council round 1: codex B14, muse B6 (§5.6 has no 16-wire limit).
mod support;
use bennett_isa_ref::{Object, QuantumBindings, QuantumState};

fn perm_action(width: u64, body: &str, bounds: &[u64]) -> String {
    let values: Vec<String> = bounds.iter().map(u64::to_string).collect();
    let signature = format!(
        r#"{{"abi":"0.8","args":[],"bounds":[{}],"in":[1],"kind":"perm_action","mem":[],"mut":[{width}],"tier":"q"}}"#,
        values.join(",")
    );
    let regs = if bounds.is_empty() {
        String::new()
    } else {
        format!("regs {{  }} bounds {{{}}}\n", values.join(", "))
    };
    support::object(
        &[(
            "a",
            &signature,
            &format!("perm_action @a (t:wire[{width}] mut) (x:wire in) () () ()\n{regs}^entry():\nb = qborrow any 1\n{body}\nqreturn b"),
        )],
        "{}",
        "",
    )
}
/// Runs @a with t = `t`, x = `x`, borrowed b = `b`; returns (t, b).
fn run(o: &Object, width: usize, t: u128, x: u128, b: u128) -> (u128, u128) {
    let mut q = QuantumState::new();
    let tw = q.allocate(width).unwrap();
    let xw = q.allocate(1).unwrap();
    let bw = q.allocate(1).unwrap();
    for (wires, value) in [(&tw, t), (&xw, x), (&bw, b)] {
        for (i, w) in wires.iter().enumerate() {
            if value >> i & 1 == 1 {
                q.gate("x", &[*w], None, &[]).unwrap();
            }
        }
    }
    let mut bindings = QuantumBindings::default();
    bindings.bundles.insert("t".into(), tw.clone());
    bindings.bundles.insert("x".into(), xw.clone());
    bindings.borrowed.push(bw.clone());
    o.execute_action("a", &mut q, &bindings, false, &[])
        .unwrap();
    (q.read_basis(&tw).unwrap(), q.read_basis(&bw).unwrap())
}
fn swaps17() -> String {
    let forward: Vec<String> = (0..16).map(|i| format!("swap b t[{i}]")).collect();
    let back: Vec<String> = (0..16).rev().map(|i| format!("swap b t[{i}]")).collect();
    [forward, back].concat().join("\n")
}

fn codex_b14_seventeen_wire_swap_identity_frame() {
    let o = Object::parse(&perm_action(16, &swaps17(), &[])).unwrap();
    // Sample the 2^17 domain; the ignored sweep below enumerates all of it.
    for k in 0..512u128 {
        let (t, b) = ((k * 2654435761) & 0xffff, k & 1);
        assert_eq!(run(&o, 16, t, 0, b), (t, b));
    }
}

#[ignore = "exhaustive 2^17 execution of the B14 frame; run with --ignored"]
fn codex_b14_seventeen_wire_swap_identity_frame_exhaustive() {
    let o = Object::parse(&perm_action(16, &swaps17(), &[])).unwrap();
    for t in 0..1u128 << 16 {
        for b in 0..2 {
            assert_eq!(run(&o, 16, t, 0, b), (t, b));
        }

}
#[test]
fn muse_b6_eighteen_wire_paired_cx_frame_and_its_dependent_variant() {
    let pairs = |skip_first: bool| {
        (0..17)
            .flat_map(|i| {
                let one = format!("cx b t[{i}]");
                if i == 0 && skip_first {
                    vec![one]
                } else {
                    vec![one.clone(), one]
                }
            })
            .collect::<Vec<_>>()
            .join("\n")
    };
    let o = Object::parse(&perm_action(17, &pairs(false), &[])).unwrap();
    for k in 0..256u128 {
        let (t, b) = ((k * 40503) & 0x1ffff, k >> 7 & 1);
        assert_eq!(run(&o, 17, t, 1, b), (t, b));
    }
    // cx b t[0] once: t[0] ^= b depends on the borrowed entry value.
    let e = Object::parse(&perm_action(17, &pairs(true), &[]))
        .unwrap_err()
        .to_string();
    assert!(e.contains("§5.6"), "{e}");
}
#[test]
fn borrow_frames_inside_bounded_loops_are_composed_not_unrolled() {
    // (cx b t[0])^(2^40) = I; the former verifier refused loops above 10^6.
    let o = Object::parse(&perm_action(
        1,
        "qloop 1099511627776 {\ncx b t\n}",
        &[1099511627776],
    ))
    .unwrap();
    assert_eq!(run(&o, 1, 1, 0, 1), (1, 1));
    let e = Object::parse(&perm_action(1, "qloop 3 {\ncx b t\n}", &[3]))
        .unwrap_err()
        .to_string();
    assert!(e.contains("§5.6"), "{e}");
    // The order-3 linear map (b,t) -> (t, b xor t), cubed, restores both wires.
    Object::parse(&perm_action(1, "qloop 3 {\ncx b t\ncx t b\n}", &[3])).unwrap();
    Object::parse(&perm_action(1, "qloop 2 {\ncx b t\ncx t b\n}", &[2])).unwrap_err();
}

#[test]
fn r2_opaque_borrow_calls_bind_classical_args_and_tokens_through_inlining() {
    use bennett_isa_ref::{Argument, Budget};
    let os = r#"{"abi":"0.8","args":["i1"],"fault":4,"in":[],"kind":"oracle","mem":[],"tgt":1,"tier":"q"}"#;
    let ps = r#"{"abi":"0.8","args":["token","i1","i1"],"bounds":[],"in":[],"kind":"perm_action","mem":[],"mut":[4],"tier":"q"}"#;
    let cs = r#"{"abi":"0.8","args":["token","i1"],"bounds":[],"in":[],"kind":"perm_action","mem":[],"mut":[1,4],"tier":"q"}"#;
    let oracle = "oracle @o () (t:wire) (f:wire[4]) () (n:i1)\n^entry():\nlift.retval n";
    let child = "perm_action @child (d:wire mut, f:wire[4] mut) () () (token:token, value:i1) ()\n^entry():\noracle_call @o token () d f () (value)";
    for inline in [false, true] {
        let call = |v| {
            if inline {
                format!("action_call @child (d, f) () () (tk, {v})")
            } else {
                format!("oracle_call @o tk () d f () ({v})")
            }
        };
        let build = |second| {
            let body = format!("perm_action @a (f:wire[4] mut) () () (tk:token, x:i1, y:i1) ()\n^entry():\nd = qborrow any 1\n{}\n{}\nqreturn d", call("x"), call(second));
            support::object(
                &[("o", os, oracle), ("child", cs, child), ("a", ps, &body)],
                "{}",
                "",
            )
        };
        let e = Object::parse(&build("y")).expect_err("x and y are not the same classical binding");
        assert!(e.to_string().contains("§5.6"), "{e}");
        let o = Object::parse(&build("x")).unwrap();
        // d_out=d_in XOR x XOR x=d_in; fault XOR 0 twice, for every f,d.
        for x in 0..2 {
            for f in 0..16 {
                for d in 0..2 {
                    let mut q = QuantumState::new();
                    let fw = q.allocate(4).unwrap();
                    let dw = q.allocate(1).unwrap();
                    for (j, w) in fw.iter().chain(&dw).enumerate() {
                        if (f | (d << 4)) >> j & 1 == 1 {
                            q.gate("x", &[*w], None, &[]).unwrap();
                        }
                    }
                    let before = q.clone();
                    let mut b = QuantumBindings::default();
                    b.bundles.insert("f".into(), fw);
                    b.borrowed.push(dw);
                    b.args
                        .insert("tk".into(), Argument::Token(Budget::steps(1)));
                    b.args.insert("x".into(), Argument::Bits(x));
                    b.args.insert("y".into(), Argument::Bits(1 - x));
                    o.execute_action("a", &mut q, &b, false, &[]).unwrap();
                    assert_eq!(q, before);
                    o.execute_action("a", &mut q, &b, true, &[]).unwrap();
                    assert_eq!(q, before);
                }
            }
        }
    }
}

#[test]
fn r3_opaque_loop_composition_substitutes_inside_applications() {
    use bennett_isa_ref::{Argument, Budget};
    let os =
        r#"{"abi":"0.8","args":[],"fault":4,"in":[1],"kind":"oracle","mem":[],"tgt":1,"tier":"q"}"#;
    let ps = r#"{"abi":"0.8","args":["token"],"bounds":[2],"in":[],"kind":"perm_action","mem":[],"mut":[1,4],"tier":"q"}"#;
    let call = "oracle_call @o tk (t) d f () ()";
    let build = |flip: bool, looped: bool| {
        let pair = format!("{call}{}", if flip { "\nx t" } else { "" });
        let body = if looped {
            format!("qloop 2 {{\n{pair}\n}}")
        } else {
            format!("{pair}\n{pair}")
        };
        let sig = if looped {
            ps.to_string()
        } else {
            ps.replace("[2]", "[]")
        };
        let regs = if looped { "regs {  } bounds {2}\n" } else { "" };
        support::object(&[("o",os,"oracle @o (x:wire in) (t:wire) (f:wire[4]) () ()\n^entry():\nlift.retval x"),("a",&sig,&format!("perm_action @a (t:wire mut, f:wire[4] mut) () () (tk:token) ()\n{regs}^entry():\nd = qborrow any 1\n{body}\nqreturn d"))],"{}", "")
    };
    for looped in [true, false] {
        // d' = d XOR t XOR (t XOR 1) = d XOR 1: never a borrow identity.
        support::reject_cli(
            &build(true, looped),
            "§5.6",
            &format!("opaque-loop-{looped}"),
        );
        let o = Object::parse(&build(false, looped)).unwrap();
        // Invariant inputs: d' = d XOR t XOR t = d; all 64 t,f,d values.
        for input in 0..65u32 {
            let mut q = QuantumState::new();
            let w = q.allocate(6).unwrap();
            for (bit, wire) in w.iter().enumerate() {
                if input == 64 {
                    q.gate("h", &[*wire], None, &[]).unwrap();
                } else if input >> bit & 1 == 1 {
                    q.gate("x", &[*wire], None, &[]).unwrap();
                }
            }
            let before = q.clone();
            let mut b = QuantumBindings::default();
            b.bundles.insert("t".into(), vec![w[0]]);
            b.bundles.insert("f".into(), w[1..5].to_vec());
            b.borrowed.push(vec![w[5]]);
            b.args
                .insert("tk".into(), Argument::Token(Budget::steps(1)));
            o.execute_action("a", &mut q, &b, false, &[]).unwrap();
            assert_eq!(q, before);
            o.execute_action("a", &mut q, &b, true, &[]).unwrap();
            assert_eq!(q, before);
        }
    }
}

#[test]
fn r3_nonpermutation_calls_touch_all_effective_controls() {
    let ac = r#"{"abi":"0.8","args":[],"bounds":[],"in":[],"kind":"action","mem":[],"mut":[1],"tier":"q"}"#;
    let build = |sig: &str, child: &str, body: &str| {
        support::object(&[("child",sig,child),("a",ac,&format!("action @a (t:wire mut) () () () ()\n^entry():\nd = qborrow any 1\n{body}\nqreturn d"))],"{}", "")
    };
    let child = "action @child (t:wire mut) () () () ()\n^entry():\nh t";
    for (tag, body) in [
        ("ctl", "ctl d action_call @child (t) () () ()"),
        (
            "inherited",
            "qpred d\naction_call @child (t) () () ()\nqunpred d",
        ),
        ("direct", "qpred d\nh t\nqunpred d"),
    ] {
        support::reject_cli(
            &build(ac, child, body),
            "§5.6",
            &format!("borrow-control-{tag}"),
        );
    }
    let pc = ac.replace("action", "perm_action");
    let child = "perm_action @child (t:wire mut) () () () ()\n^entry():\nx t";
    let o = Object::parse(&build(
        &pc,
        child,
        "ctl d action_call @child (t) () () ()\nctl d action_call @child (t) () () ()",
    ))
    .unwrap();
    // Controlled X twice is identity, including arbitrary borrowed states.
    for input in 0..5u32 {
        let mut q = QuantumState::new();
        let w = q.allocate(2).unwrap();
        for (bit, wire) in w.iter().enumerate() {
            if input == 4 {
                q.gate("h", &[*wire], None, &[]).unwrap();
            } else if input >> bit & 1 == 1 {
                q.gate("x", &[*wire], None, &[]).unwrap();
            }
        }
        let before = q.clone();
        let mut b = QuantumBindings::default();
        b.bundles.insert("t".into(), vec![w[0]]);
        b.borrowed.push(vec![w[1]]);
        o.execute_action("a", &mut q, &b, false, &[]).unwrap();
        assert_eq!(q, before);
        o.execute_action("a", &mut q, &b, true, &[]).unwrap();
        assert_eq!(q, before);
    }
}

/// c is identity (X twice), so CX(b,t); c[†]; CX(b,t) is identity on
/// every t,b and on any reference entangled with b. Local images/lifetimes
/// are unconditional even if c is called under a borrowed control.
fn check_local_region_lifetime(declaration: &str, bounds: &[u64], image: bool) {
    let ps = r#"{"abi":"0.8","args":[],"bounds":[],"in":[],"kind":"perm_action","mem":[],"mut":[1],"tier":"q"}"#;
    let cs = ps.replace("\"bounds\":[]", &format!("\"bounds\":{bounds:?}"));
    let regs = if bounds.is_empty() {
        String::new()
    } else {
        "regs {  } bounds {0}\n".into()
    };
    let child = format!(
        "perm_action @c (t:wire mut) () () () ()\n{regs}^entry():\n{declaration}\nx t\nx t"
    );
    for direction in ["", "adj "] {
        for controlled in [false, true] {
            let call = format!("{direction}action_call @c (t) () () ()");
            let call = if controlled {
                format!("qpred b\n{call}\nqunpred b")
            } else {
                call
            };
            let parent = format!("perm_action @a (t:wire mut) () () () ()\n^entry():\nb = qborrow any 1\ncx b t\n{call}\ncx b t\nqreturn b");
            let layout = "\nsection layout\n{\"A_tab\":0,\"H\":0,\"S_cells\":0,\"globals\":{},\"heap_base\":1,\"heap_limit_max\":0,\"interface_regions\":{},\"null_size\":1,\"ptr_width\":32}\n";
            let text = support::object_with_data(
                &[("c", &cs, &child), ("a", ps, &parent)],
                if image { &[("image", "ff")] } else { &[] },
                layout,
            );
            let o = support::rehash(&text);
            o.check_hashes().unwrap();
            // Four t,b basis entries, a superposition, and a Bell pair b/ref.
            for input in 0..6u32 {
                let mut q = QuantumState::new();
                let w = q.allocate(3).unwrap();
                if input == 5 {
                    q.gate("h", &[w[1]], None, &[]).unwrap();
                    q.gate("cx", &[w[1], w[2]], None, &[]).unwrap();
                    q.gate("h", &[w[0]], None, &[]).unwrap();
                } else {
                    for (bit, wire) in w[..2].iter().enumerate() {
                        if input == 4 {
                            q.gate("h", &[*wire], None, &[]).unwrap();
                        } else if input >> bit & 1 == 1 {
                            q.gate("x", &[*wire], None, &[]).unwrap();
                        }
                    }
                }
                let before = q.clone();
                let mut bindings = QuantumBindings::default();
                bindings.bundles.insert("t".into(), vec![w[0]]);
                bindings.borrowed.push(vec![w[1]]);
                for adjoint in [false, true] {
                    o.execute_action("a", &mut q, &bindings, adjoint, &[])
                        .unwrap();
                    assert_eq!(q, before, "{declaration}, {direction}, controlled={controlled}, input={input}, adjoint={adjoint}");
                }
            }
            // Pin the reported CLI acceptance and t=0/1 exact reversal too.
            let path = std::path::Path::new(env!("CARGO_MANIFEST_DIR"))
                .join(".tmp")
                .join(format!(
                    "codex-local-{image}-{}-{}-{controlled}.bisa",
                    bounds.len(),
                    direction.len()
                ));
            std::fs::create_dir_all(path.parent().unwrap()).unwrap();
            std::fs::write(&path, &o.text).unwrap();
            for t in ["0", "1"] {
                for command in ["run-action", "reverse"] {
                    let output = std::process::Command::new(env!("CARGO_BIN_EXE_bennett-isa-ref"))
                        .arg(command)
                        .arg(&path)
                        .args(["a", "--mut", t])
                        .output()
                        .unwrap();
                    assert!(
                        output.status.success(),
                        "{}",
                        String::from_utf8_lossy(&output.stderr)
                    );
                    let value = support::json(std::str::from_utf8(&output.stdout).unwrap());
                    let expected = support::json(&format!(r#"{{"{t}":[1,0]}}"#));
                    let field = if command == "reverse" {
                        "forward_state"
                    } else {
                        "state"
                    };
                    assert_eq!(value.get(field).unwrap(), &expected);
                    if command == "reverse" {
                        assert_eq!(
                            value.get("equals_entry").unwrap(),
                            &bennett_isa_ref::json::Json::Bool(true)
                        );
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }
}

#[test]
fn codex_r3_b03_adjoint_child_local_region_exact_witness() {
    check_local_region_lifetime("qregion r 1 1", &[], false);
}

#[test]
fn codex_r3_b03_adjoint_child_nonzero_image() {
    check_local_region_lifetime("qregion r 1 4 @image", &[], true);
}

#[test]
fn codex_r3_b03_adjoint_child_zero_trip_region_declaration() {
    // The load precedes the lexical declaration: even a zero-trip declaration
    // creates the region at function entry. The loaded image is restored.
    check_local_region_lifetime("z = qalloc any 1\nv = qload r z\nqunload r z v\nqfree z\nqloop 0 {\nqregion r 1 4 @image\n}", &[0], true);
}

#[test]
fn r4_loop_local_returns_cannot_be_restored_by_later_borrowings() {
    // At EACH return b_out = beta XOR 1. A second borrowing cannot complete
    // the first frame, even if the executor happens to reuse the same pool bit.
    for (tag, body, bounds) in [
        (
            "loop",
            "qloop 2 {\nb = qborrow any 1\nx b\nqreturn b\n}",
            vec![2],
        ),
        (
            "unrolled",
            "b = qborrow any 1\nx b\nqreturn b\nb = qborrow any 1\nx b\nqreturn b",
            vec![],
        ),
        (
            "nested",
            "qloop 2 {\nqloop 2 {\nb = qborrow any 1\nx b\nqreturn b\n}\n}",
            vec![2, 2],
        ),
        ("single", "b = qborrow any 1\nx b\nqreturn b", vec![]),
        // b is restored but the output depends on beta at each return.
        (
            "dependent",
            "qloop 2 {\nb = qborrow any 1\ncx b t\nqreturn b\n}",
            vec![2],
        ),
    ] {
        support::reject_cli(
            &support::borrow_lifetime_object(body, &bounds),
            "§5.6",
            &format!("r4-borrow-{tag}"),
        );
    }
}

#[test]
fn r4_borrow_lifetimes_inside_and_across_loops_preserve_full_state() {
    for (body, bounds) in [
        (
            "d = qalloc any 1\nb = qborrow any 1\nx b\nx b\nqfree d\nqreturn b",
            vec![],
        ),
        ("b = qborrow any 1\nqloop 2 {\nx b\n}\nqreturn b", vec![2]),
        (
            "qloop 2 {\nb = qborrow any 1\nx b\nx b\nqreturn b\n}",
            vec![2],
        ),
        (
            "qloop 2 {\nqloop 2 {\nb = qborrow any 1\nx b\nx b\nqreturn b\n}\n}",
            vec![2, 2],
        ),
        (
            "qloop 2 {\nb = qborrow any 1\nqloop 2 {\nx b\n}\nqreturn b\n}",
            vec![2, 2],
        ),
    ] {
        let o = support::rehash(&support::borrow_lifetime_object(body, &bounds));
        o.check_hashes().unwrap();
        support::borrow_identity(&o);
    }
}

#[test]
fn muse_r4_b01_each_iteration_has_an_independent_borrowed_entry() {
    // Each return must factor on its OWN arbitrary beta_i. For d->t,
    // t' = t XOR beta_i; for t->d, d' = beta_i XOR t. Both fail for
    // one iteration regardless of the parity of the surrounding loop count.
    for gate in ["cx d t", "cx t d"] {
        let lifetime = format!("d = qborrow any 1\n{gate}\nqreturn d");
        for (tag, body, bounds) in [
            ("single", lifetime.clone(), vec![]),
            ("two", format!("qloop 2 {{\n{lifetime}\n}}"), vec![2]),
            ("four", format!("qloop 4 {{\n{lifetime}\n}}"), vec![4]),
            (
                "nested",
                format!("qloop 2 {{\nqloop 2 {{\n{lifetime}\n}}\n}}"),
                vec![2, 2],
            ),
            (
                "unrolled",
                format!("{lifetime}\n{}", lifetime.replace('d', "e")),
                vec![],
            ),
        ] {
            support::reject_cli(
                &support::borrow_lifetime_object(&body, &bounds),
                "§5.6",
                &format!("muse-r4-{tag}-{}", gate.replace(' ', "-")),
            );
        }
    }
}

#[test]
fn muse_r4_b01_carried_and_local_borrow_cx_identities_have_no_trip_cap() {
    for gate in ["cx d t", "cx t d"] {
        let spanning = format!("d = qborrow any 1\nqloop 2 {{\n{gate}\n}}\nqreturn d");
        let o = support::rehash(&support::borrow_lifetime_object(&spanning, &[2]));
        support::borrow_identity(&o);
        for trips in [2, 1_099_511_627_776u64] {
            let body =
                format!("qloop {trips} {{\nd = qborrow any 1\n{gate}\n{gate}\nqreturn d\n}}");
            let o = support::rehash(&support::borrow_lifetime_object(&body, &[trips]));
            o.check_hashes().unwrap();
            support::borrow_identity(&o);
        }
    }
}

#[test]
fn sol_r5_b02_clean_surrounding_loop_controls_are_reachable_invariants() {
    for n in [1, 2, 3, 1 << 40] {
        for nested in [false, true] {
            let inner = format!("qloop {n} {{\nb = qborrow any 1\ncx d b\nqreturn b\n}}");
            let (loops, bounds) = if nested {
                (format!("qloop 3 {{\n{inner}\n}}"), vec![3, n])
            } else {
                (inner, vec![n])
            };
            // d=0 is unchanged: EACH CX is I on arbitrary/entangled beta_i.
            let body = format!("d = qalloc any 1\n{loops}\nqfree d");
            let o = support::rehash(&support::borrow_lifetime_object(&body, &bounds));
            support::borrow_identity(&o);
            let dir = std::path::Path::new(env!("CARGO_MANIFEST_DIR")).join(".tmp");
            let path = dir.join(format!("r5-clean-{n}-{nested}.bisa"));
            std::fs::write(&path, &o.text).unwrap();
            for cmd in ["hash", "check"] {
                let out = std::process::Command::new(env!("CARGO_BIN_EXE_bennett-isa-ref"))
                    .arg(cmd)
                    .arg(&path)
                    .output()
                    .unwrap();
                assert!(out.status.success(), "{out:?}");
            }
            // d=1 makes each return invalid, including at even trip counts.
            let bad = format!("d = qalloc any 1\nx d\n{loops}\nx d\nqfree d");
            support::reject_cli(
                &support::borrow_lifetime_object(&bad, &bounds),
                "§5.6",
                &format!("r5-dirty-{n}-{nested}"),
            );
            if n <= 3 {
                let unrolled = (0..n)
                    .map(|i| format!("b{i} = qborrow any 1\ncx d b{i}\nqreturn b{i}"))
                    .collect::<Vec<_>>()
                    .join("\n");
                support::borrow_identity(&support::rehash(&support::borrow_lifetime_object(
                    &format!("d = qalloc any 1\n{unrolled}\nqfree d"),
                    &[],
                )));
            }
        }
    }
    // Reachability must include later iterations: d=0 on the first entry,
    // then toggles to 1. A first-iteration-only check would admit this.
    support::reject_cli(
        &support::borrow_lifetime_object(
            "d = qalloc any 1\nqloop 2 {\nb = qborrow any 1\ncx d b\nqreturn b\nx d\n}\nqfree d",
            &[2],
        ),
        "§5.6",
        "r5-later-entry",
    );
}

#[test]
fn codex_r5_b03_one_iteration_release_matches_unrolled_clean_entry() {
    for (i, (body, bounds, hash)) in [
        (
            "c = qalloc any 1\nb = qborrow any 1\nqloop 1 {\nqfree c\n}\nqreturn b",
            vec![1],
            "a42079194137127e703185faaeb6b5bc85c6941ccc03988eb67c19c14481e8df",
        ),
        (
            "c = qalloc any 1\nb = qborrow any 1\nqfree c\nqreturn b",
            vec![],
            "77ec83b71a86ed5ecff50d17e3eafe79fc371da7ff553ab53eb2de7a19abd218",
        ),
        (
            "c = qalloc any 1\nqloop 1 {\nb = qborrow any 1\nqfree c\nqreturn b\n}",
            vec![1],
            "1f7845d8ea763f50cbd05294dacce1f1c8de52f18a506a240ffee4b909ce7712",
        ),
    ]
    .iter()
    .enumerate()
    {
        // c is exactly zero, so freeing it once is legal; b never changes.
        let o = support::rehash(&support::borrow_lifetime_object(body, bounds));
        assert_eq!(o.identity().unwrap().interface_hashes["a"], *hash);
        o.check_hashes().unwrap();
        support::borrow_identity(&o);
        let path = std::path::Path::new(env!("CARGO_MANIFEST_DIR"))
            .join(format!(".tmp/codex-r5-b03-{i}.bisa"));
        std::fs::write(&path, &o.text).unwrap();
        for cmd in ["hash", "check", "run-action", "reverse"] {
            for t in ["0", "1"] {
                let mut command = std::process::Command::new(env!("CARGO_BIN_EXE_bennett-isa-ref"));
                command.arg(cmd).arg(&path);
                if matches!(cmd, "run-action" | "reverse") {
                    command.args(["a", "--mut", t]);
                }
                let out = command.output().unwrap();
                assert!(out.status.success(), "{cmd}, {out:?}");
                if cmd == "run-action" {
                    let result = support::json(std::str::from_utf8(&out.stdout).unwrap());
                    assert_eq!(
                        result.get("state").unwrap().canonical(),
                        format!("{{\"{t}\":[1,0]}}")
                    );
                } else if cmd == "reverse" {
                    assert!(String::from_utf8_lossy(&out.stdout).contains("\"equals_entry\":true"));
                }
            }
        }
        // The same release with c=1 is unclean, irrespective of the wrapper.
        let dirty = body.replace("c = qalloc any 1", "c = qalloc any 1\nx c");
        assert!(Object::parse(&support::borrow_lifetime_object(&dirty, bounds)).is_err());
    }
}

#[test]
fn r6_sol_boundary_exact() {
    let (text, h, oh) = support::r6_witness("sol-boundary");
    let o = Object::parse(&text).unwrap();
    let id = o.identity().unwrap();
    assert_eq!(id.interface_hashes["a"], h);
    assert_eq!(id.closure_hashes["a"].as_deref(), Some(h));
    assert_eq!(id.object_hash, oh);
    o.check_hashes().unwrap();
    support::r6_map(&o, false);
}

#[test]
fn r6_codex_boundary_exact() {
    let (text, h, oh) = support::r6_witness("codex-boundary");
    let o = Object::parse(&text).unwrap();
    let id = o.identity().unwrap();
    assert_eq!(id.interface_hashes["a"], h);
    assert_eq!(id.closure_hashes["a"].as_deref(), Some(h));
    assert_eq!(id.object_hash, oh);

    support::r6_map(&o, true);
}

#[test]
fn r6_boundary_variants_retain_clean_controls_and_reject_dirty_frames() {
    for (body, bounds, h) in [
        ("c = qalloc any 1\nb = qborrow any 1\nh t\ncx c b\nqreturn b\nh t\nqfree c", vec![], false),
        ("c = qalloc any 1\nh t\nb = qborrow any 1\nx b\nx b\nqreturn b\nqfree c", vec![], true),
        ("c = qalloc any 1\nqloop 3 {\nh t\nb = qborrow any 1\ncx c b\nqreturn b\nh t\n}\nqfree c", vec![3], false),
        ("c = qalloc any 1\nh t\nb = qborrow any 1\ncx c b\nqreturn b\nqfree c\nh t", vec![], false),
        // Facts about c are invalidated by H c: this valid cleanup uses H c
        // again, but borrowed restoration is independent of that unknown c.
        ("c = qalloc any 1\nh c\nb = qborrow any 1\nx b\nx b\nqreturn b\nh c\nqfree c", vec![], false),
    ] {
        let text = support::borrow_lifetime_object(body, &bounds).replace("perm_action", "action");
        let o = support::rehash(&text);
        o.check_hashes().unwrap();
        support::r6_map(&o, h);
    }
    for body in [
        "c = qalloc any 1\nx c\nh t\nb = qborrow any 1\ncx c b\nqreturn b\nh t\nx c\nqfree c",
        "c = qalloc any 1\nh t\nb = qborrow any 1\nx b\nqreturn b\nh t\nqfree c",
        "c = qalloc any 1\nh t\nb = qborrow any 1\nqreturn b\nx c\nqfree c",
        "c = qalloc any 1\nh c\nb = qborrow any 1\ncx c b\nqreturn b\nh c\nqfree c",
    ] {
        for certified in [false, true] {
            let text = if certified {
                support::certified_borrow_identity_kind(body, &[], "action")
            } else {
                support::borrow_lifetime_object(body, &[]).replace("perm_action", "action")
            };
            let e = Object::parse(&text).unwrap_err().to_string();
            assert!(e.contains("§5.6") || e.contains("§6.2"), "{e}");
        }
    }
}

fn r9_qinplace_zero_budget_rejects_before_mutation() {
    use bennett_isa_ref::{Argument, Budget};
    let o = support::rehash(&support::r9_opaque_object("qinplace @o @o tk t", &[], None));
    for adjoint in [false, true] {
        let mut q = QuantumState::new();
        let w = q.allocate(1).unwrap();
        q.gate("h", &w, None, &[]).unwrap();
        let entry = q.clone();
        let mut b = QuantumBindings::default();
        b.bundles.insert("t".into(), w);
        b.args
            .insert("tk".into(), Argument::Token(Budget::steps(0)));
        let e = o.execute_action("a", &mut q, &b, adjoint, &[]).unwrap_err();
        assert!(e.to_string().contains("§4.5"), "{e}");
        assert_eq!(q, entry);
    }
    // The exact member subject still checks statically but must reject B=0 at execution.
    let o = Object::parse(support::r9_fixture("sol-qinplace")).unwrap();
    let path = std::path::Path::new(env!("CARGO_MANIFEST_DIR")).join(".tmp/r9-qinplace-zero.bisa");
    std::fs::write(&path, &o.text).unwrap();
    let out = std::process::Command::new(env!("CARGO_BIN_EXE_bennett-isa-ref"))
        .arg("run-action")
        .arg(&path)
        .args(["a", "--mut", "0", "--arg", "token:0,0,0,0"])
        .output()
        .unwrap();
    assert_eq!(out.status.code(), Some(1));
    assert!(out.stdout.is_empty());
    assert!(String::from_utf8_lossy(&out.stderr).contains("§4.5"));
}
````

````rust
//! Council round 1: codex B14 (claim route), B16, muse B7 (typed metadata and
//! checked claims).
mod support;
use bennett_isa_ref::{json::Json, ClaimVerdict, Object};
use support::json;

const INC: &str = include_str!("fixtures/inc8.bisa");

fn rejects(text: &str, rule: &str) {
    match Object::parse(text) {
        Err(e) => assert!(e.to_string().contains(rule), "{e} must cite {rule}"),
        Ok(_) => panic!("malformed metadata accepted"),
    }
}
/// A perm_action `a` borrowing one wire around a swap frame over t[0..n),
/// and an identity reference `id` of the same signature.
fn swap_frame(n: u64) -> String {
    let sig = format!(
        r#"{{"abi":"0.8","args":[],"bounds":[],"in":[1],"kind":"perm_action","mem":[],"mut":[{n}],"tier":"q"}}"#
    );
    let forward: Vec<String> = (0..n).map(|i| format!("swap b t[{i}]")).collect();
    let back: Vec<String> = (0..n).rev().map(|i| format!("swap b t[{i}]")).collect();
    let a = format!(
        "perm_action @a (t:wire[{n}] mut) (x:wire in) () () ()\n^entry():\nb = qborrow any 1\n{}\nqreturn b",
        [forward, back].concat().join("\n")
    );
    let id = format!(
        "perm_action @id (t:wire[{n}] mut) (x:wire in) () () ()\n^entry():\nx t[0]\nx t[0]"
    );
    support::rehash(&support::object(
        &[("a", &sig, &a), ("id", &sig, &id)],
        "{}",
        "",
    ))
    .text
}
fn certificate(text: &str, n: u64, claims: &str, borrow_frames: &str) -> String {
    let o = Object::parse(text).unwrap();
    let identity = o.identity().unwrap();
    let a = identity.closure_hashes["a"].clone().unwrap();
    let id = identity.closure_hashes["id"].clone().unwrap();
    let signature = o.functions["a"].signature().canonical();
    let claims = claims.replace("ID", &id);
    let bounds = format!("{:?}", o.functions["a"].bounds);
    let cert = json(&format!(
        r#"{{"versions":{{"isa":"0.8","object":"0.8","launch":"0.8","sched":"0.8","cert":"0.8","coverage":"0.8","target":"0.8"}},"bindings":{{"object_hash":"{}","interface_hash":"{}","closure_hash":"{a}","reference_program_hash":"{}","dialect_mapping_version":"test.1","target_hash":"{}"}},"producer":{{"name":"tests","version":"1","materialisation":{{"llvm_version":"none","pipeline":"none","normaliser_version":"1"}}}},"regions":{{"{a}":{{"kind":"perm_action","signature":{signature},"bounds":{bounds},"frame":{{"interface":[{{"role":"mut","width":{n},"class":"any"}},{{"role":"in","width":1,"class":"any"}}],"scratch":{{}},"retained_history":0,"borrow":{{"any":1}},"scheme_ancillae":{{}}}},"resources":{{}},"gates_used":{{}},"claims":[{claims}],"verification":{{"oracle":null,"borrow_frames":[{borrow_frames}],"inverse_pairs":[],"unitary":[],"channel":[],"fault_rate":{{"domain":{{"bundles":[],"borrowed":[],"regions":[]}},"faults_by_code":{{}},"undefined_excluded":0,"layout_dependent_excluded":0}}}},"cleanup":{{}},"error":{{}},"definedness_assumptions":[]}}}},"composition":{{"multiplicities":{{}},"epsilon_total":{{"diamond":0}},"method":"sum_over_multiplicities"}}}}"#,
        identity.object_hash,
        identity.interface_hashes["a"],
        identity.interface_hashes["a"],
        "3".repeat(64)
    ));
    format!("{text}\nsection certificate\n{}\n", cert.canonical())
}
fn claim(n: u64, t_hi: &str, b_hi: u32, expected: &str) -> String {
    format!(
        r#"{{"kind":"exhaustive","label":"proof","domain":{{"bundles":[{{"name":"t","width":{n},"lo":0,"hi":{t_hi}}},{{"name":"x","width":1,"lo":0,"hi":1}}],"borrowed":[{{"name":"b","width":1,"lo":0,"hi":{b_hi}}}],"regions":[]}},"expected":{expected}}}"#
    )
}

#[test]
fn b14_checked_borrow_claim_and_altered_or_incomplete_claims() {
    let n = 4;
    let text = swap_frame(n);
    let good = certificate(&text, n, &claim(n, "15", 1, r#"{"program":"ID"}"#), "0");
    let o = Object::parse(&good).unwrap();
    let reports = o.verify_certificate().unwrap();
    assert_eq!(reports.len(), 1);
    assert_eq!(reports[0].verdict, ClaimVerdict::Proof);
    // Altered: the expected program is the frame itself... replaced by a
    // table with one wrong row (2^6 rows: t fastest-last order).
    let mut rows = Vec::new();
    for t in 0..16u32 {
        for x in 0..2u32 {
            for b in 0..2u32 {
                rows.push(format!("[{t},{x},{b}]"));
            }
        }
    }
    let table = format!(r#"{{"table":[{}]}}"#, rows.join(","));
    let exact = certificate(&text, n, &claim(n, "15", 1, &table), "0");
    assert_eq!(
        Object::parse(&exact).unwrap().verify_certificate().unwrap()[0].verdict,
        ClaimVerdict::Proof
    );
    let wrong = table.replacen("[0,0,0]", "[1,0,0]", 1);
    let altered = certificate(&text, n, &claim(n, "15", 1, &wrong), "0");
    let e = Object::parse(&altered)
        .unwrap()
        .verify_certificate()
        .unwrap_err()
        .to_string();
    assert!(e.contains("§12.1"), "{e}");
    // Incomplete: t only up to 7, so the domain is not D: evidence, not proof,
    // and therefore not a borrow_frames proof (§5.6, §12.2).
    let incomplete = certificate(&text, n, &claim(n, "7", 1, r#"{"program":"ID"}"#), "0");
    let e = Object::parse(&incomplete)
        .unwrap()
        .verify_certificate()
        .unwrap_err()
        .to_string();
    assert!(e.contains("§5.6"), "{e}");
    // A borrow claim must range over the borrowed bundle.
    let no_borrowed = claim(n, "15", 1, r#"{"program":"ID"}"#)
        .replace(r#"[{"name":"b","width":1,"lo":0,"hi":1}]"#, "[]");
    let e = Object::parse(&certificate(&text, n, &no_borrowed, "0"))
        .unwrap()
        .verify_certificate()
        .unwrap_err()
        .to_string();
    assert!(e.contains("§5.6"), "{e}");
}

#[ignore = "the codex B14 17-wire frame with its 2^18-element claim; run with --ignored"]

}

fn schedule(field: &str, value: &str) -> Json {
    let base = format!(
        r#"{{"bindings":{{"budget":[3,0,0,0],"closure_hash":"8ce5e64f15830d8e596ba9b4861def6565dd567b5804300f427d8b9566d5be93","epsilon":0,"expansion":{{"hash":"{}","name":"ref","version":"0.8"}},"inherited_controls":0,"params_hash":"{}","region":"inc8","scheduler":{{"name":"test","version":"1"}},"target_hash":"{}","variant":"forward"}},"entries":[{{"generated":"*","kind":"start","path":[{{"iteration":[],"point":"entry:0","symbol":"8ce5e64f15830d8e596ba9b4861def6565dd567b5804300f427d8b9566d5be93"}}],"phase":"fwd","start":{{"time":0}},"step":1}}]}}"#,
        "1".repeat(64),
        "2".repeat(64),
        "3".repeat(64)
    );
    let mut s = json(&base);
    let Json::Object(top) = &mut s else { panic!() };
    match field {
        "" => {}
        "budget" | "variant" => {
            let Json::Object(b) = top.get_mut("bindings").unwrap() else {
                panic!()
            };
            b.insert(field.into(), json(value));
        }
        _ => {
            let Json::Array(entries) = top.get_mut("entries").unwrap() else {
                panic!()
            };
            let Json::Object(e) = &mut entries[0] else {
                panic!()
            };
            if field == "time" {
                e.insert("start".into(), json(&format!(r#"{{"time":{value}}}"#)));
            } else if field == "path" {
                e.insert("path".into(), json(value));
            } else {
                e.insert(field.into(), json(value));
            }
        }
    }
    s
}

    Object::parse(&with(&schedule("", ""))).unwrap();

        ("budget", "[3,true,0,0]"),
        ("budget", "[3,null,0,0]"),
        ("budget", "[3,-1,0,0]"),

        ),

        ("variant", "\"a:b\""),

    Object::parse(&good).unwrap();

        (
            r#""versions":{"cert":"0.8""#,

        ),
        (
            r#""dialect_mapping_version":"test.1""#,
            r#""dialect_mapping_version":false"#,
        ),
        (r#""multiplicities":{}"#, r#""multiplicities":false"#),
        (

            r#""method":"nonsense""#,
        ),
        (

        (r#""claims":[{"#, r#""claims":[{"bogus":1},{"#),
        (r#""scratch":{}"#, r#""scratch":{},"unknown":1"#),
        (r#""gates_used":{}"#, r#""gates_used":{"x":{"count":-1}}"#),
    ] {
        let bad = good.replacen(from, to, 1);
        assert_ne!(bad, good, "{from}");
        // Re-canonicalise so the test reaches the schema, not the JCS check.
        let line = bad.lines().last().unwrap();
        let fixed = match Json::parse(line) {
            Ok(j) => bad.replace(line, &j.canonical()),
            Err(_) => bad,
        };
        rejects(&fixed, "§");

fn sol_translation_object(gates: &str, nested: bool) -> String {
    let sig = r#"{"abi":"0.8","args":[],"bounds":[],"in":[1],"kind":"perm_action","mem":[],"mut":[1],"tier":"q"}"#;
    let asig = if nested {
        sig.replace("\"bounds\":[]", "\"bounds\":[2]")
````
