````rust
        sig.into()
    };
    let regs = if nested { "regs {  } bounds {2}\n" } else { "" };
    let body = format!("perm_action @a (t:wire mut) (p:wire in) () () ()\n{regs}^entry():\nb = qborrow any 1\n{}\nqreturn b", if nested { format!("qloop 2 {{\n{gates}\n}}") } else { gates.into() });
    support::rehash(&support::object(
        &[
            ("a", &asig, &body),
            (
                "id",
                sig,
                "perm_action @id (u:wire mut) (v:wire in) () () ()\n^entry():\nx u\nx u",
            ),
        ],
        "{}",
        "",
    ))
    .text
}
fn sol_translation_claim(text: &str, start: u32, end: u32, v: u32, w: u32, b: &str) -> String {
    let o = Object::parse(text).unwrap();
    let h = &o.identity().unwrap().interface_hashes["a"];
    format!(
        r#"{{"kind":"structural","rule":"translation_lemma","subclaims":[],"witness":{{"V":[["{h}","entry",{v}]],"W":[["{h}","entry",{w}]],"X":["p"],"B":["{b}"],"frame":[["{h}","entry",{start}],["{h}","entry",{end}]]}}}}"#
    )
}
fn sol_assert_translation(text: &str, claim: &str, valid: bool) {
    let o = Object::parse(&certificate(text, 1, claim, "")).unwrap();
    let h = o.identity().unwrap().closure_hashes["a"].clone().unwrap();
    for verdict in [
        o.verify_claim(&h, 0),
        o.verify_certificate().map(|r| r[0].verdict.clone()),
    ] {
        if valid {
            assert_eq!(verdict.unwrap(), ClaimVerdict::Proof);
        } else {
            let e = verdict
                .expect_err("false structural frame proved")
                .to_string();
            assert!(e.contains("§5.6") || e.contains("§12.1"), "{e}");
        }
    }
}
#[test]
fn sol_r4_b02_translation_claim_must_prove_its_complete_named_frame() {
    // Full frame: b ^= p; t ^= b; b ^= p; t ^= b => (t ^= p, b unchanged).
    // Truncated frame: b ^= p; t ^= b => b dirty and t dependent on entry b.
    let text = sol_translation_object("cx p b\ncx b t\ncx p b\ncx b t", false);
    for (start, end, v, w, valid) in [
        (1, 2, 1, 2, false),
        (1, 4, 1, 2, true),
        (99, 100, 1, 2, false),
        (4, 1, 1, 2, false),
        (1, 4, 99, 2, false),
        (1, 4, 1, 3, false),
    ] {
        sol_assert_translation(
            &text,
            &sol_translation_claim(&text, start, end, v, w, "b"),
            valid,
        );
    }
    sol_assert_translation(&text, &sol_translation_claim(&text, 1, 4, 1, 2, "p"), false);
    // The object itself is still valid, but its first four gates have a
    // changed second W; later gates complete the actual independent circuit.
    let changed = sol_translation_object("cx p b\ncx b t\ncx p b\nx t\ncx b t\nx t", false);
    sol_assert_translation(
        &changed,
        &sol_translation_claim(&changed, 1, 4, 1, 2, "b"),
        false,
    );
}
#[test]
fn sol_r4_b02_translation_claim_uses_nested_line_ordinals() {
    // qborrow=0, qloop=1, nested gates=2..5, qreturn=6. Prove the
    // complete body frame, uniformly for both loop iterations.
    let text = sol_translation_object("cx p b\ncx b t\ncx p b\ncx b t", true);
    sol_assert_translation(&text, &sol_translation_claim(&text, 2, 5, 2, 3, "b"), true);
    sol_assert_translation(&text, &sol_translation_claim(&text, 2, 3, 2, 3, "b"), false);
}

#[test]
fn sol_r4_b02_translation_frame_rejects_omissions_and_checks_reverse_order() {
    let gates = "x b\ncx p b\ncx b t\ncx p b\nx b\ncx b t";
    let text = sol_translation_object(gates, false);
    let mut claim = json(&sol_translation_claim(&text, 1, 6, 1, 3, "b"));
    let h = Object::parse(&text)
        .unwrap()
        .identity()
        .unwrap()
        .interface_hashes["a"]
        .clone();
    let Json::Object(c) = &mut claim else {
        panic!()
    };
    let Json::Object(w) = c.get_mut("witness").unwrap() else {
        panic!()
    };
    w.insert(
        "V".into(),
        json(&format!(r#"[["{h}","entry",1],["{h}","entry",2]]"#)),
    );
    sol_assert_translation(&text, &claim.canonical(), true);
    // Skip x b between the named V and W; the remaining four gates happen
    // to form a valid independent circuit, but the named frame contains six.
    sol_assert_translation(&text, &sol_translation_claim(&text, 1, 6, 2, 3, "b"), false);
    let twice = sol_translation_object(
        "cx p b\ncx b t\ncx p b\ncx b t\ncx p b\ncx b t\ncx p b\ncx b t",
        false,
    );
    sol_assert_translation(
        &twice,
        &sol_translation_claim(&twice, 1, 4, 1, 2, "b"),
        false,
    );
}

fn sol_positional_object(region: bool, reference: &str) -> String {
    let mem = if region {
        r#"[{"A":1,"W":1,"role":"mut"}]"#
    } else {
        "[]"
    };
    let sig = format!(
        r#"{{"abi":"0.8","args":[],"bounds":[],"in":[1],"kind":"perm_action","mem":{mem},"mut":[1],"tier":"q"}}"#
    );
    let a = format!(
        "perm_action @a (t:wire mut) (p:wire in) ({}) () ()\n^entry():\nx t\nx t",
        if region { "m:region[1,1] mut" } else { "" }
    );
    let id = format!(
        "perm_action @id (u:wire mut) (v:wire in) ({}) () ()\n^entry():\n{reference}",
        if region { "n:region[1,1] mut" } else { "" }
    );
    support::rehash(&support::object(&[("a",&sig,&a),("id",&sig,&id)],"{}",if region { "\nsection layout\n{\"A_tab\":0,\"H\":0,\"S_cells\":0,\"globals\":{},\"heap_base\":1,\"heap_limit_max\":0,\"interface_regions\":{},\"null_size\":1,\"ptr_width\":32}\n" } else {""})).text
}
fn sol_positional_claim(regions: &str, borrowed: &str, bundles: &str) -> String {
    format!(
        r#"{{"kind":"exhaustive","label":"proof","domain":{{"bundles":[{bundles}],"borrowed":[{borrowed}],"regions":[{regions}]}},"expected":{{"program":"ID"}}}}"#
    )
}
const SOL_BUNDLES: &str =
    r#"{"name":"t","width":1,"lo":0,"hi":1},{"name":"p","width":1,"lo":0,"hi":1}"#;
fn sol_positional_verdict(text: &str, claim: &str) -> Result<ClaimVerdict, bennett_isa_ref::Error> {
    let o = Object::parse(&certificate(text, 1, claim, "")).unwrap();
    let h = o.identity().unwrap().closure_hashes["a"].clone().unwrap();
    let v = o.verify_claim(&h, 0)?;
    assert_eq!(o.verify_certificate().unwrap()[0].verdict, v);
    Ok(v)
}
#[test]
fn sol_r4_b03_expected_program_uses_signature_positions_for_renamed_bundles() {
    // Independently: both bodies are identity on 00,01,10,11. Local names
    // t,p versus u,v have no ABI significance (§9.4).
    let text = sol_positional_object(false, "x u\nx u");
    let claim = sol_positional_claim("", "", SOL_BUNDLES);
    assert_eq!(
        sol_positional_verdict(&text, &claim).unwrap(),
        ClaimVerdict::Proof
    );
    // Permuting domain enumeration order must not permute interface slots.
    let reverse = sol_positional_claim(
        "",
        "",
        r#"{"name":"p","width":1,"lo":0,"hi":1},{"name":"t","width":1,"lo":0,"hi":1}"#,
    );
    assert_eq!(
        sol_positional_verdict(&text, &reverse).unwrap(),
        ClaimVerdict::Proof
    );
    // Borrowed pool entries follow their domain order, independently of the
    // expected program's local names. A truly omitted input stays zero.
    let borrowed = r#"{"name":"z","width":1,"lo":0,"hi":1},{"name":"b","width":2,"lo":0,"hi":3}"#;
    assert_eq!(
        sol_positional_verdict(&text, &sol_positional_claim("", borrowed, SOL_BUNDLES)).unwrap(),
        ClaimVerdict::Proof
    );
    let partial = sol_positional_claim("", "", r#"{"name":"t","width":1,"lo":0,"hi":1}"#);
    assert_eq!(
        sol_positional_verdict(&text, &partial).unwrap(),
        ClaimVerdict::Evidence { elements: 2 }
    );
    let wrong = sol_positional_object(false, "x u");
    let e = sol_positional_verdict(&wrong, &claim)
        .unwrap_err()
        .to_string();
    assert!(
        e.contains("§12.1") && e.contains("differs from the expected program"),
        "{e}"
    );
}
#[test]
fn sol_r4_b03_expected_program_maps_renamed_region_cells_positionally() {
    // 2 interface bits and 2 independent region cells => 16 identical final
    // tuples. Changing only reference memory must still be detected.
    let text = sol_positional_object(true, "x u\nx u");
    let claim = sol_positional_claim(r#"{"name":"m","cells":"all"}"#, "", SOL_BUNDLES);
    assert_eq!(
        sol_positional_verdict(&text, &claim).unwrap(),
        ClaimVerdict::Proof
    );
    let partial = sol_positional_claim(
        r#"{"name":"m","cells":[{"index":1,"lo":0,"hi":1}]}"#,
        "",
        SOL_BUNDLES,
    );
    assert_eq!(
        sol_positional_verdict(&text, &partial).unwrap(),
        ClaimVerdict::Evidence { elements: 8 }
    );
    let wrong = sol_positional_object(true, "qstore n v u");
    assert!(sol_positional_verdict(&wrong, &claim)
        .unwrap_err()
        .to_string()
        .contains("§12.1"));
}

#[test]
fn sol_r4_b03_positions_distinguish_same_width_slots_and_crossed_names() {
    let sig = r#"{"abi":"0.8","args":[],"bounds":[],"in":[1],"kind":"perm_action","mem":[],"mut":[1,1],"tier":"q"}"#;
    // Rename by crossing existing local names. Both maps are (t,u,p) ->
    // (t XOR p,u,p); a name-based correspondence would exchange mut and in.
    let a = "perm_action @a (t:wire mut, u:wire mut) (p:wire in) () () ()\n^entry():\ncx p t";
    let id = "perm_action @id (p:wire mut, t:wire mut) (u:wire in) () () ()\n^entry():\ncx u p";
    let text = support::rehash(&support::object(
        &[("a", sig, a), ("id", sig, id)],
        "{}",
        "",
    ))
    .text;
    let claim = sol_positional_claim(
        "",
        "",
        r#"{"name":"u","width":1,"lo":0,"hi":1},{"name":"p","width":1,"lo":0,"hi":1},{"name":"t","width":1,"lo":0,"hi":1}"#,
    );
    assert_eq!(
        sol_positional_verdict(&text, &claim).unwrap(),
        ClaimVerdict::Proof
    );
    // Writing the second mutable slot instead must fail the full-tuple check.
    let wrong = support::rehash(&support::object(
        &[("a", sig, a), ("id", sig, &id.replace("cx u p", "cx u t"))],
        "{}",
        "",
    ))
    .text;
    assert!(sol_positional_verdict(&wrong, &claim)
        .unwrap_err()
        .to_string()
        .contains("§12.1"));
}

/// The hashes are derived without parsing the invalid uncertified subject.
fn r5_certified_lifetime(gate: &str) -> String {
    let (h, object_hash) = match gate {
        "x b" => (
            "3bc76b4398502416eed66400092c8ec2e5e273d97283b5199065a88a3ed9f1d7",
            "9b10654c083129047b847830d3582ff3dbf15cf7c8759f4586f836c02e5b6266",
        ),
        "cx b t" => (
            "1e0d1484447af491bd512ef5cc3cbe4f1b9532863aa56ae2149f61247973f343",
            "4aaf72716633ad6037e3b542f000eb31372accd743ddb97aa97d2960447ac43b",
        ),
        "cx t b" => (
            "020372af2df49bc56df0f37f08dfc7b58af2e258df9fb58da7010a7a8d3eb24a",
            "cb7ef9243fc8e1144a6863142a46e2969941940894e993bd2abddb685725f7cd",
        ),
        _ => panic!("test gate"),
    };
    let body = format!("qloop 2 {{\nb = qborrow any 1\n{gate}\nqreturn b\n}}");
    let text = support::borrow_lifetime_object(&body, &[2]).replace(&"0".repeat(64), h);
    let certified = support::certified_borrow_identity(&body, &[2]);
    assert_eq!(
        certified.split("\nsection certificate").next().unwrap(),
        text
    );
    let cert = json(certified.lines().last().unwrap());
    assert_eq!(
        cert.get("bindings")
            .unwrap()
            .get("object_hash")
            .unwrap()
            .string()
            .unwrap(),
        object_hash
    );
    certified
}

#[test]
fn sol_r5_b01_certificates_cannot_waive_completed_lifetimes() {
    for (i, gate) in ["x b", "cx b t"].iter().enumerate() {
        // Each beta_i is independent: X fails restoration, CX fails output
        // independence. Whole-loop parity is irrelevant to either obligation.
        let certified = r5_certified_lifetime(gate);
        for (j, text) in [
            certified.split("\nsection certificate").next().unwrap(),
            &certified,
        ]
        .iter()
        .enumerate()
        {
            support::reject_cli(text, "§5.6", &format!("r5-certified-{i}-{j}"));
        }
    }
}

#[test]
fn sol_r5_b01_library_replay_checks_boundaries_even_when_region_map_is_identity() {
    for gate in ["x b", "cx b t"] {
        let invalid = r5_certified_lifetime(gate);
        // Object's fields are public. Isolate verify_certificate from parse's
        // definite-failure guard by constructing the same compiled subject from
        // a valid paired-gate object, then installing the independently bound
        // invalid source/metadata. This tests the second admission defense.
        let valid = support::borrow_lifetime_object(
            &format!("qloop 2 {{\nb = qborrow any 1\n{gate}\n{gate}\nqreturn b\n}}"),
            &[2],
        );
        let mut o = Object::parse(&valid).unwrap();
        let f = o.functions.get_mut("a").unwrap();
        f.blocks[0].instructions[0].bodies[0].remove(2);
        f.lines = invalid
            .split("section functions\n")
            .nth(1)
            .unwrap()
            .split("\n\nsection certificate")
            .next()
            .unwrap()
            .lines()
            .map(str::to_string)
            .collect();
        o.metadata.insert(
            "symbols".into(),
            json(
                invalid
                    .split("section symbols\n")
                    .nth(1)
                    .unwrap()
                    .lines()
                    .next()
                    .unwrap(),
            ),
        );
        o.metadata
            .insert("certificate".into(), json(invalid.lines().last().unwrap()));
        o.text = invalid;
        let closure = o.identity().unwrap().closure_hashes["a"].clone().unwrap();
        assert_eq!(o.verify_claim(&closure, 0).unwrap(), ClaimVerdict::Proof);
        let error = o.verify_certificate().unwrap_err().to_string();
        assert!(
            error.contains("§5.6") && error.contains("qreturn"),
            "{error}"
        );
    }
    for body in [
        "qloop 2 {\nb = qborrow any 1\nx b\nx b\nqreturn b\n}",
        "qloop 2 {\nb = qborrow any 1\ncx b t\ncx b t\nqreturn b\n}",
        "b = qborrow any 1\nqloop 2 {\ncx b t\n}\nqreturn b",
    ] {
        let o = Object::parse(&support::certified_borrow_identity(body, &[2])).unwrap();
        assert_eq!(
            o.verify_certificate().unwrap()[0].verdict,
            ClaimVerdict::Proof
        );
        support::borrow_identity(&o);
    }
}

#[test]
fn sol_r5_b01_certificate_return_checks_keep_quantum_surrounding_state() {
    // Each borrowed frame is identity even though t is a superposition at
    // qreturn. Auditing the classical values of all other wires would narrow
    // this valid action; compare their exact quantum state instead.
    for body in [
        "h t\nb = qborrow any 1\nx b\nx b\nqreturn b\nh t",
        "b = qborrow any 1\nx b\nx b\nh t\nh t\nx b\nx b\nqreturn b",
    ] {
        let o = Object::parse(&support::certified_borrow_identity_kind(
            body,
            &[],
            "action",
        ))
        .unwrap();
        assert_eq!(
            o.verify_certificate().unwrap()[0].verdict,
            ClaimVerdict::Proof
        );
        support::borrow_identity(&o);
    }
}

#[test]
fn sol_r5_b01_library_replay_checks_frames_before_nonpermutation_boundaries() {
    for gate in ["x b", "cx b t"] {
        let body = format!("b = qborrow any 1\n{gate}\nh t\nh t\n{gate}\nqreturn b");
        let invalid = support::certified_borrow_identity_kind(&body, &[], "action");
        let valid = support::borrow_lifetime_object(
            &format!("b = qborrow any 1\n{gate}\n{gate}\nh t\nh t\n{gate}\n{gate}\nqreturn b"),
            &[],
        )
        .replace("perm_action", "action");
        let mut o = Object::parse(&valid).unwrap();
        let f = o.functions.get_mut("a").unwrap();
        f.blocks[0].instructions.remove(6);
        f.blocks[0].instructions.remove(2);
        f.lines = invalid
            .split("section functions\n")
            .nth(1)
            .unwrap()
            .split("\n\nsection certificate")
            .next()
            .unwrap()
            .lines()
            .map(str::to_string)
            .collect();
        o.metadata.insert(
            "symbols".into(),
            json(
                invalid
                    .split("section symbols\n")
                    .nth(1)
                    .unwrap()
                    .lines()
                    .next()
                    .unwrap(),
            ),
        );
        o.metadata
            .insert("certificate".into(), json(invalid.lines().last().unwrap()));
        o.text = invalid;
        let closure = o.identity().unwrap().closure_hashes["a"].clone().unwrap();
        assert_eq!(o.verify_claim(&closure, 0).unwrap(), ClaimVerdict::Proof);
        assert!(o
            .verify_certificate()
            .unwrap_err()
            .to_string()
            .contains("§5.6"));
    }
}

#[test]
fn codex_r5_b01_exact_three_certified_lifetime_witnesses() {
    for (i, gate) in ["x b", "cx b t", "cx t b"].iter().enumerate() {
        let exact = r5_certified_lifetime(gate);
        for (j, text) in [exact.split("\nsection certificate").next().unwrap(), &exact]
            .iter()
            .enumerate()
        {
            support::reject_cli(text, "§5.6", &format!("codex-r5-b01-{i}-{j}"));
        }
        // No lifetime may borrow a future lifetime's parity cancellation.
        for (j, (body, bounds)) in [
            (format!("b = qborrow any 1\n{gate}\nqreturn b"), vec![]),
            (
                format!("qloop 2 {{\nqloop 2 {{\nb = qborrow any 1\n{gate}\nqreturn b\n}}\n}}"),
                vec![2, 2],
            ),
        ]
        .iter()
        .enumerate()
        {
            support::reject_cli(
                &support::certified_borrow_identity(body, bounds),
                "§5.6",
                &format!("codex-r5-b01-more-{i}-{j}"),
            );
        }
    }
}

fn codex_r5_install_subject(invalid: &str, body: &str) -> Object {
    // Parse a legal shape, then reconstruct public fields to isolate the
    // certificate API's checks from load-time admission.
    let valid = support::borrow_lifetime_object(body, &[]).replace("perm_action", "action");
    let mut o = Object::parse(&valid.replace("cz b ", "x ")).unwrap();
    for i in &mut o.functions.get_mut("a").unwrap().blocks[0].instructions {
        if i.op == "x" {
            i.op = "cz".into();
            i.operands.insert(0, "b".into());
        }
    }
    o.functions.get_mut("a").unwrap().lines = invalid
        .split("section functions\n")
        .nth(1)
        .unwrap()
        .split("\n\nsection certificate")
        .next()
        .unwrap()
        .lines()
        .map(str::to_string)
        .collect();
    o.metadata.insert(
        "symbols".into(),
        json(
            invalid
                .split("section symbols\n")
                .nth(1)
                .unwrap()
                .lines()
                .next()
                .unwrap(),
        ),
    );
    o.metadata
        .insert("certificate".into(), json(invalid.lines().last().unwrap()));
    o.text = invalid.into();
    o
}

#[test]
fn codex_r5_b02_exact_cz_certificate_cannot_admit_a_nonpermutation_frame() {
    let body = "b = qborrow any 1\ncz b t\nqreturn b";
    let exact = support::certified_borrow_identity_kind(body, &[], "action");
    let cert = json(exact.lines().last().unwrap());
    let bindings = cert.get("bindings").unwrap();
    assert_eq!(
        bindings.get("interface_hash").unwrap().string().unwrap(),
        "26374c7b2da2747a9a755d48da06130bfa53e8ba67102e4749fa1cb8adc2f1a0"
    );
    assert_eq!(
        bindings.get("object_hash").unwrap().string().unwrap(),
        "2340cad379662fdcec0e7664aa161a667d77294eee1da295bced60916553158d"
    );
    for (i, text) in [
        exact.split("\nsection certificate").next().unwrap(),
        &exact,
        &exact.replace("\"borrow_frames\":[0]", "\"borrow_frames\":[]"),
    ]
    .iter()
    .enumerate()
    {
        support::reject_cli(text, "§5.6", &format!("codex-r5-b02-{i}"));
    }
    // Public API: a full tuple claim alone is not a T3 proof. Even a pair of
    // illegal phase touches which cancels in the final unitary must fail the
    // mandatory permutation-only gate-boundary premise, independently of replay.
    for body in [
        body,
        "b = qborrow any 1\ncz b t\ncz b t\nqreturn b",
        "c = qalloc any 1\nb = qborrow any 1\ncz b c\ncz b c\nqfree c\nqreturn b",
    ] {
        let invalid = support::certified_borrow_identity_kind(body, &[], "action");
        let o = codex_r5_install_subject(&invalid, body);
        let error = o
            .verify_certificate()
            .expect_err("nonpermutation borrow frame certified");
        assert!(error.to_string().contains("§5.6"), "{error}");
    }
    // Quantum phase witness, not integer basis labels: CZ|++> has -1/2 at 11.
    let o = codex_r5_install_subject(&exact, body);
    let mut q = bennett_isa_ref::QuantumState::new();
    let w = q.allocate(2).unwrap();
    for wire in &w {
        q.gate("h", &[*wire], None, &[]).unwrap();
    }
    let mut b = bennett_isa_ref::QuantumBindings::default();
    b.bundles.insert("t".into(), vec![w[0]]);
    b.borrowed.push(vec![w[1]]);
    o.execute_action("a", &mut q, &b, false, &[]).unwrap();
    for (bits, (re, im)) in q.exact_support() {
        assert_eq!(re, if bits == [true, true] { -0.5 } else { 0.5 });
        assert_eq!(im, 0.0);
    }
    // Non-permutation gates on unrelated wires remain legal, including when
    // t is superposed at the frame's entry or return.
    for body in [
        "h t\nb = qborrow any 1\nx b\nx b\nqreturn b\nh t",
        "b = qborrow any 1\nh t\nx b\nx b\nh t\nqreturn b",
    ] {
        let o = Object::parse(&support::certified_borrow_identity_kind(
            body,
            &[],
            "action",
        ))
        .unwrap();
        assert_eq!(
            o.verify_certificate().unwrap()[0].verdict,
            ClaimVerdict::Proof
        );
        support::borrow_identity(&o);
    }
}

#[test]
fn muse_r5_translation_frame_maximality_is_within_its_static_sequence() {
    // Two pre-loop borrowed touches form an identity frame. Each iteration's
    // complete translation frame is maximal within its own static body.
    let text = sol_translation_object("cx p b\ncx b t\ncx p b\ncx b t", true).replace(
        "b = qborrow any 1\nqloop",
        "b = qborrow any 1\ncx p b\ncx p b\nqloop",
    );
    let text = support::rehash(&text).text;
    sol_assert_translation(&text, &sol_translation_claim(&text, 4, 7, 4, 5, "b"), true);
}

#[test]
fn r17_sample_count_default_replays_and_present_values_validate() {
    let base = swap_frame(1);
    let domain = r#"{"bundles":[{"name":"t","width":1,"lo":0,"hi":1},{"name":"x","width":1,"lo":0,"hi":1}],"borrowed":[{"name":"b","width":1,"lo":0,"hi":1}],"regions":[]}"#;
    let mut sampler = json(r#"{"algorithm":"xoshiro256**","seed":["1","2","3","4"]}"#);
    for count in [None, Some(0), Some(3)] {
        if let Some(count) = count {
            let Json::Object(fields) = &mut sampler else {
                unreachable!()
            };
            fields.insert("count".into(), json(&count.to_string()));
        }
        let claim = format!(
            r#"{{"kind":"sampled","domain":{domain},"sampler":{}}}"#,
            sampler.canonical()
        );
        let text = certificate(&base, 1, &claim, "");
        let o = Object::parse(&text).unwrap();
        let closure = o.identity().unwrap().closure_hashes["a"].clone().unwrap();
        assert_eq!(
            o.verify_claim(&closure, 0).unwrap(),
            ClaimVerdict::Evidence {
                elements: count.unwrap_or(65536)
            }
        );
        assert_eq!(o.text, text);
    }
    for bad in ["null", "{}", "-1", r#""invalid""#] {
        let Json::Object(fields) = &mut sampler else {
            unreachable!()
        };
        fields.insert("count".into(), json(bad));
        let claim = format!(
            r#"{{"kind":"sampled","domain":{domain},"sampler":{}}}"#,
            sampler.canonical()
        );
        let error = Object::parse(&certificate(&base, 1, &claim, "")).unwrap_err();
        assert!(error.to_string().contains("§12.1"), "{error}");
    }
}
````

````rust
//! Council round 1: fable R1-B3, codex B03, B04, B05, muse B5 (§6.1, §6.2, §4.6, §5.1).
mod support;
use bennett_isa_ref::{Object, QuantumBindings, QuantumState};
use support::object;

const TWO_MUT: &str = r#"{"abi":"0.8","args":[],"bounds":[],"in":[],"kind":"action","mem":[],"mut":[1,1],"tier":"q"}"#;
fn two_mut(body: &str) -> String {
    object(
        &[(
            "a",
            TWO_MUT,
            &format!("action @a (t:wire mut, m:wire mut) () () () ()\n^entry():\n{body}"),
        )],
        "{}",
        "",
    )
}
/// action @a (t:wire mut) (p:wire in), with optional loop bounds.
fn action(body: &str, bounds: &[u64]) -> String {
    let values = bounds.iter().map(u64::to_string).collect::<Vec<_>>();
    let signature = format!(
        r#"{{"abi":"0.8","args":[],"bounds":[{}],"in":[1],"kind":"action","mem":[],"mut":[1],"tier":"q"}}"#,
        values.join(",")
    );
    let regs = if bounds.is_empty() {
        String::new()
    } else {
        format!("regs {{  }} bounds {{{}}}\n", values.join(", "))
    };
    object(
        &[(
            "a",
            &signature,
            &format!("action @a (t:wire mut) (p:wire in) () () ()\n{regs}^entry():\n{body}"),
        )],
        "{}",
        "",
    )
}
fn reject(text: &str, rule: &str) {
    match Object::parse(text) {
        Err(e) => assert!(e.to_string().contains(rule), "{e} must cite {rule}"),
        Ok(_) => panic!("ill-formed cleanup accepted:\n{text}"),
    }
}
fn accept(text: &str) -> Object {
    Object::parse(text).unwrap_or_else(|e| panic!("{e}\n{text}"))
}
/// Executes @a forward and adjoint on every basis input of (t, p) and checks
/// the stated map, the absence of workspace and the exact adjoint.
fn run_basis(o: &Object, map: impl Fn(u128, u128) -> u128) {
    for t in 0..2u128 {
        for p in 0..2u128 {
            let mut q = QuantumState::new();
            let tw = q.allocate(1).unwrap();
            let pw = q.allocate(1).unwrap();
            if t == 1 {
                q.gate("x", &tw, None, &[]).unwrap();
            }
            if p == 1 {
                q.gate("x", &pw, None, &[]).unwrap();
            }
            let before = q.clone();
            let mut b = QuantumBindings::default();
            b.bundles.insert("t".into(), tw.clone());
            b.bundles.insert("p".into(), pw.clone());
            o.execute_action("a", &mut q, &b, false, &[]).unwrap();
            assert_eq!(q.read_basis(&tw).unwrap(), map(t, p), "t={t} p={p}");
            assert_eq!(q.read_basis(&pw).unwrap(), p);
            assert_eq!(q.wire_count(), 2, "no workspace survives");
            o.execute_action("a", &mut q, &b, true, &[]).unwrap();
            assert_eq!(q, before);
        }
    }
}

#[test]
fn fable_r1_b3_predicate_flip_closes_the_window() {
    // §6.1 qcopy: S = {s} ∪ Π; §6.2 window closes on a permutation change to a
    // wire in S not undone before the cleanup. On m=1,t=1: d=1, m flips to 0,
    // the cleanup is disabled and d is released dirty.
    reject(
        &two_mut("qpred m\nd = qcopy t\nqunpred m\nx m\nqpred m\nquncopy t d\nqunpred m"),
        "§6.2",
    );
    reject(
        &two_mut("d = qalloc any 1\nqpred m\ncx t d\nqunpred m\nx m\nqpred m\ncx t d\nqunpred m\nqfree d"),
        "§6.2",
    );
    accept(&two_mut(
        "qpred m\nd = qcopy t\nqunpred m\nx m\nx m\nqpred m\nquncopy t d\nqunpred m",
    ));
    accept(&two_mut(
        "qpred m\nd = qcopy t\nqunpred m\nqpred m\nquncopy t d\nqunpred m\nx m",
    ));
}

#[test]
fn codex_b03_predicate_versions_and_windows_start_at_the_computation() {

    );
    // A non-diagonal gate before the computation does not close a later window.
    let o = accept(&action("h t\nh t\nd = qcopy t\nquncopy t d", &[]));
    run_basis(&o, |t, _| t);

fn codex_b05_quantum_memory_cleanup_and_restoration() {

    reject(&action("qregion r 1 1\nqstore r p t", &[]), "§5.1");
    let o = accept(&action(
        "qregion r 1 1\nd = qload r p\ncx d t\nqunload r p d",

    reject(

    reject(
        &tmp("d0 = qalloc any 1\nd1 = qcopy m\nh d0\ncx d0 d1\nqpred d1\nx t\nqunpred d1\ncx d0 d1\nh d0\nquncopy m d1\nqfree d0"),

    reject(
        &tmp("d0 = qalloc any 1\nd1 = qcopy t\nh d0\ncx d0 d1\ncz d1 t\ncx d0 d1\nh d0\nquncopy t d1\nqfree d0"),
        "§6.2",

    // (4) a flipped effective-control wire between t and tdg on an `other` value.
    reject(
        &tmp("d0 = qalloc any 1\nry 0.75 d0\nqpred t\nqpred m\nt d0\nqunpred m\nqunpred t\nx t\nqpred t\nqpred m\ntdg d0\nqunpred m\nqunpred t\nry -0.75 d0\nqfree d0"),
        "§6.2",
    );
    // Positive controls: the readers are undone before the adjoint.
    accept(&tmp("d0 = qalloc any 1\nd1 = qcopy p\nh d0\nccx d0 p d1\ncx d1 t\ncx d1 t\nccx d0 p d1\nh d0\nquncopy p d1\nqfree d0"));
    accept(&tmp("d0 = qalloc any 1\nd1 = qcopy t\nh d0\ncx d0 d1\ncz d1 t\ncz d1 t\ncx d0 d1\nh d0\nquncopy t d1\nqfree d0"));
}

#[test]
fn r2_exchanges_preserve_transitive_entangling_read_dependencies() {
    for exchange in ["swap", "qexch"] {
        let body =
            format!("d = qalloc any 1\nh d\n{exchange} d m\ncx m t\n{exchange} d m\nh d\nqfree d");
        reject(&tmp(&body), "§6.2");
        let good = body.replace("cx m t", "cx m t\ncx m t");
        run_three_identity(&accept(&tmp(&good)));
    }
    let body = "qregion r 1 1\nd = qalloc any 1\nh d\nqexchm r p d\nz = qload r p\ncx z t\nqunload r p z\nqexchm r p d\nh d\nqfree d";
    reject(&tmp(body), "§6.2");
    run_three_identity(&accept(&tmp(&body.replace("cx z t", "cx z t\ncx z t"))));
}
fn run_three_identity(o: &Object) {
    for input in 0..9u32 {
        let mut q = QuantumState::new();
        let wires = q.allocate(3).unwrap();
        for (bit, w) in wires.iter().enumerate() {
            if input == 8 {
                q.gate("h", &[*w], None, &[]).unwrap();
            } else if input >> bit & 1 == 1 {
                q.gate("x", &[*w], None, &[]).unwrap();
            }
        }
        let before = q.clone();
        let mut b = QuantumBindings::default();
        for (n, w) in ["t", "m", "p"].iter().zip(&wires) {
            b.bundles.insert((*n).into(), vec![*w]);
        }
        o.execute_action("a", &mut q, &b, false, &[]).unwrap();
        assert_eq!(q, before);
        o.execute_action("a", &mut q, &b, true, &[]).unwrap();
        assert_eq!(q, before);
    }
}

fn r3_action_calls_transfer_the_old_joint_dependencies() {
    let cs = r#"{"abi":"0.8","args":[],"bounds":[],"in":[],"kind":"perm_action","mem":[],"mut":[1,1],"tier":"q"}"#;

    let body = "d = qalloc any 1\nh d\naction_call @child (d, m) () () ()\ncx m t\nadj action_call @child (d, m) () () ()\nh d\nqfree d";
    let build = |body: &str| {

    let cs = r#"{"abi":"0.8","args":[],"bounds":[],"in":[1],"kind":"perm_action","mem":[{"A":1,"W":1,"role":"mut"}],"mut":[1],"tier":"q"}"#;

    let ps = r#"{"abi":"0.8","args":[],"bounds":[],"in":[1],"kind":"action","mem":[],"mut":[1,1],"tier":"q"}"#;
    let body = "qregion r 1 1\nd = qalloc any 1\nh d\naction_call @child (d) (p) (r) ()\nz = qload r p\ncx z t\nqunload r p z\nadj action_call @child (d) (p) (r) ()\nh d\nqfree d";
    let build = |body: &str| {
        support::object(&[("child",cs,child),("a",ps,&format!("action @a (t:wire mut, m:wire mut) (p:wire in) () () ()\n^entry():\n{body}"))],"{}", "\nsection layout\n{\"A_tab\":0,\"H\":0,\"S_cells\":0,\"globals\":{},\"heap_base\":1,\"heap_limit_max\":0,\"interface_regions\":{},\"null_size\":1,\"ptr_width\":32}\n")
    };
    reject(&build(body), "§6.2");
    run_three_identity(&accept(&build(&body.replace("cx z t", "cx z t\ncx z t"))));
}
````

## `tests/r1_exact.rs` (123 lines)

````rust
//! Council round 1: codex B15 (clean release decided exactly, no 1e-24 threshold).
mod support;
use bennett_isa_ref::{ClassicalMachine, Object, QuantumState};

#[test]
fn b15_tiny_rotation_is_not_clean_and_release_changes_nothing() {
    // ry(1e-13)|0> = cos(5e-14)|0> + sin(5e-14)|1>; sin(5e-14) != 0.
    let mut q = QuantumState::new();
    let w = q.allocate(1).unwrap();
    q.gate("ry", &w, Some(1e-13), &[]).unwrap();
    let before = q.clone();
    let e = q.release(&w).unwrap_err().to_string();
    assert!(e.contains("E_QREG_NOT_CLEAN"), "{e}");
    assert_eq!(q, before);
    assert_eq!(q.wire_count(), 1);
    // Even 1e-300: the exact shadow is not a tolerance.
    let mut q = QuantumState::new();
    let w = q.allocate(1).unwrap();
    q.gate("rx", &w, Some(1e-300), &[]).unwrap();
    assert!(q.release(&w).is_err());
}

#[test]
fn b15_exact_adjoints_release_cleanly() {
    for theta in [0.7, 1e-13, -2.5, std::f64::consts::TAU, 1e-300] {
        for gate in ["rx", "ry", "rz"] {
            let mut q = QuantumState::new();
            let w = q.allocate(2).unwrap();
            q.gate("h", &w[..1], None, &[]).unwrap();
            q.gate(gate, &w[1..], Some(theta), &[w[0]]).unwrap();
            q.gate(gate, &w[1..], Some(-theta), &[w[0]]).unwrap();
            q.gate("h", &w[..1], None, &[]).unwrap();
            q.release(&w)
                .unwrap_or_else(|e| panic!("{gate}({theta}): {e}"));
        }
    }
    // h t h ; h tdg h is the identity exactly (sqrt 2 and e^{i pi/4} arithmetic).
    let mut q = QuantumState::new();
    let w = q.allocate(1).unwrap();
    for g in ["h", "t", "h", "h", "tdg", "h"] {
        q.gate(g, &w, None, &[]).unwrap();
    }
    q.release(&w).unwrap();
    // s s s s = I; h s h has the exactly nonzero |1> amplitude (1 - i)/2.
    let mut q = QuantumState::new();
    let w = q.allocate(1).unwrap();
    for g in ["h", "s", "h"] {
        q.gate(g, &w, None, &[]).unwrap();
    }
    assert!(q.release(&w).is_err());
}

#[test]
fn b15_cc_free_of_an_almost_clean_register_traps() {
    let rot_sig = r#"{"abi":"0.8","args":[],"bounds":[],"in":[],"kind":"action","mem":[],"mut":[1],"tier":"q"}"#;
    let cc_sig = r#"{"abi":"0.8","kind":"cc","params":[],"results":[],"tier":"cc"}"#;
    let rot = "action @rot (t:wire mut) () () () ()\n^entry():\nry 1e-13 t";
    let main = |calls: &str| {
        format!(
            "fn cc @main () () () () ()\n^entry():\nq = qreg.new any 1\n{calls}qreg.free q\nret"
        )
    };
    let unclean = support::rehash(&support::object(
        &[
            ("rot", rot_sig, rot),
            ("main", cc_sig, &main("action_call @rot (q) () () ()\n")),
        ],
        "{}",
        "",
    ));
    let mut m = ClassicalMachine::new(&unclean, "main", &[], &[]).unwrap();
    let r = m.run(10).unwrap();
    // §3.3: an instruction whose precondition fails is a CC trap (FAULT_UB_TRAP).
    assert_eq!(r.fault, Some(4));
    assert!(r.trapped);
    // The handle is still live: the failed free consumed nothing.
    assert_eq!(m.quantum_registers().quantum_state().wire_count(), 1);
    let clean = support::rehash(&support::object(
        &[
            ("rot", rot_sig, rot),
            (
                "main",
                cc_sig,
                &main("action_call @rot (q) () () ()\nadj action_call @rot (q) () () ()\n"),
            ),
        ],
        "{}",
        "",
    ));
    let mut m = ClassicalMachine::new(&clean, "main", &[], &[]).unwrap();
    let entry = m.snapshot();
    let r = m.run(10).unwrap();
    assert_eq!(r.fault, None);
    m.reverse().unwrap();
    assert_eq!(m.snapshot(), entry);
    let _ = Object::parse;
}

#[test]
fn superpositions_have_no_wire_limit() {
    // The former simulator refused more than 24 live wires in a superposition.
    // A 200-wire GHZ state: h on wire 0, then a cx chain; two components.
    let mut q = QuantumState::new();
    let w = q.allocate(200).unwrap();
    q.gate("h", &w[..1], None, &[]).unwrap();
    for i in 1..200 {
        q.gate("cx", &[w[i - 1], w[i]], None, &[]).unwrap();
    }
    assert_eq!(q.exact_support().len(), 2);
    let branches = q.measurement_branches(&w[..1]).unwrap();
    assert_eq!(branches.len(), 2);
    for b in &branches {
        assert!((b.probability - 0.5).abs() < 1e-12);
        // The other 199 wires equal the measured bit on its branch.
        let rest = b.state.read_basis(&w[1..129]).unwrap();
        assert_eq!(rest, if b.bits[0] { u128::MAX } else { 0 });
    }
    for i in (1..200).rev() {
        q.gate("cx", &[w[i - 1], w[i]], None, &[]).unwrap();
    }
    q.gate("h", &w[..1], None, &[]).unwrap();
    q.release(&w).unwrap();
}
````

//! Council round 1: codex B18 (a fixture audit that audits every fixture), and
//! fable's suggestion that the §16.3 fixtures equal the spec text byte for byte.
mod support;
use bennett_isa_ref::Object;
use std::path::PathBuf;

#[test]
fn r11_qinplace_comment_matches_budget_contract() {
    let expected = "Hand: for B >= 1, @o is the one-step identity permutation, both qinplace rows are I, H^2=I, and CX(0,b)=I_bR. B=0 rejects under §4.5 because the oracle faults; it is not an identity run.\n";
    assert_eq!(include_str!("fixtures/r9-sol-qinplace.comments"), expected);
    let o = Object::parse(support::r9_fixture("sol-qinplace")).unwrap();
    o.check_hashes().unwrap();
    support::r9_identity(
        &o,
        &[bennett_isa_ref::Argument::Token(
            bennett_isa_ref::Budget::steps(1),
        )],
    );
    let path =
        PathBuf::from(env!("CARGO_MANIFEST_DIR")).join("tests/fixtures/r9-sol-qinplace.bisa");
    for t in ["0", "1"] {
        for budget in ["token:0,0,0,0", "token:1,0,0,0"] {
            let out = std::process::Command::new(env!("CARGO_BIN_EXE_bennett-isa-ref"))
                .args([
                    "run-action",
                    path.to_str().unwrap(),
                    "a",
                    "--mut",
                    t,
                    "--arg",
                    budget,
                ])
                .output()
                .unwrap();
            if budget == "token:0,0,0,0" {
                assert_eq!(out.status.code(), Some(1));
                assert!(out.stdout.is_empty());
                assert!(String::from_utf8_lossy(&out.stderr).contains("§4.5"));
            } else {
                assert!(out.status.success(), "{out:?}");
                let v = support::json(std::str::from_utf8(&out.stdout).unwrap());
                assert_eq!(
                    v.get("state").unwrap().canonical(),
                    format!(r#"{{"{t}":[1,0]}}"#)
                );
                assert_eq!(v.get("wires").unwrap().uint().unwrap(), 1);
            }
        }
    }
}

fn fixtures() -> Vec<PathBuf> {
    let dir = PathBuf::from(env!("CARGO_MANIFEST_DIR")).join("tests/fixtures");
    let mut out: Vec<_> = std::fs::read_dir(dir)
        .unwrap()
        .map(|e| e.unwrap().path())
        .filter(|p| p.extension().is_some_and(|x| x == "bisa"))
        .collect();
    out.sort();
    out
}

#[test]
fn b18_every_bisa_file_is_audited_and_has_a_comments_file() {
    let all = fixtures();
    // Inventory: the audit covers whatever is committed, never a hand list.
    assert!(all.len() >= 12, "fixture inventory shrank: {all:?}");
    for path in &all {
        let text = std::fs::read_to_string(path).unwrap();
        Object::parse(&text)
            .unwrap_or_else(|e| panic!("{}: {e}", path.display()))
            .check_hashes()
            .unwrap_or_else(|e| panic!("{}: {e}", path.display()));
        assert!(
            path.with_extension("comments").exists(),
            "{} lacks its hand-derived .comments file",
            path.display()
        );
    }
}

#[test]
fn b18_a_corrupted_stored_hash_is_detected_by_the_same_audit() {
    let path = fixtures()
        .into_iter()
        .find(|p| p.ends_with("tiny_memory.bisa"))
        .unwrap();
    let text = std::fs::read_to_string(path).unwrap();
    let start = text.find("\"interface_hash\":\"").unwrap() + 18;
    let mut corrupted = text.clone();
    let flipped = if &text[start..start + 1] == "0" {
        "1"
    } else {
        "0"
    };
    corrupted.replace_range(start..start + 1, flipped);
    let o = Object::parse(&corrupted).unwrap();
    assert!(o.check_hashes().unwrap_err().to_string().contains("§9.2"));
}

/// The n-th fenced block after `marker` in the specification.
fn spec_block(marker: &str, n: usize) -> String {
    let spec = std::fs::read_to_string(
        PathBuf::from(env!("CARGO_MANIFEST_DIR")).join("../spec/Bennett-ISA-Spec.md"),
    )
    .unwrap();
    let mut rest = &spec[spec.find(marker).unwrap()..];
    let mut block = String::new();
    for _ in 0..=n {
        let open = rest.find("```\n").unwrap() + 4;
        let close = rest[open..].find("```").unwrap() + open;
        block = rest[open..close].to_string();
        rest = &rest[close + 3..];
    }
    block
}

#[test]
fn published_example_objects_are_the_fixtures_byte_for_byte() {
    assert_eq!(
        spec_block("**Example 1** (`inc8`)", 0),
        include_str!("fixtures/inc8.bisa")
    );
    assert_eq!(
        spec_block("**Example 2** (`sum_db`)", 0),
        include_str!("fixtures/sum_db.bisa")
    );
}

#[test]
fn r10_independent_effective_control_and_grammar_pins() {
    for tag in ["controls", "duplicate", "cc", "r", "omitted-bounds"] {
        support::r10_pin(tag);
    }
    // Rejected objects still retain their literal byte digests. They must not
    // be silently rewritten into legal objects before hashing.
    for tag in [
        "bare-cc",
        "bare-r",
        "empty-bounds",
        "fn-oracle",
        "inc-empty-bounds",
        "empty-lhs",
    ] {
        let c = support::r10_case(tag);
        assert_eq!(
            bennett_isa_ref::sha256_hex(support::r10_text(tag).as_bytes()),
            c.get("object_hash").unwrap().string().unwrap()
        );
    }
}

#[test]
fn r11_control_flow_pins_match_literal_envelopes() {
    let pins = support::json(include_str!("support/r11_control_flow_pins.json"));
    let o = Object::parse(include_str!("fixtures/control_flow.bisa")).unwrap();
    let id = o.identity().unwrap();
    assert_eq!(
        id.object_hash,
        pins.get("object_hash").unwrap().string().unwrap()
    );
    for (name, env) in pins.get("envelopes").unwrap().object().unwrap() {
        let env = env.string().unwrap();
        assert_eq!(id.envelopes[name], env);
        let h = bennett_isa_ref::sha256_hex(env.as_bytes());
        assert_eq!(
            h,
            pins.get("hashes")
                .unwrap()
                .get(name)
                .unwrap()
                .string()
                .unwrap()
        );
        assert_eq!(id.interface_hashes[name], h);
        assert_eq!(id.closure_hashes[name].as_deref(), Some(h.as_str()));
    }
    for tag in ["rounded-probe", "exact-probe"] {
        support::r11_pin(tag);
    }
}

## `tests/r1_fuzz_discipline.rs` (1782 lines)

````rust
//! Differential soundness check of the §6 static discipline against the exact
//! §14.2 simulator: every randomly generated action that `Object::parse`
//! accepts must, on every basis input of its interface and on a superposed
//! input, release its workspace exactly clean (§4.3 qfree, §6.3 T5) and
//! restore its local state. A failure prints the witness program.
mod support;
use bennett_isa_ref::{Object, QuantumBindings, QuantumState};

struct Rng(u64);
impl Rng {
    fn next(&mut self) -> u64 {
        // xorshift64*
        self.0 ^= self.0 >> 12;
        self.0 ^= self.0 << 25;
        self.0 ^= self.0 >> 27;
        self.0.wrapping_mul(0x2545_f491_4f6c_dd1d)
    }
    fn below(&mut self, n: u64) -> u64 {
        self.next() % n
    }
    fn chance(&mut self, percent: u64) -> bool {
        self.below(100) < percent
    }
}
#[derive(Clone)]
struct Op {
    line: String,
    adjoint: String,
}
fn op(line: &str, adjoint: &str) -> Op {
    Op {
        line: line.into(),
        adjoint: adjoint.into(),
    }
}
/// A gate on workspace wire `d`, controlled from `controls`.
fn compute_op(r: &mut Rng, d: &str, controls: &[String]) -> Op {
    let c = |r: &mut Rng| controls[r.below(controls.len() as u64) as usize].clone();
    match r.below(16) {
        0 => op(&format!("x {d}"), &format!("x {d}")),
        1 | 2 => {
            let c1 = c(r);
            op(&format!("cx {c1} {d}"), &format!("cx {c1} {d}"))
        }
        3 => {
            let (c1, c2) = (c(r), c(r));
            if c1 == c2 {
                op(&format!("cx {c1} {d}"), &format!("cx {c1} {d}"))
            } else {
                op(&format!("ccx {c1} {c2} {d}"), &format!("ccx {c1} {c2} {d}"))
            }
        }
        4 => op(&format!("h {d}"), &format!("h {d}")),
        5 => op(&format!("t {d}"), &format!("tdg {d}")),
        6 => op(&format!("s {d}"), &format!("sdg {d}")),
        7 => op(&format!("rz 0.5 {d}"), &format!("rz -0.5 {d}")),
        8 => op(&format!("ry 0.75 {d}"), &format!("ry -0.75 {d}")),
        9 => {
            let c1 = c(r);
            let (a, b) = (compute_op(r, d, controls), compute_op(r, d, controls));
            op(
                &format!("qif {c1} {{\n{}\n}} {{\n{}\n}}", a.line, b.line),
                &format!("qif {c1} {{\n{}\n}} {{\n{}\n}}", a.adjoint, b.adjoint),
            )
        }
        10 => {
            let n = r.below(4);
            let a = compute_op(r, d, controls);
            op(
                &format!("qloop {n} {{\n{}\n}}", a.line),
                &format!("qloop {n} {{\n{}\n}}", a.adjoint),
            )
        }
        11 => {
            let (c1, c2) = (c(r), c(r));
            let a = compute_op(r, d, controls);
            if c1 == c2 {
                return a;
            }
            op(
                &format!(
                    "qpred {c1}\nqpred {c2}\n{}\nqunpred {c2}\nqunpred {c1}",
                    a.line
                ),
                &format!(
                    "qpred {c1}\nqpred {c2}\n{}\nqunpred {c2}\nqunpred {c1}",
                    a.adjoint
                ),
            )
        }
        13 | 14 => {
            let c1 = c(r);
            let gate = if r.chance(50) { "swap" } else { "qexch" };
            let line = format!("{gate} {d} {c1}");
            op(&line, &line)
        }
        15 => {
            let line = format!("qexchm r p {d}");
            op(&line, &line)
        }
        _ => {
            let c1 = c(r);
            op(
                &format!("qpred {c1}\nx {d}\nqunpred {c1}"),
                &format!("qpred {c1}\nx {d}\nqunpred {c1}"),
            )
        }
    }
}
/// A middle operation: reads workspace into the interface, or disturbs it.
fn middle_op(r: &mut Rng, work: &[String]) -> String {
    let d = &work[r.below(work.len() as u64) as usize];
    match r.below(23) {
        0..=2 => format!("cx {d} t"),
        3 => format!("s {d}"),
        4 => "x t".into(),
        5 => "h t".into(),
        6 => format!("qpred {d}\nx t\nqunpred {d}"),
        7 => "s p".into(),
        8 => format!("qif {d} {{\nx t\n}} {{\ns t\n}}"),
        9 => "x m".into(),
        10 => "h m".into(),
        11 => format!("cx {d} m"),
        12 => "qxor t m".into(),
        13 => "qexch t m".into(),
        14 => format!("ry 0.25 {d}"),
        15 => "qstore r p t".into(),
        16 => format!("qstore r {d} t\nqstore r {d} t"),
        17 => format!("qstore r p {d}\nqstore r p {d}"),
        18 => format!("qloop 2 {{\ncx {d} t\n}}"),
        20 => format!("swap {d} m"),
        21 => format!("qexch {d} m"),
        22 => format!("qexchm r p {d}"),
        _ => format!("cz {d} t"),
    }
}
fn mutate(r: &mut Rng, uncompute: &mut Vec<String>) {
    if uncompute.is_empty() {
        return;
    }
    let i = r.below(uncompute.len() as u64) as usize;
    match r.below(4) {
        0 => {
            uncompute.remove(i);
        }
        1 if uncompute.len() > 1 => {
            let j = (i + 1) % uncompute.len();
            uncompute.swap(i, j);
        }
        2 => {
            uncompute[i] = uncompute[i]
                .replace(" t\n", " p\n")
                .replace("cx t ", "cx p ")
        }
        _ => uncompute.insert(i, "x t".into()),
    }
}
fn program(r: &mut Rng) -> (String, Vec<u64>) {
    let mut lines = Vec::new();
    let mut work: Vec<String> = Vec::new();
    let mut releases = Vec::new();
    let mut compute = Vec::new();
    let count = 1 + r.below(2) as usize;
    for k in 0..count {
        let d = format!("d{k}");
        match r.below(4) {
            0 => {
                let s = ["t", "m", "p"][r.below(3) as usize];
                lines.push(format!("{d} = qcopy {s}"));
                releases.push(format!("quncopy {s} {d}"));
            }
            1 => {
                let a = ["t", "m", "p"][r.below(3) as usize];
                lines.push(format!("{d} = qload r {a}"));
                releases.push(format!("qunload r {a} {d}"));
            }
            _ => {
                lines.push(format!("{d} = qalloc any 1"));
                releases.push(format!("qfree {d}"));
            }
        }
        work.push(d);
    }
    let mut controls: Vec<String> = vec!["t".into(), "m".into(), "p".into()];
    controls.extend(work.iter().cloned());
    for _ in 0..1 + r.below(4) {
        let d = work[r.below(work.len() as u64) as usize].clone();
        let others: Vec<String> = controls.iter().filter(|c| **c != d).cloned().collect();
        compute.push(compute_op(r, &d, &others));
    }
    for c in &compute {
        lines.push(c.line.clone());
    }
    for _ in 0..r.below(3) {
        lines.push(middle_op(r, &work));
    }
    let mut uncompute: Vec<String> = compute.iter().rev().map(|c| c.adjoint.clone()).collect();
    if r.chance(35) {
        mutate(r, &mut uncompute);
    }
    lines.extend(uncompute);
    lines.extend(releases.into_iter().rev());
    let mut body = format!("qregion r 1 1\n{}", lines.join("\n"));
    if r.chance(25) {
        let n = r.below(4);
        body = format!("qregion r 1 1\nqloop {n} {{\n{}\n}}", lines.join("\n"));
    }
    // §5.3: the bounds list holds every qloop trip count in text order.
    let bounds = body
        .lines()
        .filter_map(|l| l.strip_prefix("qloop "))
        .map(|l| l.split(' ').next().unwrap().parse().unwrap())
        .collect();
    (body, bounds)
}
fn object(body: &str, bounds: &[u64]) -> String {
    let values: Vec<String> = bounds.iter().map(u64::to_string).collect();
    let signature = format!(
        r#"{{"abi":"0.8","args":[],"bounds":[{}],"in":[1],"kind":"action","mem":[],"mut":[1,1],"tier":"q"}}"#,
        values.join(",")
    );
    let regs = if bounds.is_empty() {
        String::new()
    } else {
        format!("regs {{  }} bounds {{{}}}\n", values.join(", "))
    };
    support::object(
        &[(
            "a",
            &signature,
            &format!(
                "action @a (t:wire mut, m:wire mut) (p:wire in) () () ()\n{regs}^entry():\n{body}"
            ),
        )],
        "{}",
        "",
    )
}
/// Runs @a on |t m p> for all basis values and on H|0> H|0> H|0>.
fn runs_clean(o: &Object) -> Result<(), String> {
    for input in 0..9u32 {
        let mut q = QuantumState::new();
        let wires = q.allocate(3).map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;
        for (bit, wire) in wires.iter().enumerate() {
            if input == 8 {
                q.gate("h", &[*wire], None, &[])
                    .map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;
            } else if input >> bit & 1 == 1 {
                q.gate("x", &[*wire], None, &[])
                    .map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;
            }
        }
        let mut b = QuantumBindings::default();
        for (name, wire) in ["t", "m", "p"].iter().zip(&wires) {
            b.bundles.insert((*name).into(), vec![*wire]);
        }
        let before = q.clone();
        o.execute_action("a", &mut q, &b, false, &[])
            .map_err(|e| format!("input {input}: {e}"))?;
        if q.wire_count() != 3 {
            return Err(format!("input {input}: workspace survived"));
        }
        o.execute_action("a", &mut q, &b, true, &[])
            .map_err(|e| format!("input {input} adjoint: {e}"))?;
        if q != before {
            return Err(format!("input {input}: adjoint is not the inverse"));
        }
    }
    Ok(())
}
fn sweep(seed: u64, count: usize) -> (usize, usize) {
    let mut r = Rng(seed);
    let (mut accepted, mut rejected) = (0, 0);
    for _ in 0..count {
        let (body, bounds) = program(&mut r);
        let text = object(&body, &bounds);
        match Object::parse(&text) {
            Ok(o) => {
                accepted += 1;
                if let Err(e) = runs_clean(&o) {
                    panic!("§6 accepted an ill-formed action ({e}):\n{body}");
                }
            }
            Err(_) => rejected += 1,
        }
    }
    (accepted, rejected)
}
#[test]
fn accepted_random_actions_run_exactly_clean() {
    let (accepted, rejected) = sweep(0x5eed_0001, 400);
    assert!(
        accepted > 40,
        "generator accepts too rarely: {accepted}/{rejected}"
    );
}
#[test]
#[ignore = "long differential sweep; run with --ignored and record in PROGRESS.md"]
fn accepted_random_actions_run_exactly_clean_sweep() {
    let mut total = (0, 0);
    for seed in 2..12u64 {
        let (a, r) = sweep(0x5eed_0000 + seed, 20_000);
        total = (total.0 + a, total.1 + r);
    }
    let (accepted, rejected) = total;
    println!("§6 differential sweep: {accepted} accepted (all clean), {rejected} rejected");
}

#[test]
fn generated_borrow_frames_keep_differing_classical_bindings_distinct() {
    use bennett_isa_ref::{Argument, Budget};
    let os = r#"{"abi":"0.8","args":["i1"],"fault":4,"in":[],"kind":"oracle","mem":[],"tgt":1,"tier":"q"}"#;
    let ac = r#"{"abi":"0.8","args":["token","i1","i1"],"bounds":[],"in":[],"kind":"perm_action","mem":[],"mut":[4],"tier":"q"}"#;
    let mut r = Rng(0x0b07_7002);
    for _ in 0..80 {
        let mut parity = [false; 2];
        let mut body = "perm_action @a (f:wire[4] mut) () () (tk:token, x:i1, y:i1) ()\n^entry():\nd = qborrow any 1\n".to_string();
        for _ in 0..2 * (1 + r.below(3)) {
            let j = r.below(2) as usize;
            parity[j] ^= true;
            body.push_str(&format!(
                "oracle_call @o tk () d f () ({})\n",
                ["x", "y"][j]
            ));
        }
        body.push_str("qreturn d");
        let text = support::object(
            &[
                (
                    "o",
                    os,
                    "oracle @o () (t:wire) (f:wire[4]) () (n:i1)\n^entry():\nlift.retval n",
                ),
                ("a", ac, &body),
            ],
            "{}",
            "",
        );
        let parsed = Object::parse(&text);
        // d' = d XOR parity_x*x XOR parity_y*y. This is identity for ALL
        // classical bindings iff both formal-argument occurrence counts are even.
        if parity.iter().any(|v| *v) {
            assert!(parsed.unwrap_err().to_string().contains("§5.6"));
            continue;
        }
        let o = parsed.unwrap();
        for input in 0..16u32 {
            let mut q = QuantumState::new();
            let wires = q.allocate(5).unwrap();
            for (bit, w) in wires.iter().enumerate() {
                if (input & 3) >> (bit % 2) & 1 == 1 {
                    q.gate("x", &[*w], None, &[]).unwrap();
                }
            }
            let before = q.clone();
            let mut b = QuantumBindings::default();
            b.bundles.insert("f".into(), wires[..4].to_vec());
            b.borrowed.push(vec![wires[4]]);
            b.args
                .insert("tk".into(), Argument::Token(Budget::steps(1)));
            b.args
                .insert("x".into(), Argument::Bits((input >> 2 & 1) as u128));
            b.args
                .insert("y".into(), Argument::Bits((input >> 3 & 1) as u128));
            o.execute_action("a", &mut q, &b, false, &[]).unwrap();
            assert_eq!(q, before, "{body}");
            o.execute_action("a", &mut q, &b, true, &[]).unwrap();
            assert_eq!(q, before, "{body}");
        }
    }
}

#[test]
fn generated_child_call_wrapping_preserves_bell_cleanup_obligations() {
    let cs = r#"{"abi":"0.8","args":[],"bounds":[],"in":[],"kind":"perm_action","mem":[],"mut":[1,1],"tier":"q"}"#;
    let ps = cs
        .replace("\"in\":[]", "\"in\":[1]")
        .replace("perm_action", "action");
    for kind in ["swap", "cx", "region"] {
        for count in 0..6 {
            for wrapped in [false, true] {
                let (child_sig, child, decl, direct, forward, inverse, middle) = if kind == "region"
                {
                    (
                        r#"{"abi":"0.8","args":[],"bounds":[],"in":[1],"kind":"perm_action","mem":[{"A":1,"W":1,"role":"mut"}],"mut":[1],"tier":"q"}"#,
                        "perm_action @child (d:wire mut) (p:wire in) (r:region[1,1] mut) () ()\n^entry():\nqexchm r p d".to_string(),
                        "qregion r 1 1\n",
                        "qexchm r p d".to_string(),
                        "action_call @child (d) (p) (r) ()",
                        "adj action_call @child (d) (p) (r) ()",
                        format!("z = qload r p\n{}qunload r p z\n", "cx z t\n".repeat(count)),
                    )
                } else {
                    (cs, format!("perm_action @child (a:wire mut, b:wire mut) () () () ()\n^entry():\n{kind} a b"), "", format!("{kind} d m"),
                     "action_call @child (d, m) () () ()", "adj action_call @child (d, m) () () ()", "cx m t\n".repeat(count))
                };
                let (compute, uncompute) = if wrapped {
                    (forward, inverse)
                } else {
                    (direct.as_str(), direct.as_str())
                };
                let body = format!("action @a (t:wire mut, m:wire mut) (p:wire in) () () ()\n^entry():\n{decl}d = qalloc any 1\nh d\n{compute}\n{middle}{uncompute}\nh d\nqfree d");
                let text = support::object(&[("child",child_sig,&child),("a",&ps,&body)],"{}", "\nsection layout\n{\"A_tab\":0,\"H\":0,\"S_cells\":0,\"globals\":{},\"heap_base\":1,\"heap_limit_max\":0,\"interface_regions\":{},\"null_size\":1,\"ptr_width\":32}\n");
                // For each operation, odd CX copies the H-created bit into t;
                // even CX is identity. Calling must preserve this obligation.
                if count % 2 == 1 {
                    assert!(
                        Object::parse(&text)
                            .unwrap_err()
                            .to_string()
                            .contains("§6.2"),
                        "{kind}, wrapped={wrapped}, count={count}"
                    );
                } else {
                    let o = Object::parse(&text).unwrap();
                    runs_clean(&o).unwrap();
                }
            }
        }
    }
}

#[test]
fn generated_changing_input_opaque_loops_match_independent_parity() {
    use bennett_isa_ref::{Argument, Budget};
    let os =
        r#"{"abi":"0.8","args":[],"fault":4,"in":[1],"kind":"oracle","mem":[],"tgt":1,"tier":"q"}"#;
    for flip in [false, true] {
        for n in 0..8 {
            for nested in [false, true] {
                let count = if nested { 2 * n } else { n };
                let bounds = if nested {
                    format!("[2,{n}]")
                } else {
                    format!("[{n}]")
                };
                let regs = if nested {
                    format!("2, {n}")
                } else {
                    n.to_string()
                };
                let ps = format!(
                    r#"{{"abi":"0.8","args":["token"],"bounds":{bounds},"in":[],"kind":"perm_action","mem":[],"mut":[1,4],"tier":"q"}}"#
                );
                let body = format!(
                    "qloop {n} {{\noracle_call @o tk (t) d f () ()\n{}\n}}",
                    if flip { "x t" } else { "" }
                );
                let body = if nested {
                    format!("qloop 2 {{\n{body}\n}}")
                } else {
                    body
                };
                let body = body.replace("\n\n", "\n");
                let text = support::object(&[("o",os,"oracle @o (x:wire in) (t:wire) (f:wire[4]) () ()\n^entry():\nlift.retval x"),("a",&ps,&format!("perm_action @a (t:wire mut, f:wire[4] mut) () () (tk:token) ()\nregs {{  }} bounds {{{regs}}}\n^entry():\nd = qborrow any 1\n{body}\nqreturn d"))],"{}", "");
                // Identity oracle: without flips, d' = d XOR (count%2)*t;
                // with flips, pairs contribute t XOR !t = 1. Identity on d
                // for ALL t iff count is even (no flips) or a multiple of 4.
                let valid = count % (if flip { 4 } else { 2 }) == 0;
                let parsed = Object::parse(&text);
                if !valid {
                    assert!(parsed.unwrap_err().to_string().contains("§5.6"), "{body}");
                    continue;
                }
                let o = parsed.unwrap_or_else(|e| panic!("{e}: {body}"));
                for input in 0..65u32 {
                    let mut q = QuantumState::new();
                    let w = q.allocate(6).unwrap();
                    for (bit, wire) in w.iter().enumerate() {
                        if input == 64 {
                            q.gate("h", &[*wire], None, &[]).unwrap();
                        } else if input >> bit & 1 == 1 {
                            q.gate("x", &[*wire], None, &[]).unwrap();
                        }
                    }
                    let before = q.clone();
                    let mut b = QuantumBindings::default();
                    b.bundles.insert("t".into(), vec![w[0]]);
                    b.bundles.insert("f".into(), w[1..5].to_vec());
                    b.borrowed.push(vec![w[5]]);
                    b.args
                        .insert("tk".into(), Argument::Token(Budget::steps(1)));
                    o.execute_action("a", &mut q, &b, false, &[]).unwrap();
                    assert_eq!(q, before, "{body}");
                    o.execute_action("a", &mut q, &b, true, &[]).unwrap();
                    assert_eq!(q, before, "{body}");
                }
            }
        }
    }
}

#[test]
fn generated_loop_local_borrow_returns_match_alpha_renamed_unrollings() {
    // Independent expectation: each lifetime's X parity must be even, not
    // merely the product of trip count and parity. No existing RNG is changed.
    let mut counts = (0, 0);
    for trips in 1..=4u64 {
        for flips in 1..=2usize {
            for nested in [false, true] {
                for unrolled in [false, true] {
                    let lifetime = |name: &str| {
                        format!(
                            "{name} = qborrow any 1\n{}qreturn {name}\n",
                            format!("x {name}\n").repeat(flips)
                        )
                    };
                    let (mut body, mut bounds) = if unrolled {
                        (
                            (0..trips)
                                .map(|j| lifetime(&format!("b{j}")))
                                .collect::<String>(),
                            vec![],
                        )
                    } else {
                        (
                            format!("qloop {trips} {{\n{}}}", lifetime("b")),
                            vec![trips],
                        )
                    };
                    if nested {
                        body = format!("qloop 2 {{\n{}\n}}", body.trim_end());
                        bounds.insert(0, 2);
                    }
                    let text = support::borrow_lifetime_object(&body, &bounds);
                    if flips == 1 {
                        let e = Object::parse(&text).expect_err("one-X lifetime accepted");
                        assert!(e.to_string().contains("§5.6"), "{e}");
                        counts.1 += 1;
                    } else {
                        let o = Object::parse(&text).unwrap();
                        support::borrow_identity(&o);
                        counts.0 += 1;
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }
    assert_eq!(counts, (16, 16));
}

#[test]
fn generated_fresh_borrow_cx_loops_match_per_lifetime_maps() {
    // Fresh beta_i is universally quantified for EVERY return: neither an
    // even number of iterations nor alpha-renaming can cancel its influence.
    let mut counts = (0, 0);
    for trips in 1..=4u64 {
        for gate in ["cx d t", "cx t d"] {
            for copies in 1..=2 {
                for nested in [false, true] {
                    for unrolled in [false, true] {
                        let lifetime = |name: &str| {
                            format!(
                                "{name} = qborrow any 1\n{}qreturn {name}\n",
                                format!("{gate}\n").replace('d', name).repeat(copies)
                            )
                        };
                        let (mut body, mut bounds) = if unrolled {
                            (
                                (0..trips)
                                    .map(|i| lifetime(&format!("b{i}")))
                                    .collect::<String>(),
                                vec![],
                            )
                        } else {
                            (
                                format!("qloop {trips} {{\n{}}}", lifetime("d")),
                                vec![trips],
                            )
                        };
                        if nested {
                            body = format!("qloop 2 {{\n{}\n}}", body.trim_end());
                            bounds.insert(0, 2);
                        }
                        let text = support::borrow_lifetime_object(&body, &bounds);
                        if copies == 1 {
                            assert!(
                                Object::parse(&text)
                                    .unwrap_err()
                                    .to_string()
                                    .contains("§5.6"),
                                "{body}"
                            );
                            counts.1 += 1;
                        } else {
                            support::borrow_identity(&Object::parse(&text).unwrap());
                            counts.0 += 1;
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }
    assert_eq!(counts, (32, 32));
}

#[test]
fn generated_nested_calls_with_regions_and_local_borrows_match_boolean_maps() {
    // V: b ^= p; W: t ^= b, r[p] ^= b. V;W;V;W is exactly
    // (t,r[0],r[1],p,b) -> (t XOR p,r[0],r[1] XOR p,p,b).
    // Dropping the second W leaves beta in both outputs iff W's count is odd.
    // Expected states are built from this independent map, not another execution.
    let sig = r#"{"abi":"0.8","args":[],"bounds":[],"in":[1],"kind":"perm_action","mem":[{"A":1,"W":1,"role":"mut"}],"mut":[1],"tier":"q"}"#;
    let mut counts = (0, 0);
    for trips in 1..=4u64 {
        for copies in 0..=3 {
            for complete in [false, true] {
                for wrapped in [false, true] {
                    for nested in [false, true] {
                        let w = "cx b t\nqstore r p b\n".repeat(copies);
                        let leaf = format!("perm_action @leaf (t:wire mut) (p:wire in) (r:region[1,1] mut) () ()\n^entry():\nb = qborrow any 1\ncx p b\n{w}cx p b\n{}qreturn b", if complete { &w } else { "" });
                        let middle = "perm_action @middle (u:wire mut) (v:wire in) (s:region[1,1] mut) () ()\n^entry():\naction_call @leaf (u) (v) (s) ()";
                        let call = format!(
                            "action_call @{} (t) (p) (r) ()",
                            if wrapped { "middle" } else { "leaf" }
                        );
                        let (body, bounds) = if nested {
                            (
                                format!("qloop 2 {{\nqloop {trips} {{\n{call}\n}}\n}}"),
                                vec![2, trips],
                            )
                        } else {
                            (format!("qloop {trips} {{\n{call}\n}}"), vec![trips])
                        };
                        let ps = sig.replace("\"bounds\":[]", &format!("\"bounds\":{bounds:?}"));
                        let regs = bounds
                            .iter()
                            .map(u64::to_string)
                            .collect::<Vec<_>>()
                            .join(", ");
                        let parent = format!("perm_action @a (t:wire mut) (p:wire in) (r:region[1,1] mut) () ()\nregs {{  }} bounds {{{regs}}}\n^entry():\n{body}");
                        let text = support::object(&[("leaf", sig, &leaf), ("middle", sig, middle), ("a", &ps, &parent)], "{}", "\nsection layout\n{\"A_tab\":0,\"H\":0,\"S_cells\":0,\"globals\":{},\"heap_base\":1,\"heap_limit_max\":0,\"interface_regions\":{},\"null_size\":1,\"ptr_width\":32}\n");
                        if !complete && copies % 2 == 1 {
                            assert!(
                                Object::parse(&text)
                                    .unwrap_err()
                                    .to_string()
                                    .contains("§5.6"),
                                "{leaf}\n{body}"
                            );
                            counts.1 += 1;
                            continue;
                        }
                        let o = Object::parse(&text).unwrap();
                        counts.0 += 1;
                        for input in 0..34u32 {
                            let mut q = QuantumState::new();
                            let wires = q.allocate(6).unwrap();
                            for (bit, wire) in wires[..5].iter().enumerate() {
                                if input == 32 {
                                    q.gate("h", &[*wire], None, &[]).unwrap();
                                } else if input == 33 {
                                    if bit == 0 || bit == 1 || bit == 4 {
                                        q.gate("h", &[*wire], None, &[]).unwrap();
                                    }
                                } else if input >> bit & 1 == 1 {
                                    q.gate("x", &[*wire], None, &[]).unwrap();
                                }
                            }
                            if input == 33 {
                                q.gate("cx", &[wires[4], wires[5]], None, &[]).unwrap();
                            }
                            let entry = q.clone();
                            let mut expected = entry.clone();
                            if complete && copies % 2 == 1 && trips % 2 == 1 && !nested {
                                expected
                                    .gate("cx", &[wires[1], wires[0]], None, &[])
                                    .unwrap();
                                expected
                                    .gate("cx", &[wires[1], wires[3]], None, &[])
                                    .unwrap();
                            }
                            let mut b = QuantumBindings::default();
                            b.bundles.insert("t".into(), vec![wires[0]]);
                            b.bundles.insert("p".into(), vec![wires[1]]);
                            b.regions.insert(
                                "r".into(),
                                bennett_isa_ref::QuantumRegion {
                                    address_width: 1,
                                    cell_width: 1,
                                    cells: vec![vec![wires[2]], vec![wires[3]]],
                                },
                            );
                            b.borrowed.push(vec![wires[4]]);
                            o.execute_action("a", &mut q, &b, false, &[]).unwrap();
                            assert_eq!(q, expected, "input={input}, {leaf}\n{body}");
                            o.execute_action("a", &mut q, &b, true, &[]).unwrap();
                            assert_eq!(q, entry, "adjoint, input={input}, {leaf}\n{body}");
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }
    assert_eq!(counts, (96, 32));
}

#[test]
fn generated_r5_certificate_and_clean_context_lifetimes_match_independent_maps() {
    let (mut accepted, mut rejected) = (0, 0);
    // Independent per-lifetime Boolean equations, irrespective of trip parity:
    // one X: beta'=beta^1; one CX: beta'=beta^t OR t'=t^beta.
    // Two identical gates cancel within the SAME lifetime.
    for n in 1..=4 {
        for gate in ["x b", "cx b t", "cx t b"] {
            for repetitions in 1..=2 {
                for nested in [false, true] {
                    let gates = vec![gate; repetitions].join("\n");
                    let inner = format!("qloop {n} {{\nb = qborrow any 1\n{gates}\nqreturn b\n}}");
                    let (body, bounds) = if nested {
                        (format!("qloop 2 {{\n{inner}\n}}"), vec![2, n])
                    } else {
                        (inner, vec![n])
                    };
                    for certified in [false, true] {
                        let text = if certified {
                            support::certified_borrow_identity(&body, &bounds)
                        } else {
                            support::borrow_lifetime_object(&body, &bounds)
                        };
                        if repetitions == 2 {
                            let o = Object::parse(&text).unwrap();
                            support::borrow_identity(&o);
                            if certified {
                                o.verify_certificate().unwrap();
                            }
                            accepted += 1;
                        } else {
                            let e = Object::parse(&text).unwrap_err().to_string();
                            assert!(e.contains("§5.6"), "{e}");
                            rejected += 1;
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        for dirty in [false, true] {
            for unrolled in [false, true] {
                let (lifetimes, bounds) = if unrolled {
                    (
                        (0..n)
                            .map(|j| format!("b{j} = qborrow any 1\ncx d b{j}\nqreturn b{j}"))
                            .collect::<Vec<_>>()
                            .join("\n"),
                        vec![],
                    )
                } else {
                    (
                        format!("qloop {n} {{\nb = qborrow any 1\ncx d b\nqreturn b\n}}"),
                        vec![n],
                    )
                };
                let x = if dirty { "x d\n" } else { "" };
                let body = format!("d = qalloc any 1\n{x}{lifetimes}\n{x}qfree d");
                for certified in [false, true] {
                    let text = if certified {
                        support::certified_borrow_identity(&body, &bounds)
                    } else {
                        support::borrow_lifetime_object(&body, &bounds)
                    };
                    if dirty {
                        assert!(Object::parse(&text)
                            .unwrap_err()
                            .to_string()
                            .contains("§5.6"));
                        rejected += 1;
                    } else {
                        let o = Object::parse(&text).unwrap();
                        support::borrow_identity(&o);
                        if certified {
                            o.verify_certificate().unwrap();
                        }
                        accepted += 1;
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }
    assert_eq!((accepted, rejected), (64, 64));
}

#[test]
fn generated_r5_alpha_renaming_consumed_workspace_preserves_widths() {
    let mut count = 0;
    for n in 1..=3 {
        for width in 1..=3 {
            for second in ["d", "e"] {
                let body = format!("qloop {n} {{\nd = qalloc any 1\ncx t d\ncx t d\nqfree d\n{second} = qalloc any {width}\nqfree {second}\n}}");
                let o = Object::parse(&support::borrow_lifetime_object(&body, &[n])).unwrap();
                support::borrow_identity(&o);
                count += 1;
            }
````
